2769210.description: After being cancelled during ADE 2025 due to the adverse weather conditions, Heliotrope by Heleen Blanken & Daniel de Bruin is back at the ADE Lab Village in Westerpark during the ADE week 2026. Heliotrope is a kinetic installation inspired by the natural phenomenon in which plants orient their leaves and blossoms toward the sun. The work takes this principle as both a biological reference and a metaphor, exploring processes of energy reception, tropistic behaviour, the atomic movements inherent to living matter, and the pulsating rhythms embedded within the natural world. This idea is translated into a mirrored installation. The mechanically engineered installation moves its blades, diffusing light beams, and reflecting its surroundings in a chaotic and refracted image. It explores parallels between manufactured and organic movements and tries to liquefy the barriers. Heliotrope transforms from day into night and back again, evoking a state of perpetual motion. In doing so, it proposes an artificial organism, one that, like its botanical counterpart, responds to invisible flows of energy. Heliotrope is a public light installation in Westerpark. It can be visited for free at any time of day or night during ADE week.
2769210.title: Heliotrope by Heleen Blanken & Daniel de Bruin
2769210.title_full: Heliotrope by Heleen Blanken & Daniel de Bruin

2802143.description: German DJ and producer Klangkuenstler is one of the defining voices of the modern techno scene. He stands for an uncompromising sound – a powerful blend of old-school and new-school Techno. His “All Night Long” series has become a signature experience, giving him full creative control over the night. These 7 to 8-hour sets take dancers on a journey through the genre's history, diving deep into Klangkuenstler’s music collection from the late 1990s to the mid-2010s. With his brand “Outworld,” Klangkuenstler brings his bold vision of Techno to life, not just as a label but also as an event series with an innovative production concept. Blending futuristic aesthetics with raw, industrial sound, Outworld transports the crowd into a dystopian, sci-fi-inspired world. At the heart of Outworld is an innovative lighting design built around a striking portal aesthetic. Massive LED and truss structures, strobe effects, a white only light color scheme, and precisely aligned beams create the impression of stepping through a dimensional gateway into a sci-fi world. Each event transforms the venue into a cinematic environment where music and architecture interact, creating a short break from reality.
2802143.title: OUTWORLD – Klangkuenstler All Night Long

2802196.description: During ADE 2026, German DJ MALUGI will be coming to Paradiso for a DJ set lasting a full five hours. The Berlin-based DJ, with his mischievous smile and penguin-like moves, is also known as ‘The Happiest Man in Dance Music’. His DJing style and infectious energy have proven to be a formula that has made him a household name and earned him the BBC Radio 1 Future Star 2025 award. This has taken him to venues such as Panorama Bar, Warehouse Project, Amnesia Ibiza and Awakenings.

2803852.description: Following the success of last year's ADE afterparty, Talkback Heads returns to Amsterdam with another showcase celebrating the depth and diversity of the underground electronic music scene. Bringing together four artists with distinct identities. At the heart of the showcase is Talkback Heads (CH), whose sound bridges cultures and scenes through driving grooves, hypnotic rhythms, and forward-thinking techno. After years of international performances and releases on respected labels including Frequenza, Black Kat, Affluenza, and M5, he returns to ADE with the signature energy that has taken him from underground spaces to dance floors around the world. Joining him is Ancient Astronaut X (ZA), a close collaborator of Talkback Heads who brings his own distinctive take on melodic techno. Blending cinematic atmospheres, powerful grooves, and rap influences, his sets move between emotion, energy, and experimentation. With live instrumentation, dynamic sound manipulation, and spontaneous elements, he turns each performance into an immersive journey that evolves in the moment. FODA (CH), a Zürich-based DJ and producer whose high-energy, unpredictable sets have been shaped by Zürich's underground scene and the local Burning Man community. Expect punchy basslines, oriental textures, playful vocals, tribal rhythms, and acid undertones—all delivered with technical precision and an instinct for keeping the dance floor locked in from beginning to end. Conner Oldham (UK) is completing the line-up, bringing a bass-driven sound rooted in UKG and Tech. Expect rolling basslines, punchy percussion, meaty drums, and stripped-back grooves, with sets moving between UKG, tech house, and house while keeping the energy high and unpredictable. Following a recent set at Locked In Club in Chiang Mai, Thailand, he continues to push his sound internationally with a distinct UK underground flavour. Four artists. Three distinct visions of techno. From bass-driven grooves and melodic journeys to hypn

2804233.description: This October, Lane 8 brings his acclaimed label and event series This Never Happened to DGTL ADE for a special daytime gathering at the Kromhouthal. Built around emotional storytelling, deep connection, and a shared love for melodic electronic music, This Never Happened has grown into a global community unlike any other. Led by Lane 8's signature blend of house, progressive, and melodic sounds, the concept has become known for creating moments that live far beyond the dancefloor. Adding to the magic, Mees Salomé and Yotto join forces for a special B2B set, uniting two of the scene's most respected melodic storytellers for a journey through deep, immersive soundscapes. Swedish producer Kasbo brings his unmistakable blend of emotive electronica and uplifting melodies, delivering the kind of set that perfectly captures the spirit of This Never Happened. Together, they help shape a daytime experience built on connection, feeling, and unforgettable musical moments. This show is a This Never Happened event. At TNH events, we do not allow any photo or video recording from phones or cameras. This policy will be implemented using either camera tape or a camera disabling phone app on entry. Any disposable or digital cameras brought to the venue will also need to be taped. I believe that without phones or cameras, we can create a more positive and engaging atmosphere for all fans. Experience the moment, don’t record it, This Never Happened.

2805815.description: Watt events invites two of their dearest friends and inspirators. There are artists who define a moment and there are artists who quietly shape an entire culture over decades. Hernan Cattaneo and Nick Warren belong firmly to the latter. For ADE Wednesday we bring them together for a rare and extended 6-hour back-to-back set, the way this music was always intended to be experienced. Both of them, through their work on Sudbeat, The Soundgarden and their legacy with Global Underground, have shaped a deeper, more timeless interpretation of electronic music that continues to resonate with those who listen beyond the obvious. Their approach has never been about trends or quick impact, but about patience, detail and emotional depth, a way of playing that rewards those who stay, who listen and who understand that the real moments often live in the transitions rather than the peaks. For us, this goes far beyond just another ADE booking. The very first Watt event was built around Hernan Cattaneo and his Sudbeat label, followed shortly after by an ADE party where he and Nick Warren already shared the decks. In many ways, their music helped shape the foundation of what Watt Events has become; a direction rooted in storytelling, long-form sets and a deeper connection to the dancefloor. To have them return now, side by side, for a 6-hour set during ADE already completes our dream line up of the week (and its just night 1!) Expect a night that unfolds gradually. No rush, no shortcuts with two artists who know exactly how to read a room, building something that evolves hour by hour, moving through warmth, tension, groove and emotion with a level of control that only comes from decades behind the decks. This is not about a single highlight, but about the full arc of the experience. From the first record to the last, be there. Tickets are now available, and this show will sell out in advance.
2805815.title: Hernan Cattaneo b2b Nick Warren 6hrs

2805818.description: Watt events is excited to welcome Worakls back for a special ADE gathering. His unique approach to electronic music, where classical influences meet powerful club rhythms, has made him one of the most distinctive artists of his generation. Long before melodic techno became a formula, Kevin Rodrigues was approaching electronic music like a composer rather than a DJ. Raised on classical piano from the age of three and shaped by conservatory training, his productions have always carried a very different sense of structure. Not built around quick impact or predictable tension-and-release, but around harmony, movement and orchestration. You can hear it in the details of his sound design. The way string arrangements are layered against rolling low-end sequences. How arpeggios slowly evolve over long passages without losing emotional weight. His tracks often move like film scores translated into club music. Worakls helped define an entire European melodic movement during the early 2010s. At a time when underground electronic music was often split between minimal functionality and festival maximalism, Worakls introduced something more cinematic, emotional and musically rich. Deep progressive storytelling merged with classical composition, live instrumentation and hypnotic techno sequencing. What makes Worakls stand apart is that his music still feels composed rather than assembled. You hear years of musical theory behind the transitions, chord voicings and dynamic control. Even in his heaviest moments there is restraint. Space. Breathing room. His sets rarely rush toward peaks because the tension lives inside the progression itself. Over the years this evolved into the Worakls Orchestra project, where electronic arrangements were rebuilt for full ensembles and conducted live across Europe, further blurring the line between concert music and underground club culture. This ADE Thursday show at Westweelde, that entire musical philosophy lands inside one room.
2805818.title: Worakls & friends

2805824.description: Watt events continues its all night long ADE sessions with Guy J. For nearly two decades, Guy J has built a reputation not through hype or trends, but through an obsessive dedication to musical storytelling. His rise happened quietly and organically, driven almost entirely by the depth of his productions and the emotional precision of his sets. While many artists became known for big moments, Guy J became known for the space between them. Through his labels Lost & Found and Early Morning, he created entire ecosystems around that philosophy. Lost & Found became a home for deep progressive music with cinematic detail and emotional weight, while Early Morning is exploring a more intimate and experimental side of his sound. Warm textures, subtle grooves and records designed for those final hours where tension and atmosphere matter more than impact. What makes a Guy J all night long set so different is the patience inside the structure. Technically, his sets are built less around drops and more around gradual harmonic evolution. Tiny melodic changes, layered percussion loops, long EQ transitions and overlapping atmospheres slowly reshape the room over hours instead of minutes. Tracks are often blended in ways that make it difficult to hear where one ends and another begins. The opening hours can be almost deceptively restrained. Deep, hypnotic and spacious. Rhythms sit low in the mix while melodies slowly reveal themselves over extended passages. By the middle of the night the energy becomes denser and more psychedelic, with rolling basslines, complex synth modulation and progressive tension that keeps building without ever fully exploding. Then, toward the later hours, the set often becomes emotional again, reflective, melodic and deeply human. That is why people stay for entire nights with Guy J. Not for individual tracks, but for the journey itself. This ADE Thursday at IJland, surrounded by water and the Amsterdam skyline, that full experience unfolds from beginning
2805824.title: Guy J all-night-long

2805833.description: Watt events continues its legendary Sasha b2b Patrice Bäumel ADE session. For several years now, ADE Saturday with Sasha b2b Patrice Bäumel has become more than a date in the ADE calendar, it has grown into a reference point for what quality underground electronic music should feel like when it is given the space and the attention it deserves. In an era where speed often replaces substance, this collaboration has remained consistent, intentional and deeply rooted in musical integrity. Each edition has sold out not because of trend cycles or short-lived hype, but because the experience has proven itself year after year. Sasha’s contribution to electronic music cannot be overstated. Emerging from the UK scene in the late 80s and becoming a defining force in the progressive movement of the 90s, he helped shape the idea of the extended set as a narrative form, where tension, release and atmosphere are constructed patiently over hours rather than minutes. His approach has always prioritized storytelling, emotional architecture and technical precision over instant gratification. Patrice Bäumel, with his background rooted in Amsterdam’s underground and years of shaping dance floors across Europe, represents a different but equally essential lineage. His sets are known for their restraint, depth and hypnotic focus; long blends, subtle shifts in energy, and a sensitivity to the room that turns a DJ set into a shared psychological journey. His residency years at Trouw and his global touring career have built a reputation based not on volume, but on control and musical intelligence. When these two artists meet, it is not a standard back-to-back. It is a dialogue between generations and philosophies within electronic music. Progressive heritage meeting modern minimal tension, British narrative craft meeting Amsterdam’s refined underground aesthetic. The result is something that can only be understood inside the room. We return this ADE Saturday to the same venue, the same day,
2805833.lineup_names: Das Pharaoh · Gai Barone · Mariano Mellino · Patrice Bäumel · Paul Thomas · Sasha · Weird Sounding Dude

2806967.description: The Original House Music Showcase at Amsterdam Dance Event For the first time in its history, DJ International Records brings its official showcase to the Amsterdam Dance Event, celebrating over four decades of Chicago House Music and its lasting influence on dance culture worldwide. Founded in Chicago in 1985 by the late Rocky Jones, DJ International Records helped shape the global House movement through a catalogue that introduced some of the genre's most influential artists and recordings. More than forty years later, the label continues to honour its heritage while embracing the future of underground electronic music. Taking place on Saturday, October 24, 2026, this special daytime showcase transforms 50:HERTZ House & Techno Club – Rembrandt Square into a meeting point between the birthplace of House Music and one of the world's leading electronic music festivals. The lineup brings together pioneering artists and contemporary talents, reflecting the label's ongoing commitment to authentic House Music and its continuous evolution. Line-up (A–Z) ADEZ Bianchetti DJ E-Funk DJ Vivona MR. SKIN Robert Owens TWOEF Presented by SudAest Booking Agency, Nasty Juice Music, with Desslab Distribution as Distribution Partner and Sonic Frequency leading the international promotion, the showcase marks a historic milestone for DJ International Records and its first official appearance at ADE. Unable to join us in Amsterdam? Crop Of Music Radio, the event's Official Radio Partner, will broadcast the entire showcase live, bringing the sound and atmosphere of this unique celebration to listeners around the world. Join us as Chicago House returns to centre stage and experience an afternoon dedicated to one of dance music's most influential legacies.
2806967.lineup_names: ADEZ · BIANCHETTI · DJ E-Funk · DJ Vivona · MR. SKIN · Robert Owens · TWOEF

2807164.description: This year, we celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Amsterdam Dance Event. Marking 10 years of their collaboration, the Metropole Orkest and Melkweg are once again teaming up to host one of the opening concerts. The orchestra, conducted by Simon Dobson, will be joined by visionary producer, artist, and cultural architect Kybba. From the sun-drenched region of Salento in Italy to the heart of global club culture in Amsterdam, Kybba has evolved into a boundary-pushing producer and artist with deep roots in Jamaican and LATAM musical heritage. His influence stems mainly from the Basshall Movement, the platform founded in 2016 that grew into a global empire with Basshall Records, Basshall TV, and sold-out events, as well as a large online community centered around dancehall, afro, and Caribbean music. By combining dancehall with bass influences, Kybba scored international hits. ‘Colombian’ and ‘Pon Di Ting’ put him on the map, while ‘Ba Ba Bad’ (2024), featuring legendary Sean Paul and dancehall icon Busy Signal, further strengthened his global breakthrough. His debut mixtape ‘How You Bad Suh’ (2025), marked a defining moment in his career, featuring collaborations with artists including Barrington Levy, Bounty Killer, and Kalash. After a successful tour across iconic cities in North America and Europe, and the launch of his own two-day festival, Kybba now joins forces with the Metropole Orkest for a special tribute to the Basshall sound, reaffirming that music is the ultimate universal language. Explore more ADE events at Melkweg here .
2807164.title: Ade Opening Concert Kybba Metropole Orkest Special Guests
2807164.title_full: Opening Concert: KYBBA & Metropole Orkest + special guests

2807370.description: Forget the conference room. This is where ADE actually gets done. Since 2018, Exchange Asia has been quietly building the bridge nobody else bothered with, Asia's dance music scene and the West's, in the same space, trading more than just sets. This year, that bridge goes dark. BLACK MARKET takes the Boiler Room format and strips out everything that isn't essential: 10-12 artists, 45 minutes each, zero filler. But this isn't a line up to watch and forget. It's a market. Every DJ who steps up is here to trade : a sound, a contact, a booking, a favour, and the floor is built to make sure that trade actually happens. An Exchange Board on-site turns a room full of strangers into a five-minute conversation with exactly the right person. No cash fees for artists. No corporate sponsor logos plastered across the booth. Just the scene running its own economy, off the books, in the room that matters more than the one with the badges. Eight years in, Exchange Asia has built something most ADE showcases never manage. a crowd that return. Same faces, new deals, every October. The regulars know the room before they walk in, and they're the ones bringing the next generation through the door with them. 300+ people already know what this is. The rest find out when it's too late to say they were there first. Free entry. No dress code. Bring something to trade.
2807370.lineup_names: Asabella · Better · FJR · Helang · J.Masaki · John Kho · John Odin · Kim Sane · Nela · Nelson Dior · Roxie Li · Song · ZÖE VI
2807370.title: Exchange ASIA:

2809379.description: Some nights are about getting loud. FLIGHT MODE is about getting deeper & connected with music. In a world of endless scrolls and pings, FLIGHT MODE offers a rare moment to disconnect from the noise, the pressure, the everyday life and reconnect with the sound, yourself and likeminded people. Originating from Sagia’s monthly radio show* under the same name, FLIGHT MODE is an inclusive space to enjoy captivating music from a range of electronica spectrum, predominantly Melodic House and Techno, Deep and Progressive vibes, where every set tells a story. We invite you to step aboard an experience where the music is the guide and you are the main character. Expect deep, melody-driven vibes, a no-ego and all-feeling dancefloor. Whether you are a seasoned traveller or someone seeking a new destination - Flight Mode is for you! We believe in connection and freedom expressed through music. After a well received debut at last year’s Amsterdam Music Event and a rooftop edition overlooking Gdańsk shipyard in Poland over summer, FLIGHT MODE is coming back to ADE 2026. Take off with us - all passengers welcome! *Flight Mode events are curated by Sagia with a range of guest artists featured on the radio show. 2812228.description: Club Baggerbeest, Amsterdam — Wednesday, 21 October 2026 · 12:00 – 18:30 For the first time, Big Bells Records and Audiosolo come together at the Amsterdam Dance Event — a debut ADE moment for both labels, and the start of a long-imagined collaboration between two underground communities separated by continents but bound by the same musical philosophy. Big Bells Records , founded in 2019 by Bosnian-born, Stuttgart-based DJ and producer Adnan Jakubovic , is an independent label dedicated to emotionally driven Progressive, Melodic, Organic, and Deep House. With releases distributed by Proton Radio (San Francisco) and a global roster of artists, Big Bells has built a reputation for refined, story-driven electronic music with depth and atmosphere. Audiosolo , founded in 2016 by Sri Lankan DJ, producer and curator Nishan Lee alongside a collective of friends, has grown from a small community-driven project into one of South Asia's most respected platforms for underground electronic music — running events, releases, radio shows, and educational initiatives that connect the local scene to a wider international network. At Club Baggerbeest, the two labels meet for a daytime showcase built around melody, groove, and the kind of journey-led DJing both crews are known for. Line-up: Andre Zeldenrust · klangverwandt B2B Arrakis (GER) · Dj Ruby · Waya SL B2B Desh · Adnan Jakubovic B2B Shell Robinson · Nishan Lee · + special guest TBA A first ADE. A first collaboration. 2813292.description: As you approach Deep Seeing Currents by Olafur Eliasson , you are slowly enveloped by darkness and the sounds of life underwater. Layers of oceanic cacophony – whale songs, rumbling of hydrothermal vents, and human-made noises, among others – surround you, while the vibrations can be felt throughout your entire body, emulating the experience of pressure in the deep sea. Above and around you, lights flash and seem to descend like the hypnotic circulation of marine snow, the organic and inorganic particles essential to life in the deep sea. The immersive sound of Deep seeing currents is brought to life by 4DSOUND . The exhibition is located inside the ARTIS Aquarium and can be visited with a valid ARTIS Park ticket. Tickets are available through the ARTIS website. Opening hours: Wed - Sun, 09:00 - 18.00
2813292.title: Deep Seeing Currents

2814580.description: Originally from Tokyo, Japan, Takuya Nakamura moved to the United States in 1990 to study under the legendary jazz theorist and composer George Russell at the New England Conservatory of Music. Under Russell’s tutelage, Nakamura honed his craft and developed a profound understanding of jazz theory and composition, which would become fundamental to his innovative approach to music. In 94′ Nakamura moved to New York City, where he quickly became a staple in the vibrant Jazz and Jungle scene. He has worked with legendary figures such as Quincy Jones, David Byrne, and Arto Lindsay, bringing his distinctive sound to numerous recordings and live performances. Takuya Nakamura continues to push the boundaries of music, with recent projects blending his deep jazz roots with cutting-edge electronic production. His dedication to his craft and his ability to transcend genres make him a true pioneer in contemporary music.
2814580.title: Takuya Nakamura

2815281.description: DISCO changed nightlife forever. But how did it all begin? What did Amsterdam sound like when the first disco records drifted in from New York? Who was there at the forefront when everything was still new, raw and exciting? And what remains of those nights filled with glitter, freedom and unapologetic dancing? During this ADE Arts & Culture special, we dive into the history of the disco scene and the dawn of the DJ era. From pioneers and tastemakers to clubs like Vrijhaven and today’s festivals. We trace the journey from disco to house and ask ourselves: is that energy still alive? Do we still dare to embrace the disco spirit? Expect stories, music, performances and fresh perspectives. We honour the past, question the present and celebrate everything in between. Tickets now available! Programme: 19.00 – 20.00 Welcoming tunes with Shirley Hart & visit to the DISCO exhibition (open all evening) 20.00 – 20.45 Indepth session: Do we still dare to disco? Speakers: disco legend Eddy de Clercq, disco diva Sunny Jansen, and disco lover Thijs Weijland (Adonis/ Supernature). 2815992.description: As if she’s sitting next to you on the couch, Diamanda La Berge Dramm ’s voice is intimate and immediate. The simplicity of her speaking, singing and violin playing draws the listener into her fantasy world—magical and at the same time crystal clear. With simple tools—two violins, a small table, a studio lamp and a few pedals—she creates an intimate and crystal-clear world on stage. The audience witnesses the unfolding of Chimp’s sound world: the acoustic violin as the first source, the voice as transportation, and the electric violin facilitating it all. Nothing more than that—completely minimal. Yet the result is maximal. Drawing from her rich musical background, Dramm combines classical training, the American avant-garde, new music and a deep love of alternative pop. These influences are not presented as references, but filtered into a highly personal musical language: direct, natural and unmistakably her own.

2816040.context: Hoketus 50! A work that forever changed the landscape of new music Live Performances / Beyond the Dancefloor / Contemporary / Live / East Muziekgebouw aan 't IJ · 20:15 - 22:00 Muziekgebouw aan 't IJ + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46
2816040.description: Uncompromising in form and driven by a rhythmic energy that defies all convention – that is Hoketus , the legendary composition by Louis Andriessen . Fifty years ago, Andriessen wrote this still-striking piece that reshaped the face of contemporary music. Hoketus became a cornerstone of the Dutch musical movement known as the Haagse School (The Hague School) and an enduring source of inspiration far beyond the Netherlands. Many composers have drawn from Andriessen’s propulsive rhythms, minimalist precision, and raw sonic world. For this anniversary celebration, Michael Gordon , co-founder of the legendary Bang on a Can collective, writes a mirror composition: a new work that confronts Hoketushead-on. Not a homage, but a next step in the path Andriessen set out – music that doesn’t yield, but clashes, moves, and breaks.
2816040.title: Hoketus 50!

2816235.description: Nothing Here Now and The Rest Is Noise present the live premiere of Crawler: Your Death Is a Lullaby at Muziekgebouw. This night will open with the performance of Coil in the foyer of the Muziekgebouw. Coil experiences itself as an amplification of an audio tactile sensation. With a speaker embedded in the hips and a microphone positioned at the top of the spine, Ciro and Koiri move a giant spring reverb through the room. Continuing with the night we open the Grote Zaal with the new collaborative project from 2K88 , Rainy Miller , and Bianca Scout , developed during an Unsound residency and released as Everything Always Changes, For We're Truly Here, which features Lauren Duffus, weaving hypnagogic R&B through half-remembered histories. The evening continues with Crawler , founded by Rachella Groen (Zohar) and Harry Castle, joined by writer Gervaise Alexis Savvias. The project asks who gets to be legible, and what it costs to insist on being otherwise, treating instability, fragility, and refusal as a queer politics rather than as failures of communication. Grief, desire, Blackness, and hauntology run throughout Gervaise's writing, positioning the body on stage as a site of contest rather than display. For this premiere, cellist Malou van der Veld and guitarist Rob Toal-Lennon join the core group, while Studio Basse Stitgen's live installation and Clint Soren's visuals extend Crawler's collective language into the spatial and visual dimensions of the performance. Closing the night is Nkisi , an electronic musician and composer rooted in the Congolese diaspora and African cosmologies. Co-founder of NON Worldwide, her research project The Anomaly Index explores rhythm and vibration as counter-epistemologies, while her live performance extends the ongoing Black Spells Series: sonic rituals of remembrance in which rhythm carries stories rather than merely decorating them. The project is part of Muziekgebouw Productiehuis and the ADE Arts & Culture. Explore more ADE Arts

2816261.description: A monochromatic light instrument played through collective presence. White Space is an immersive installation that transforms negative space into a place where strangers connect. At its heart, a monolith of intense blue and white light spins on its axis, casting compositions of monochromatic light and generative music that shift and dance among the audience. Responding to pose and position, the sculpture becomes an instrument, played by everyone present at once. Only by coordinating their positions and synchronising their poses can visitors reach the climax of the installation: illuminating the emptiness that separates them and transforming the negative space into White Space. White Space is an interactive light installation by artist Matthias Oostrik , who leads its concept, software, and production. Developed under the Harmonic Dissonance Collective , it premieres during ADE Friday (with a public try-out on ADE Thursday), hosted by ICK Dans Amsterdam. Its sonic language, developed with composer Marcel Wierckx , draws from electronic dance music and generative composition, placing the work at the intersection of light art, club culture, and participatory performance. During both the public try-out and premiere, DJ Michiel Bouwens will be playing. The program also features ‘ SMILE ’, Oostrik's AI installation that transforms your portrait into an eerily perfect version of yourself. The Harmonic Dissonance Collective, which Oostrik co-founded with Suzanne Dikker, is known for award-winning work on human connectedness, with collaborations spanning artists from Marina Abramović to Bad Bunny and institutions including the Max Planck Society, VU Amsterdam, New York University, and ICK Dans Amsterdam. Programme: ADE Thursday: Public Try Out, €5- ADE Friday: Premiere, €5- ADE Saturday: Installation, Free ADE Sunday: Installation, Free

2816261.title: Ade X Space For Dance Art

2816293.description: Join True House LA during Amsterdam Dance Event for a very special evening celebrating the life, music, and legacy of the legendary DJ Romain. DJ Romain was more than an incredible producer and DJ, he was a mentor, an inspiration, and a true friend to so many throughout the global house music community. For decades, his music moved dance floors around the world, and his passion for authentic house music never wavered. From the very beginning, Romain was a proud supporter of True House LA, and we are honored to celebrate the lasting impact he had on our family and on house music as a whole. This night is also a milestone celebration as True House LA marks 10 years at Amsterdam Dance Event, sharing this unforgettable occasion during ADE's 30th anniversary. It's a moment to reflect on the friendships, the music, and the incredible community that has brought us together year after year. Providing the soundtrack for this special celebration are: Joel DeMarzo • SAMO • Doc Link • Hugo H. • First Lady • Jason Hodges • Melvin Meeks • Mike Lachman • Regina Love (ADE Debut) Expect an unforgettable journey of soulful, deep, and underground house music from early evening until late into the night as we dance in honor of DJ Romain and celebrate everything that makes ADE so special. Come celebrate the music. Celebrate the memories. Celebrate the people who keep house music alive. One more dance. One more family reunion. One unforgettable ADE.
2816293.lineup_names: DJ Hugo H. · Doc Link · First Lady · Joel DeMarzo · Melvin Meeks · Mike Lachman · Regina Love · SAMO
2816293.title: True House LA Presents: A Tribute to DJ Romain

2816666.description: LABYRINTH 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY — ADE SATURDAY 24 OCTOBER After our first passage into Labyrinth, our second ADE celebrates our 1 year anniversary. We yearned for lineups that felt intentional, embracing the night and dancer’s experience. 2817035.description: A cinematic fusion of electronic music and immersive visual art This ADE, Dome Concerts opens a new chapter at FABRIQUE DES LUMIERES — one of Amsterdam's most extraordinary cultural venues. Across four days, internationally acclaimed artists transform this monumental space through sound, light and architecture. French producer, composer and multi-instrumentalist THYLACINE has established himself as one of the most distinctive voices in contemporary electronic music. Blending organic instrumentation with rich electronic textures, his work is shaped by a deep curiosity for travel, culture and the places that influence human experience. From recording aboard the Trans-Siberian Railway and exploring the landscapes of the Andes and the Faroe Islands to learning the Turkish bağlama during his travels, Thylacine transforms every journey into music. His acclaimed Roads series reflects an ongoing search for new perspectives, where movement itself becomes an essential part of the creative process. For this special performance at Fabrique des Lumières, Thylacine is joined by internationally acclaimed fractal artist JULIUS HORSTHUIS . Together they create an immersive audiovisual experience where cinematic soundscapes, monumental architecture and evolving visual worlds merge into one extraordinary journey through music, light and space. Dome Concerts is an immersive 360° live audiovisual series taking place throughout ADE at ARTIS Planetarium and Fabrique des Lumières .

2817049.description: Where art, science and electronic music converge. This ADE, Dome Concerts opens a new chapter at FABRIQUE DES LUMIERES — one of Amsterdam's most extraordinary cultural venues. Across four days, internationally acclaimed artists transform this monumental space through sound, light and architecture. Some artists create music. Others create questions. MAX COOPER belongs to the latter. A former computational biologist turned electronic composer and multidisciplinary artist, Max Cooper has spent more than fifteen years exploring the intersection of art, science and technology. Through music and visual art, he reveals the hidden patterns that connect the natural world, human experience and scientific inquiry. His artistic vision has led to collaborations with institutions and innovators including Zaha Hadid Architects, Dolby, 4DSOUND, L-Acoustics and the Barbican Centre , while his audiovisual works have been presented in leading museums around the world. At Fabrique des Lumières , Cooper's monumental audiovisual performance transforms the venue into a living canvas where music, light and architecture converge. Scientific curiosity meets artistic expression in an experience that invites audiences to look beyond what they hear—and discover new ways of seeing. Dome Concerts is an immersive 360° live audiovisual series taking place throughout ADE at ARTIS Planetarium and Fabrique des Lumières .

2817051.description: Sound and image emerge together. This ADE, Dome Concerts opens a new chapter at FABRIQUE DES LUMIERES — one of Amsterdam's most extraordinary cultural venues. Across four days, internationally acclaimed artists transform this monumental space through sound, light and architecture. Some performances follow a fixed sequence. This one begins with a carefully constructed framework: a shared audiovisual system designed to be played, redirected and transformed in real time. Within this framework, COLIN BENDERS shapes rhythm, texture and evolving sequences live through his modular synthesizer, while OTHERNODE composes and performs with real-time image, light, projection and the architecture of the venue. Their practices operate as a shared audiovisual instrument, responding to one another and to the space as the performance unfolds. Neither sound nor image merely accompanies the other. Both actively shape the composition. Presented inside Fabrique des Lumières , the collaboration expands beyond the traditional concert format. Music, light and projection move across the monumental architecture, continuously reshaping the perception of space. The system is prepared, but the performance is not fixed. What unfolds is created in the moment and belongs entirely to those who are present. Dome Concerts is an immersive 360° live audiovisual series taking place throughout ADE at ARTIS Planetarium and Fabrique des Lumières .

2818099.description: EarthSonic, ADE and the NXT Museum present: Premiere: Two Seas and Vinorun Paul Hartnoll (Orbital) with Natural Symphony (installation and panel) Paranoid London (live) , Finnish, Uzbekistani and Bobolian artists (installation and live AV set) Natural Symphony (live performance) In-Depth Discussion: Matt Black (Coldcut), Joey Dean (Natural Symphony), Paul Hartnoll (Orbital), Quinn Whalley (Paranoid London), Ben Sheppee (Observatory), Juliana Aping and Razif Ajip (Bobolian community). EarthSonic is a global project by In Place of War telling the story of climate change through music, working with indigenous communities, musicians, scientists and climate activists worldwide. At NXT Museum, as part of ADE Arts & Culture 2026, EarthSonic presents two new premieres of new music, immersive installations, and a live AV set by Paranoid London, along with an exclusive in-depth discussion. The night starts with Roland's Electronic Petting Zoo, an interactive station built from EarthSonic's field recordings. Vinorun is an immersive installation exploring the traditional ecological knowledge of Sabah's Momogun communities through the rinait chants of the Bobolian community. It is a project by the Malaysian NGO Pertubuhan Kolektif Seni Budaya Sabah in partnership with EarthSonic, The University of Manchester and the British Council. Natural Symphony travelled to Sabah's rainforest to capture plant and star data on the ground, which was combined with the field recordings and footage captured by the rest of the team to provide the source material for new music by Paul Hartnoll (Orbital) , with the finished installation created by visual artist Ben Sheppee (Observatory) and Alastair Lomas. Two Seas tells the story of two bodies of water at opposite ends of the climate crisis: the melting Bothnian Bay in Oulu, Finland, and the vanished Aral Sea in Muynak, Uzbekistan. Music created by Paranoid London with Finnish and Uzbekistani artists, and immersive installations created by Ben She

2818103.description: Fosbury will transform its studio on Kerkstraat into a one-of-a-kind live broadcasting space, inspired by the openness and energy of New York’s The Lot Radio. Our ambition is simple: Create the longest continuous back-to-back DJ performance ever attempted. For more than 100 consecutive hours, all DJ’s in town will take over the booth. But there is one rule: Nobody ever plays alone. Every DJ joins the artist already playing, performs a two-hour back-to-back, and then hands over to the next DJ. Every hour, one artist leaves and another joins, creating an endless chain of collaborations, unexpected combinations, and once-in-a-lifetime musical moments. The entire event will be professionally livestreamed and recorded. With large windows facing Kerkstraat, the studio becomes part of the city during ADE. People walking by can watch the DJs perform from outside, while thousands more tune in from around the world. ∞ B2B isn’t just about breaking records. The entire event raises money for charity. Fans around the world can access the livestream by making a donation, turning every hour of music into real-world impact. Access is only available through charitable donations, making every ticket another contribution to the cause. A Guinness World Records attempt We’re aiming to make ∞ B2B an official Guinness World Records attempt for the longest continuous back-to-back DJ performance ever staged. If successful, ADE won’t just witness an unforgettable livestream. ADE brings together the world’s greatest electronic artists every year. ∞ B2B creates collaborations that would never normally happen. •⁠ ⁠Unexpected B2B combinations. •⁠ ⁠More than 100 hours of continuous music. •⁠ ⁠A global livestream. •⁠ ⁠Incredible content for years to come. •⁠ ⁠Money raised for charity. •⁠ ⁠An official world record attempt. One booth. 100 hours. No solo sets. One endless back-to-back. Where one DJ never stops, because another is always joining.

2819936.description: For the first time, ERRATIC WEATHER is presented in an immersive full-dome environment. Beneath a 360° projection dome, audiences are completely surrounded by sound and visuals, transforming MAOTIK and Maarten Vos' acclaimed audiovisual performance into an entirely new experience. Inspired by the growing impact of climate change, ERRATIC WEATHER translates historical hurricane data into a living audiovisual landscape that unfolds in real time. Before each performance, the system selects a historical hurricane from a database. Scientific data—including geolocation, atmospheric pressure, temperature and wind speed—forms the foundation for a unique composition of sound and visuals. No two performances are ever the same. Each show follows the life cycle of a different storm, allowing audiences to experience the beauty, power and unpredictability of nature through an ever-changing generative artwork. During the performance, swirling hurricanes, typhoons and tropical cyclones evolve across the dome while music and imagery respond continuously to the underlying data. The result is a poetic interpretation of our changing climate—both mesmerizing and thought-provoking. The immersive dome transforms the performance into something entirely new. Instead of watching the storm unfold on a screen, audiences find themselves inside it. The 360° environment amplifies the scale, movement and emotion of the work, creating an experience that can only exist within a dome.
2819936.title: Maarten Vos & Maotik present: Erratic Weather

2821402.description: It would be easy to imagine 4am Kru were born in an instant flash of blinding light. After all, the truest way to experience their music is in the timeless white heat of a manic rave dancefloor, where they deliver their literally sweat-drenched live show. The way they distil the pure energy and spirit of early '90s rave and jungle feels so effortless that it seems driven by instinct alone. In reality, though, the story was anything but instant. Howie and Stu, the core of the Kru, spent years painstakingly experimenting and refining their sound before everything clicked into place and 4am Kru exploded into life. This ADE, they bring that raw energy to our stage!

2823111.description: Inspired by the mystery, freedom and anonymity of underground nightlife. SYNCHRONY invites you into a space where identities fade, expectations disappear, and only the music remains. Inspired by underground nightlife and the freedom club culture, SYNCHRONY is an immersive journey through melodic, techno, progressive and hypnotic sounds. More than a party, it's a space where music takes the lead, identities fade, and connection happens beyond words. 2823125.description: UNHOLY is a celebration of the underground as a space where music, identity and community exist without the need for definition. Inspired by queer club culture and the freedom that has shaped dancefloors for decades, the concept explores the tension between the sacred and the profane, transforming familiar symbols into a contemporary club experience. Rather than relying on a massive impersonal stage, UNHOLY is built around atmosphere and elecreonic music progression in the most intimate way. The night unfolds through hypnotic techno and trance influences, allowing each artist to contribute a different perspective while maintaining a coherent journey from beginning to end. The lineup features Infame, Martin Campos, Zoxta and Giggydeby, Solon alongside additional artists from the Latin American and Spanish underground scenes. Together, they reflect the diversity of a new generation of electronic artists whose work is driven by musical identity rather than genre boundaries. With a limited capacity of approximately 100 guests, UNHOLY embraces the intimate format that has become an essential part of Amsterdam Dance Event. Designed as a close interaction between artists and audience, the focus is on connection, carefully curated programming and the energy that can only exist in a packed room where every person becomes part of the experience.
2823125.lineup_names: GIGGYDEVY · Infame · Martin Campos · Rob-iin · Solon · Zoxta
2823125.title: UNHOLY

2823591.description: The Silk Road was an ancient network of cultural, economic, and spiritual exchange connecting Eastern and Western Eurasia for centuries. The Sonic Silk Road explores how modern dance music has similarly evolved into a living network of cultural connection, translation, and transformation. Presented by global creative movement Interdependence , the event brings together an indepth discussion and artist showcase examining how musical lineages, dance music traditions, and digital technologies flow across borders and are continually reimagined on contemporary dance floors. The conversation will consider themes of authenticity, appropriation, lineage, storytelling, diaspora, and political solidarity. The evening continues on the dancefloor, where a curated lineup of artists working across cultures and musical traditions puts these ideas into practice through their sound. The event takes place at Theatre de Richel , a historic and intimate performance space in central Amsterdam where our diverse Interdependence community will have the opportunity to deepen connections across cultures, scenes, and borders. Doors Open — 18:00 Indepth — 19:00–21:00 Showcase & Social — 21:00–03:00 Lineup TBA

2823993.description: Sapodilla is DARKMATTER Collective ’s signature electronic music event, presenting a listening session inside W139 with local and international artists. Since its launch in 2022, Sapodilla has reimagined club culture as a space where electronic sound, artistic experimentation and community converge, centring marginalised voices and diasporic perspectives. Named after a fruit native to the tropical Americas, with deep roots in Indigenous histories of cultivation and knowledge, Sapodilla takes the fruit as a symbol of movement and cultural transformation. Its journeys across the Caribbean and beyond resonate with DARKMATTER’s engagement with histories shaped by indigeneity, colonialism, slavery, migration and creolisation - and with the cultures and communities that have endured, transformed and flourished through them. Sapodilla at W139 is part of The Nature of Remembering , a group exhibition initiated by artist Lawil Karama in conversation with historian Megan Hoetger , featuring multimedia research projects that move between interrogation of normative memory politics and co-experimentation with environmental and more-than-human bodies. The Nature of Remembering is on show from September 4th until November 1st 2026. Line up to be announced. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at W139 here .
2823993.title: DARKMATTER presents: Sapodilla

2824009.context: BBTCOR presents: A Soft Guide to Chill An immersive sonic journey Live Performances / Exhibitions / Audiovisual & Immersive Arts / Beyond the Dancefloor / Other / Live / Centre / Club Culture / Deep Listening & Spatial Sound W139 · 20:00 - 23:59 W139 + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none
2824009.description: During ADE, LNR and Sarah Saleh translate the research of A Soft Guide to Chill into an immersive sonic journey, revisiting the chill-out room as a space for memory, experimentation, and communal experience. The programme opens with LNR , the DJ alias of El Bickers, a UK-born, Amsterdam-based writer, researcher, and DJ whose practice bridges archival research with the energy of the dance floor. Through deep investigations into underground music histories and 90s rave countercultures, LNR explores the connections between past movements and contemporary electronic landscapes. Their sets draw from decades of musical experimentation, weaving together forgotten sounds, countercultural histories, and the evolving language of the club. A Soft Guide to Chill invites Archetype to perform his new album Nothing New Under The Sun , a critical reflection on how contemporary individual experiences—despite being more connected than ever—are increasingly shaped by feelings of isolation, anxiety, and fragmentation. The evening also features a live performance by Gizem Öz , an Amsterdam-based composer, sound artist, and contemporary artist working at the intersections of club and gallery, ritual and technology, emotion and abstraction. The evening closes with Sarah Saleh , an interdisciplinary artist, DJ, and co-founder of BBTCOR , whose sonic practice explores the emotional and spatial qualities of electronic music. Through her research into the 1990s chill-out room, she brings together ambient, dub, downtempo, and psychedelic influences to create spaces for collective listening, reflection, and connection. BBTCOR's A Soft Guide To Chill is a 3-week residency at W139's Para-siting. The event series will highlight the launch of BBTCOR’s website that disseminates knowledge around the history of 90s chill out rooms. 2824307.description: Founded in Amsterdam in 2020, Nomadism Records is an independent electronic music label built around the idea that a nomadic spirit is constantly searching for places where joy, creativity, and human connection thrive. Today, the label brings together more than 60 artists from around the world. In 2025, our ADE event at Cártel Amsterdam was selected by Het Parool among the 12 best free ADE parties in Amsterdam, highlighting our commitment to creating unique and accessible cultural experiences. For ADE 2026, Nomadism Records returns to Cártel Amsterdam Coffee & Cocktails for two free community-driven events taking place on Saturday and Sunday during ADE weekend. The concept combines electronic music, gastronomy, and social connection in an intimate and welcoming environment. Throughout both days, DJs from the Nomadism Records roster will perform carefully curated sets, showcasing artists from our international community while creating a vibrant atmosphere for ADE visitors and local residents alike. This year, the experience will be enhanced by a special guest chef presenting a unique fusion menu inspired by Turkish and Mexican cuisine. The culinary offering will complement the music program, encouraging guests to discover new sounds, flavors, and connections in a relaxed setting. Guests will have the opportunity to discover emerging international artists, connect with Amsterdam's creative community, enjoy Cártel's distinctive atmosphere, and experience ADE beyond the traditional club environment. The events are designed as free and accessible gatherings that celebrate diversity, creativity, music, food, and local culture. By bringing together music lovers, artists, food enthusiasts, local residents, and ADE visitors, Nomadism Records and Cártel Amsterdam aim to create meaningful connections and showcase the international and inclusive spirit of Amsterdam.
2824307.lineup_names: Efecan Yesugay · Hoani Teano · Kamara · Plab On

Emerging from Amsterdam’s underground scene, Onda creates spaces where different people, bodies, and rhythms can come together. The name Onda means “wave” in Portuguese: a movement that carries energy forward, transforms, and keeps moving. 2824606.description: From Madrid to Amsterdam — Beatfreak Recordings joins UNDRGRND for Amsterdam Dance Event 2026. Founded in 1997 by Spanish electronic music pioneer D-Formation, Beatfreak has spent nearly three decades shaping its own corner of the underground. Moving through progressive house, melodic house and techno, indie dance and deeper electronic territories, the label has built an international reputation for music that balances emotion, groove and dancefloor energy. Its catalogue has featured artists including D-Formation, Quivver, Nick Muir, Betoko, Citizen Kain, Dmitry Molosh, Marc DePulse, Oscar L, Stan Kolev, Teenage Mutants, Hannes Bieger and many more. In 2026, Beatfreak continues to push forward with releases such as Darksidevinyl’s hypnotic Afro-melodic cut “Mwanga,” including a driving D-Formation remix; the atmospheric “Ocean EP” from GRAZZE and Andrew Sar; and the latest edition of its respected compilation series, “Elements 11.” This October, the Beatfreak sound lands in Amsterdam as two underground families come together during the city’s biggest week for electronic music. 2824630.description: The final dance of ADE 2026 belongs to the underground. On Sunday, October 25, Endless Records returns to Amsterdam to join forces with UNDRGRND for the official closing chapter of our Amsterdam Dance Event journey. Born from the Italian underground, Endless is more than a record label. It is an international platform dedicated to electronic music, emerging artists, live performance and the culture that connects people beyond borders. Its identity is built around immersive sound, strong visual aesthetics and a genuine passion for the dancefloor. For this special closing night, we move through different shades of electronic music—from hypnotic grooves and melodic storytelling to acid-driven, peak-time techno. The journey begins with Cambric and UNDRGRND founder Alex Sharp sharing the booth, before Udolph and Juliet Fox take control. Multi-instrumentalist Giorgia Angiuli then brings her unmistakable live performance to the dancefloor, followed by the uncompromising acid-techno energy of Marie Vaunt . Endless artist Lino Fuso closes the night with a final live set, taking us through the last moments of ADE 2026. Giorgia Angiuli is known for combining electronic production with vocals and live instrumentation, while Marie Vaunt has built her sound around powerful peak-time and acid techno. 2824747.description: BEFORE × EKANITE ADE FRIDAY 18:00 to 22:00 · OCTOBER 23 Everyone talks about the afters. Nobody manages the BEFORE. This year, that idea crosses BORDERS for the first time. BEFORE makes its debut at Amsterdam Dance Event alongside EKANITE at UNDRGRND, opening the first international chapter. But BEFORE started in Madrid with one simple idea… It was born at Lula Club, one of Madrid’s key venues in the electronic scene. To give the spotlight to the moment where great nights actually begin. Because nights don’t just happen. They’re built. And every great night starts long BEFORE the dancefloor fills up. BEFORE doesn’t belong to one genre, one venue, or one format. It belongs to that moment we ALL share before going out. When you meet up with friends, the music starts, and the night can still go ANYWHERE. Because there’s always a BEFORE. That’s why EVERY edition is different. House, melodic, techno, or whatever sound fits the identity of the space and the collaboration. BEFORE evolves with every project without losing its core: creating the best possible start to a great night. Along the way, BEFORE has teamed up with some of Madrid’s most iconic venues, like Lula Club and LAB the Club, proof that one philosophy can adapt to different concepts, crowds, and musical worlds. BEFORE’s visual identity is built together with Telepixel, a creative agency specialized in art direction, branding, and audiovisual experiences for the electronic music industry. Their creative vision has been key in shaping BEFORE’s universe, giving every edition its own identity while staying true to the brand’s evolution. Today BEFORE keeps growing. New spaces. New collaborations. New stories. Same essence. For everyone who wants to dance. Because we don’t just throw a before party. We actually run THE BEFORE. Because BEFORE. There was us. 2825396.description: Conceived by DJ and producer JHONATAN OSPINA in partnership with House Mag magazine, Confluence is the official opening event of the Amsterdam Dance Event 2026, featuring a musical program that moves between an energetic dialogue of house and techno and the celebration of distinct global clubbing scenes. The event evokes the literal meaning of "confluence," drawing attention to the convergence of different geographical flows—from Colombia and Brazil to the United States and Europe—into a single space. On the other hand, the concept expands, "The city is connected by canals. The scene is connected by culture," adopted as a foundation to connect diverse personal trajectories and artistic roots. Throughout the entire night, there is a commitment to immersive and underground experiences: engaging high-technology lighting systems that sync with the beats in real-time, and exploring the venue's potent acoustic structure. Collectively, the curation asks: how can an environment traditionally connected to Amsterdam's club culture serve as a territory for the encounter of different identities and sonic landscapes? LINE-UP (AZ): Alex Sharp Artistikk Carola Ella de Vuono Jhonatan Ospina Leo Janeiro Nadezda Scumdog Club John Doe, located on Rembrandtplein, opens its doors for Confluence on October 21.

2825520.description: Inspired by the Godfather of House, Frankie Knuckles , his legendary NYC Sound Factory Bar residency and his timeless remix of “The Pressure” by Sounds of Blackness, this movement has blossomed into a powerful night devoted to the Black roots of house, soulful house, and techno. These are the underground sounds that not only shaped global club culture but continue to ignite and unify dance floors across the world. The Sounds of Blackness (SOB) is more than an event, it is a musical manifesto. It honors the profound legacy of Black artistry in dance music while spotlighting the next generation of boundary-pushing talent. With a lineup of pioneering/trailblazing and up and coming American, European, and African DJs, each artist carries forward the spirit of freedom, resistance, and unity that birthed house and techno, ensuring its story continues to evolve and inspire. The visionaries behind SOB bring decades of dedication and artistry to this mission. EPM Productions (Elliott Matos & Benjamin Aillery), Curtis Atchison (SoundGroove & Midnight Society), Hugo Hutchinson (HUGO H.), and Manny Ward are the creative force powering this experience. Elliott, Curtis, Hugo H., and Manny, each gifted Black artist, have long championed liberation and self-expression throughout the U.S. Together, with Benjamin’s partnership, they have aligned their talents and passion to create a movement: The Sounds of Blackness.
2825520.lineup_names: DJ Hugo H. · Elliott Matos · Manny Ward · Midnight Society · Nita Funk · ReginalDJohnson · Retrotech · Sweet Georgie · Wayne Williams

2825982.context: The Nature of Remembering Group exhibition initiated by Lawil Karama, in conversation with Megan Hoetger Exhibitions / Beyond the Dancefloor / Other / Centre W139 · 12:00 - 18:00 W139 + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.403
2825982.description: Initiated by artist Lawil Karama in conversation with historian Megan Hoetger , The Nature of Remembering is a group exhibition featuring multimedia research projects that move between interrogation of normative memory politics and co-experimentation with environmental and more-than-human bodies. The exhibition title carries in it two meanings: on the one hand, nature is evoked, drawing focus to actants, actors, and animacies beyond and beside the human, who witness, participate in, index, recollect, foretell, and haunt historical time. On the other hand, the idiomatic expression "the nature of" is taken up as a provocation, pushing against pervasive ideological and violently enforced notions of remembering and of commemorating. Running through all projects is a commitment to practices of frictioning: engaging technologies against their colonial grain, and lingering in the affectively, ancestrally, archivally, and forensically intertwined conditions of lived experience and knowledge production. Collectively, the works ask: Who, or what, enframes and enlivens acts of remembering violence, which have been rendered invisible, unspeakable, and unthinkable? The exhibition features work by Samuel Baidoo, Michèle Boulogne, Laura Fong Prosper and Tin Wilke, Lawil Karama, Aram Lee, Komtouch Napattaloong, Bart Seng Wen Long, and Kaisa Saarinen. W139 is open Wednesday to Sunday, from 12:00 until 18:00. Entry €5-, Students €3-. Tickets at the door. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at W139 here .

2826451.description: One monumental art installation. Two weeks on view. Four extraordinary concerts. Celebrate ADE’s 30th anniversary with EINDER by Boris Acket . On 21 October , monumental music, art and architecture come together to celebrate 30 years of ADE. The Concertgebouworkest will perform Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony with 70 musicians inside Amsterdam’s monumental Centrale Markthal. Enjoy this true classic from 1808 conducted by Riccardo Minasi , beneath the largest-ever version of Boris Acket’s EINDER. The rhythmic motif of Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony is repeated constantly, taking on ever-changing forms, and in this way Beethoven builds his symphony layer by layer. While EINDER will shift and reshape above the orchestra creating a dance that is never the same twice. Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony was revolutionary 200 years ago, and it still is today. This energetic music never ceases to surprise. About EINDER EINDER is an artificial sky in constant motion. A vast expanse of ultralight fabric floating above the space, animated by hundreds of electronically controlled fans. The system is precisely programmed, yet what happens overhead can never be entirely controlled. Air currents collide, gravity pulls and turbulence interrupts, turning every movement into something new. At times, EINDER resembles a rolling sea. At others, a passing cloud or the beginnings of a storm. It moves somewhere between choreography and weather. Always changing. Never performing the same way twice. This is a production by artist Boris Acket and Making Waves. Acket has previously collaborated with institutions and artists including the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, the Van Gogh Museum, Lowlands and Fred again. The production is realised by Goonie Crew. EINDER brings together movement, space, sound, material and light in an installation that invites people not only to observe, but to experience. 2827744.description: One monumental art installation. Two weeks on view. Three extraordinary concerts. Celebrate ADE’s 30th anniversary with EINDER by Boris Acket. On 22 October , EINDER will set the scene for a live performance by Elias Mazian and his band . Be aware that this is a seated event. For the first time in two years, Elias Mazian returns to the stage with his live band. The DJ, producer and singer songwriter marks a special one-off performance at the Centrale Markthal during Amsterdam Dance Event, staged within EINDER, the kinetic light and fabric installation longtime friend Boris Acket created, inspired by Mazian’s debut album ‘ Vrij Van Dromen’. Mazian and Acket premierd Einder together at Het HEM, translating Mazian’s warm, melancholic songs into a living canvas of light and movement. Five years on, Mazian assembles his live band once more to bring that music back to life, for one night only. About EINDER: EINDER is an artificial sky in constant motion. A vast expanse of ultralight fabric floating above the space, animated by hundreds of electronically controlled fans. The system is precisely programmed, yet what happens overhead can never be entirely controlled. Air currents collide, gravity pulls and turbulence interrupts, turning every movement into something new. At times, EINDER resembles a rolling sea. At others, a passing cloud or the beginnings of a storm. It moves somewhere between choreography and weather. Always changing. Never performing the same way twice. This is a production by artist Boris Acket and Making Waves. Acket has previously collaborated with institutions and artists including the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, the Van Gogh Museum, Lowlands and Fred again. The production is realised by Goonie Crew. EINDER brings together movement, space, sound, material and light in an installation that invites people not only to observe, but to experience. Pre-registration has now closed. Regular tickets will go on sale via our website on August 27. Explore more AD
2827744.title: Elias Mazian (live) x EINDER by Boris Acket

2827772.description: THE OFFICIAL WE ARE LOST AFTERPARTY When the final track fades at We Are Lost, the night quickly continues just five minutes away for the official afterparty, Mariano Mellino brings Audioholics to Pacific in Westerpark, joined by a carefully selected group of guest DJs. For this special occasion we have invited Sasha, Henry Saiz and Folgar to join Mariano Mellino. The intimate Pacific has never bounced like this before 😉 Born in Buenos Aires, Mariano Mellino began his journey behind the decks at the age of nineteen, inspired by the progressive foundations laid by artists such as Hernan Cattaneo, Sasha, John Digweed and Nick Warren. Since then, he has developed a sound unmistakably his own: deep, driving and melodic. Mariano represents Argentina’s next major international DJ, an artist increasingly stepping onto the world stage while remaining closely connected to the musical culture that shaped him. Audioholics is the natural extension of that vision. What began as Mariano’s radio show has grown into an international event concept and record label, bringing together artists and listeners who follow progressive music. During ADE, that philosophy finds its setting in Amsterdam. Pacific sits in the heart of Westerpark’s Westergas cultural district. By day, it is an all-day meeting place for food, drinks and culture; after dark, its industrial interior transforms naturally into an intimate club environment. Located only a five-minute walk from We Are Lost, it gives us the opportunity to continue the night.

2827839.description: A full-body haptic and low-frequency music experience at The Stargate, bringing sound beyond the ears and into the body. Using cutting edge haptic mats, a group of participants will experience music through deep low-frequency vibrations and tactile sound, creating a physical dimension to listening. 2828289.context: The Nature of Remembering Group exhibition initiated by Lawil Karama, in conversation with Megan Hoetger Exhibitions / Beyond the Dancefloor / Other / Centre W139 · 12:00 - 18:00 W139 + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.403
2828289.description: Initiated by artist Lawil Karama in conversation with historian Megan Hoetger , The Nature of Remembering is a group exhibition featuring multimedia research projects that move between interrogation of normative memory politics and co-experimentation with environmental and more-than-human bodies. The exhibition title carries in it two meanings: on the one hand, nature is evoked, drawing focus to actants, actors, and animacies beyond and beside the human, who witness, participate in, index, recollect, foretell, and haunt historical time. On the other hand, the idiomatic expression "the nature of" is taken up as a provocation, pushing against pervasive ideological and violently enforced notions of remembering and of commemorating. Running through all projects is a commitment to practices of frictioning: engaging technologies against their colonial grain, and lingering in the affectively, ancestrally, archivally, and forensically intertwined conditions of lived experience and knowledge production. Collectively, the works ask: Who, or what, enframes and enlivens acts of remembering violence, which have been rendered invisible, unspeakable, and unthinkable? The exhibition features work by Samuel Baidoo, Michèle Boulogne, Laura Fong Prosper and Tin Wilke, Lawil Karama, Aram Lee, Komtouch Napattaloong, Bart Seng Wen Long, and Kaisa Saarinen. W139 is open Wednesday to Sunday, from 12:00 until 18:00. Entry €5-, Students €3-. Tickets at the door. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at W139 here .

2828756.description: EarthSonic, Roland, TestTafel and DJs for Climate Action present: The Future Sound of Nature & Community Kitchen An intimate Saturday evening in a glasshouse on the Amsterdam waterfront, where world-class electronic artists make music with nature, live. Birdsong, whale calls, melting ice and forest soundscapes become instruments, collaborators and co-composers. This year a Community Kitchen joins the bill, extending TestTafel's 100% plant-based table into the heart of the gathering with composer and transmedia electronic artist Gadi Sasson opening the evening with an interactive station with 27 fruit and veg and a SPOKE board hooked up to a Bela board and a pair of speakers, where touching the fruit and veg generates a melody. In the middle of the world's biggest electronic music week, we slow the tempo: a free evening that asks what interspecies collaboration sounds like, and shows the industry a different way to gather. Woven between the performances, a series of talks and panels opens up the ideas behind the music, with artists including Portrait XO, Drum and Lace, and Joey Dean. The night ends with a communal jam session, artists joining together on stage for one final live improvisation before the doors close. Line-up: Paranoid London, Eli 'Soul Clap' Goldstein (Soul Clap / FSON / DJs4CA), Matt Black (Coldcut / Ninja Tune), Portrait XO (voice, AI & sound), Drum and Lace (Sofia degli Alessandri), Natural Symphony (live nature collaboration), Museum of Consciousness, plus more tba. Free entry for all. Reserve your spot through the RSVP link. Supported by Roland, providing PA and performance equipment, with a guest artist from the Roland family joining the bill. They will also be hosting their Electronic Petting Zoo, an interactive station built from EarthSonic's field recordings. 2828960.description: Between 22-25 October, you can walk beneath the art installation EINDER by Boris Acket and experience it up close as it continuously transforms, flowing to the rhythm of day and night. Ready to step into the art and leave time behind? During the EINDER exhibition, you decide how your experience unfolds and how long it lasts. Walk, sit, stand still, and watch EINDER continuously transform to the rhythm of day and night. Always moving. Never the same twice. All we need to know is when you’ll arrive. From that moment on, the space is yours. Special time-slots with performances of Kianí del Valle On Friday 23 and Saturday 24 October at 9PM, Kianí del Valle takes over with a unique performance, reshaping the installation’s movements through her dynamic choreography. Every moment of the day has its own unique effect on EINDER. It’s up to you to choose your favourite time slot(s) As the sun rises and sets, shining its light through the sky panels onto the installation. Enjoy the soft morning light, the brightness of day, the shifting colours of sunset, or the dark skies at night. You decide how you experience EINDER. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Centrale Markthal here .
2828960.title: EINDER by Boris Acket

2829148.description: Rooted in Culture returns to Stadsschouwburg Amsterdam (ITA) for it's fifth anniversary edition. This year's programme explores the journey of house music to Europe and the crucial role the UK played as its first European home. How did house find its roots in British street culture, sound system traditions and northern soul? And what did the UK bring back to the global sound? The evening features a dance workshop by an international guest from the UK house dance scene, an indepth session by resident cultural critic and DJ Lynnée Denise, and a closing jam session by DJ collective Chill on Tuesday. 2829248.description: Live Coding Sessions and Doka Culture present an Algorave during Amsterdam Dance Event 2026. As the city welcomes the global electronic music community, we’re excited to celebrate the live coding scene alongside it. An Algorave (a combination of algorithm and rave) is a club night where music and visuals are created by writing code in real time. Rather than performing pre-recorded tracks, artists improvise throughout the night while their code is projected for the audience to follow, making the creative process part of the performance. We're thrilled to welcome a fantastic line-up of artists, with first-time Live Coding Sessions guests Hellocatfood, MYNA, Sol Sarratea, Deaxmachina and Den Ree, alongside returning favourites Jobi, Joyce den Hertog and Lil Bleep. We'll introduce each of them over the coming weeks. Live Coding Sessions is initiated and organised by Saskia Freeke, Klasien van de Zandschulp and Sabrina Verhage. This event is a collaboration between Doka Culture and Live Coding Sessions. Live Coding Sessions is kindly supported by Amsterdam Fund for the Arts (AFK)

2829367.context: Dreams of Films – Films of Dreams An exhibition by Disco Arabesquo about the visual world of Egyptian cinema Exhibitions / Beyond the Dancefloor / Other / New West / New Arts & Culture Venues Van Eesteren Museum · 12:00 - 17:00 Van Eesteren Museum + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none" xmlns
2829367.description: 99 years ago, Layla was filmed; the first Egyptian feature film. This marked the beginning of a film culture that became one of the shared languages ​​of the Arab world for decades. This exhibition, Dreams of Films – Films of Dreams, by Van Eesteren Museum and Moataz Rageb , brings back the visual world of cinema from that era. Here, you will discover original cinema posters, hand-painted billboards, and illustrated posters created by illustrators, calligraphers, and printers who are rarely known by name. In addition to images, sound and music also take center stage. Film music has always been inextricably linked to Egyptian cinema, and famous compositions were revived through another medium: on cassette tapes. Here, you will discover rare cassette tapes, film posters, and other material from the collection of Moataz Rageb, better known as Disco Arabesquo . He is an Amsterdam-based DJ, sociologist, and collector of Arabic vinyl, cassettes, and memorabilia. In this exhibition, you will experience how film music—after being shown on the silver screen—took on a life of its own, on the streets and in living rooms. Rageb, who put the Egyptian disco and cassette culture of the 70s and 80s on the international map, offers a perspective on sound that belongs to the visual language of the posters just as much as it does to the films themselves. From cinema facade to cassette deck: this exhibition at ADE shows that a dream is never carried alone. Image and sound have always traveled together and—thanks to collectors like Rageb—still do. Open Thursday to Sunday, 12.00-17.00 Entrance €5-, free with Museumkaart

2829567.description: Founded in Amsterdam in 2020, Nomadism Records is an independent electronic music label built around the idea that a nomadic spirit is constantly searching for places where joy, creativity and human connection thrive. Today, the label brings together more than 60 artists from around the world. For ADE 2026, Nomadism Records joins forces with Pastai Restaurant to present Spaghetti a Mezzanotte a late night celebration where Italian hospitality, electronic music and community come together. Set inside one of Amsterdam's favourite Italian restaurants, the evening unfolds through carefully curated electronic music by Plab On and Hoani Teano, accompanied by fresh handmade pasta, good company and the warm atmosphere of an authentic Italian dinner that slowly turns into a dance floor. At midnight, complimentary spaghetti will be served to all guests. A simple Italian tradition that brings everyone together for a shared moment, celebrating food, music and connection around one table. More than an event, Spaghetti a Mezzanotte is an invitation to slow down, meet new people and experience ADE beyond the traditional club environment. Expect intimate vibes, Mediterranean flavours, underground electronic music and a night where music, food and community become one.
2829567.title: Spaghetti a Mezzanotte
