2830350.description: 24H MUSIC MARATHON KERIKO closes Amsterdam Dance Event with an ambitious 24-hour music marathon in the heart of Amsterdam. From 07:00 on Sunday, October 25th until 07:00 on Monday, October 26th, Meet Berlage becomes the meeting point for a continuous journey through Latin House, Latin Tech, Afro Latin, Tribal and underground House music. For this special ADE edition, KERIKO joins forces with a diverse network of collectives, labels and artists from Portugal (GOTCHA), Spain (HOMIES BOOKING), Puerto Rico (SANTURCE RECORDINGS), Albania (HOJZA) and the Netherlands (VOYA & PRIVILEGE), bringing different scenes, cultures and musical identities together under one roof for 24 hours of non-stop music. More than a traditional closing party, the event is built around collaboration, community and musical exchange. From the energy of the morning through the afternoon, sunset and night, all the way to the final early-morning hours, each part of the marathon brings a new atmosphere and a different selection of artists behind the booth. 24 hours. One venue. One dance floor. One final ADE journey. ABOUT US Amsterdam-based electronic music label and event concept built around the energy, rhythm and culture of Latin House. Blending Latin House, Latin Tech, Afro Latin, Tribal and groove-driven House music, KERIKO creates a meeting point between Latin influences and Amsterdam’s international electronic music scene. KERIKO’s identity is energetic, inclusive and rhythm-driven, combining percussion, vocals and Latin influences with the sound and attitude of contemporary underground House music. More than a music brand, KERIKO is focused on building a community around dance, connection and shared experiences. Through its events, collaborations and artist network, the label brings together emerging and established talent while creating opportunities for different collectives and cultures to connect through music. Latin roots. House culture. One community.

2831662.description: Where many bands revolve around a single voice or lead instrument, RADIOHOP builds a truly collective sound. Every member plays an equal role and the music moves as one organism, driven by feeling and atmosphere rather than ego or the spotlight. The instrumental quartet from Amsterdam, made up of Joshua Lutz, Euan Jenkins, Johnny Biner and Joel Svedberg, shapes its compositions through experimentation, intuitive collaboration and deep listening, weaving jazz, hip hop and groove into compelling soundscapes. Following their debut album All We Do came a remix EP and the beat-focused album Hard To Handle, and the band has recorded a second full-length that digs even deeper into that raw, collaborative energy. Tenor saxophonist Tomoki Sanders moves effortlessly between two worlds: the New York lineage of spiritual, adventurous jazz and today's beat and hip hop scene. From their New York base they share the stage with greats such as Pharoah Sanders, Ravi Coltrane and the Jack DeJohnette Trio, while also working with innovators like Kassa Overall, Taylor McFerrin and Mark de Clive-Lowe. With roots in both New York and Japan, Sanders draws these different languages into a raw, searching sound of their own. The result is music as at home in a club night as in the concert hall. In collaboration with Amsterdam Dance Event and in partnership with Steppin', we turn our hall into a club for one night. The seats come out, the room goes standing and the dance floor opens. 19:30 Café Steppin': Lucas Benjamin & Kay Tee dj 20:30 RADIOHOP 21:30 Tomoki Sanders After the show, café: afterparty Steppin' Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Bimhuis here .

2831666.description: Brass Rave Unit literally blows away the DJ booth and ignites raves everywhere, no matter the time or place. Originally an acoustic trio with saxophones and drums, they developed into a fully-formed electronic festival act with the help of smart effects and synthesizers. But still, these are three musicians with lungs of steel and the energy to match, who cross borders and defy genre expectations. Next spring will see the release of Liquid Era, the third album by Brass Rave Unit. The band gave scintillating shows at festivals such as Glastonbury and Best Kept Secret, but also on the Paradiso main stage. Band members Ko, Bo and Dirk, who come from the Amsterdam underground, take inspiration from everything from acid house to trance and techno, which they transform into organic beats that set everything into motion. Amsterdam-based keyboardist and producer MANOLO opens the evening with a combination of funk, jazz, and Caribbean rhythms. On his second EP, Nùmber Dos, he explores his cultural background through layered percussion, catchy bass lines, and danceable melodies, inspired by his frequent visits to the Berlin nightlife. 2832493.description: On the Thursday of ADE, the multi-talented artist presents a special A/V performance at Paradiso for the first time, titled Umzimba. Zimbabwe-born and Amsterdam-based DJ and producer State OFFF is rapidly emerging as a standout name in the international club scene. He blends influences from around the world, including São Paulo’s baile funk, Baltimore club, London bass, and Durban’s gqom , an energetic South African dance style known for its raw, syncopated rhythms. Fans know him for his productions, including his debut EP GQOM TODAY (2022), as well as performances at venues and festivals such as Parallel, Lente Kabinet Festival, Nyege Nyege, and Liquid Room in Edinburgh. During ADE, he presents his new A/V performance Umzimba. In this work, heavy percussion from live hardware sequencers interacts with a language model that translates sound into visuals. The piece explores a kind of “phantom experience” of a body under strain: sweat, fatigue, and exhaustion, even though no physical body is present. The result is a dialogue between analogue rhythm and digital intelligence, where sound becomes image and rhythm transforms into fragmented, poetic language.
2832493.title: State OFFF

2833983.description: After worldwide sold out nights in Amsterdam, Germany, Ibiza, Armenia, Dubai, Oslo and right after our Canada and Australia tour, bringing our show back to Amsterdam with a night like this during Amsterdam Dance Event honestly feels like a dream come true for us. As Persian artists who came to the Netherlands years ago, it means a lot to be able to create a concept like this inside one of Amsterdam’s most iconic venues and showcase a side of Persian culture and music that the world rarely gets to experience this way. KALUT is where Persian emotion, culture, and sound meet electronic music. KALUT is not a traditional Persian music event. At its core, this is a house music experience inspired by Persian sounds, emotion, atmosphere, and storytelling, designed for everyone, no matter where you come from. Inspired by the Lut Desert (home to the hottest place on earth), KALUT represents a feeling that is difficult to explain but impossible to forget. Expect a lineup of internationally recognized artists, immersive production, deep electronic sounds with Persian influences, and a crowd brought together by music, emotion, and energy. This is a night built from our story, our vision, and our love for electronic music, shared with the world through one unforgettable experience.

2835258.description: Breathwork meets the dancefloor. Liv Stig guides a 90-minute Conscious connected breath journey while Mirella Kroes creates a live electronic soundtrack - bringing breath, beats, movement and deep listening together inside The Stargate. Breathwork guide Liv Stig leads a powerful Conscious Connected Breathing session, while DJ Mirella Kroes creates a live sonic landscape alongside her; bringing the energy, rhythm and atmosphere of the club into a deeply embodied experience. With more than 15 years behind the decks, Mirella is known for her deep, hypnotic and cerebral approach to techno, exploring trippier and more transcendental territories through carefully crafted, organic builds. A longtime presence in Amsterdam and the Dutch and European club scene, she has played venues and festivals including Doornroosje, Trouw, De School, Bassiani, Lowlands and Awakenings. Liv Stig is a Breathwork guide with roots in Amsterdam's nightlife and creative culture, bringing together breath, embodiment and the energy of the club in a grounded yet expansive practice. Expect 90 minutes of breath, beats, movement and release, moving between activation and surrender, intensity and stillness. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at The Stargate here .

2835282.description: What if you could listen with your whole body? During ADE, The Stargate invites you into SUSPENDED : an immersive sound experience centred around Parker Hertzberger 's vibrating Music Hammocks , where sound becomes physical and the body becomes part of the listening experience. Parker Hertzberger's work explores the physical and spatial dimensions of sound. His vibrating hammocks translate music into tactile vibration, allowing you to experience frequencies through your entire body rather than through the ears alone. Alongside standalone sessions where you can drop in, lie back and experience the hammocks, SUSPENDED will feature a series of live performances by artists working directly with the technology; creating music that can be heard, felt and experienced physically in real time. A different kind of listening experience for ADE: less about standing in front of the sound, and more about being inside it. Drop-in experiences + immersive live performances Full programme to be announced Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at The Stargate here .

2835295.description: VOYA Experiences is an Amsterdam based artist development and music platform rooted in electronic music, creativity and meaningful connection. We create carefully curated experiences where emerging talent meets the international music industry and every artist has the opportunity to be seen, heard and remembered. Our ADE showcase transforms an intimate bookstore in the heart of Amsterdam into a unique cultural meeting place for artists, producers, industry professionals and genuine music lovers. Across three days, visitors will experience story driven DJ performances, quality sound and a natural journey through different electronic genres, all within a warm and welcoming atmosphere. At the heart of VOYA Experiences is our belief that music should create more than a moment. It should build relationships, open doors and turn artistic imagination into real achievement. ADE does not need more noise. It needs more meaning. VOYA Experiences The Guidance between imagination and achievement.

2836086.description: Every Amsterdam Dance Event has its final chapter. This year, ours unfolds aboard the legendary Veronica Ship. On Sunday 25th of October, ORIGINS On Tour x Deep Echoes take over one of Amsterdam's most iconic cultural landmarks for a 10-hour melodic cruise. ALL HANDS ON DECK is an intimate gathering of people who want to close out ADE through great music, offline connection and a setting unlike any other. This collaboration brings together the musical identity of ORIGINS On Tour and Deep Echoes, two concepts connected by a shared love for musical storytelling. ORIGINS On Tour is built around tension, release and emotion, whereas Deep Echoes is driven by exploration and surprise, blending the familiar with the unknown. 2836442.description: THE ROOM IS THE LINE-UP Two days at ADE. 2836745.description: Thomas Azier x raam art space: Live Showcase - First Time Slot After three years of relative silence, Thomas Azier returns with PANORAMA, an expansive and deeply personal musical project, marking a new chapter in his artistic trajectory. Intimate but bold, the project unfolds across sound and visual language. With his performance at raam art space Thomas Azier will introduce this new work. Poems, field recordings, video works and performative elements disrupt the traditional concert structure, giving it a fractured, collage-like character. Azier’s new music carries his strong melodic sensibility further merging string arrangements and experimental practices into a series of intriguing pieces. The voice becomes an interpretative tool, shifting between male and female, human and animal, mythical and real. Songs are juxtaposed with intermissions and character changes that shift rhythm and mood, like switching channels or scrolling through an endless feed. Thomas Azier is a dutch composer, producer, singer and performer. He has released 6 albums over the past 12 years, consistently shaping the contours of his unique take on pop music. raam art space was opened by Gallery Vriend van Bavink. It offers an open view into an evolving program of exhibitions and ideas that engage directly with the city. Upcoming exhibition: "Forest of the City" by Anouk Griffioen (from Oct 2 - Nov 22 2026). 2837247.description: Inspired by the Godfather of House, Frankie Knuckles , his legendary NYC Sound Factory Bar residency and his timeless remix of “The Pressure” by Sounds of Blackness, this movement has blossomed into a powerful night devoted to the Black roots of house, soulful house, and techno. These are the underground sounds that not only shaped global club culture but continue to ignite and unify dance floors across the world. The Sounds of Blackness (SOB) is more than an event, it is a musical manifesto. It honors the profound legacy of Black artistry in dance music while spotlighting the next generation of boundary-pushing talent. With a lineup of pioneering/trailblazing and up and coming American, European, and African DJs, each artist carries forward the spirit of freedom, resistance, and unity that birthed house and techno, ensuring its story continues to evolve and inspire. The visionaries behind SOB bring decades of dedication and artistry to this mission. EPM Productions (Elliott Matos & Benjamin Aillery), Curtis Atchison (SoundGroove & Midnight Society), Hugo Hutchinson (HUGO H.), and Manny Ward are the creative force powering this experience. Elliott, Curtis, Hugo H., and Manny, each gifted Black artist, have long championed liberation and self-expression throughout the U.S. Together, with Benjamin’s partnership, they have aligned their talents and passion to create a movement: The Sounds of Blackness .
2837247.lineup_names: Gifted DJ · ManMachine · Retrotech · The Love Team

2838264.description: GDE Presents: SANCTUARY is an inclusive house music experience designed as a safe harbor where people can come exactly as they are without judgment, discrimination, or barriers to belonging. Presented during the Amsterdam Dance Event, the world's most influential gathering for electronic music, GDE Presents: SANCTUARY brings pioneering DJs, international artists, and diverse communities together through the universal language of house music. SANCTUARY is more than an ADE club night. It is a social impact platform using music as a vehicle for connection, inclusion, cultural exchange, and emotional wellbeing. Music + inclusion + community + cultural exchange + emotional safety creates an experience where the dance floor becomes a place for meaningful human connection. To understand how house music shaped dance culture, we have to understand the communities that created it. In the late 1970s and early 1980s, the United States entered the HIV/AIDS crisis. On June 5, 1981, the CDC reported the first five cases of what would become known as AIDS. Government inaction, misinformation, stigma, and discrimination allowed the epidemic to devastate communities particularly Black, Latino, queer, and poor communities. During this time, clubs like The Loft, The Warehouse, Paradise Garage, and The ClubHouse became more than places to dance. They became SANCTUARIES. Frankie Knuckles once described The Warehouse as a church for people who had fallen from grace. And for many queer people, the dance floor offered something the outside world often denied them: freedom, connection, and joy. These clubs also became places of care and activism. In Washington, D.C., The ClubHouse supported Black queer people living with HIV/AIDS, providing practical assistance such as food and transportation to medical appointments. In New York, the ballroom community was devastated by AIDS but responded by organizing around awareness, testing, prevention, and mutual aid. And in April 1982, Paradise Garage

2838355.description: Thomas Azier x raam art space: Live Showcase - Second Time Slot After three years of relative silence, Thomas Azier returns with PANORAMA, an expansive and deeply personal musical project. Intimate in origin yet cinematic in scope, PANORAMA is a humanist portrait of life on the brink, where illness, desire, fear and hope coexist and quietly shape one another. In this showcase at raam art space , Azier presents new work in which music and image rarely overlap but instead relay one another in an ever-shifting dialogue. Poems, field recordings, video works and performative elements disrupt the traditional concert structure, giving it a fractured, collage-like character, until a quiet logic emerges. RSVP only. Thomas Azier is a Dutch composer, producer, singer and performer. Over the course of the last 12 years, he has released 6 albums, consistently shaping the contours of his unique take on pop music. As a writer and producer, he has collaborated with artists such as Stromae, Faber and IJSLAND, among others. raam art space was opened by Gallery Vriend van Bavink. It offers an open view into an evolving program of exhibitions and ideas that engage directly with the city. Upcoming exhibition: "Forest of the City" by Anouk Griffioen (from Oct 2 - Nov 22 2026). Multiple time slots - Free entry (RSVP only)
2838355.title: Thomas Azier x raam

2838376.description: Leisure Music Productions, the independent electronic music label based in Vienna, Austria, announces its official Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE) 2026 event, bringing together the label's distinctive sound, artists and international music community during one of the most important weeks in the global electronic music calendar. Leisure Music Label showcase will take place on October 24th at The BEAR, Amsterdam, featuring a lineup of: Atarrayo ( Columbia) 8 pm - 9 pm Bastian Buesink (NL) B2B - Tim Susa (GER) 9pm - 10pm Balata (FR) B2B Gifted DJ (ZA) 10 pm - 11pm Eddy Tango (GER) B2B Hot TuneiK (Mexiko) - 11pm - 12AM Edictum (AT) (Vinyl Set) 12AM - 1AM Inessa (AT /TN) 1AM - 2AM Lavo (Argentina) B2B - Counterpart (India) 2AM - 3AM Goose Tann (Lebanon) 3AM - 4AM The event will present the musical world of Leisure Music Productions through a carefully curated lineup reflecting the label's broad electronic spectrum from deep and progressive house to Afro house, organic house, deep house, melodic house and minimal techno, electro and dance music. Founded as an independent label with an international outlook, Leisure Music Productions describes its mission as connecting people around the world through high-quality music, with a particular emphasis on the relationship between rhythm, groove, melody and emotion. The label is based in Vienna and has developed an international catalogue featuring producers and DJs from different musical and cultural backgrounds. For the past five years, Leisure Music Productions has built a strong and lasting connection with the South African electronic music community through its involvement with AfricaBurn, developing friendships, artistic collaborations and a wider creative family around the label. That relationship will now move from the South African desert to Amsterdam, as members of this extended family come together with Leisure Music Productions during ADE for a dedicated label event. 2838380.description: Get ready for a musical journey like no other with Fun With Dick & Jayne, presented in collaboration with House My Disco where the spirit of House Music, freedom, love, and self-expression come together on one unforgettable dance floor. Feel the pulse of House Music as legendary pioneers from its birthplace in Chicago connect with DJs and producers from across the globe. From deep grooves and soulful rhythms to uplifting beats and disco-infused energy, this celebration honors the roots of the culture while embracing the artists and sounds shaping its future. Experience the energy and iconic DJ sets from House Music Pioneers Producer/DJ Joe Smooth (Chgo) and The Legendary HUGO H. (Chgo) alongside powerhouse DJs Rod Carrillo (PA), Soleil Carrillo (PA), Mr. Rustle (IT) and more. This is more than a party, it's a celebration of music, love, diversity, and the freedom to be exactly who you are. Come dance, connect, express yourself, and celebrate the beautiful spirit that makes House Music a global force for unity. So gather your friends, bring your energy, and get ready to House My Disco and have Fun With Dick & Jayne all night long! BE WHO YOU ARE!

2839353.description: This ADE, Herbavox and Techno Therapy are joining forces for a special Saturday afternoon session. Founded by Taylor Taylor, Herbavox has been throwing intimate, sub-100 capacity parties across Amsterdam since August 2024. Showcasing local talent, we keep things genre-fluid with a heavy emphasis on Electro-House and Electro-Funk, building a tight-knit community along the way. Techno Therapy, founded by Prabuddha, centers on dancefloor mindfulness and sustainable club culture—offering top-quality music that leaves you feeling uplifted rather than exhausted. While ADE requires an adjustment to Techno Therapy’s usual pre-dance movement and meditation, we're preserving that core identity with a gentle wellness check at the door and posters advocating kind, conscious consumption. Rounding off the lineup, we are super excited to welcome the crew behind Utrecht and Amsterdam's Go Cosmic parties: Mission Architect and Nicola Piva.
2839353.lineup_names: Mission Architect · Nicola Piva · Prabuddha · Taylor Taylor

2839916.context: Circuits and Ceremonies Exhibition by Sunjoo Lee, Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan Exhibitions / Free A&C Events / Other / South / New Arts & Culture Venues Zone2Source · 13:00 - 17:00 Zone2Source + - <path d="M22.4652
2839916.description: Zone2Source presents an exhibition exploring electricity as a living network through works by Sunjoo Lee, Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan , in which technology, ecology and ritual become intertwined. Circuits and Ceremonies takes Sunjoo Lee’s long-term artistic research project Electric Garden as a starting point, a project initially developed in collaboration with FIBER. Zone2Source invited the artist to continue to explore the implications of her project further through engagement with the work of fellow artists who equally consider electricity not as an invisible, unlimited source of energy but as a living and relational process. Presented in the centre of the glass pavilion and growing outwards, works by Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan will engage in direct dialogue with Sunjoo Lee’s work through installations, research and experiments. Using microbial fuel cells, which generate power through the metabolic processes of soil bacteria, Electric Garden becomes an ecosystem where microbes, plants, insects, and minerals coexist while emitting small currents of electricity. Devices powered by the garden are designed to adapt to the slow, variable and unpredictable currents of the microbes, questioning the speed and extractive logic of industrial energy systems and encouraging reflection on degrowth, reciprocity, and ecological coexistence. What happens when electricity is not generated and consumed, but cultivated, nurtured and shared? Zone2Source is located in the Amstelpark. The closest access is the so-called Red Bridge. Open Friday - Sunday, 13:00-17:00 Free entry Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Zone2Source here .
2839916.lineup_names: Claire Williams · Ryan Jordan · Sunjoo Lee
2839916.title: Circuits and Ceremonies

2843071.context: Sofia's Trip A musical trip Live Performances / Ambient & Listening / Beyond the Dancefloor / Ambient / Classic / Contemporary / Live / Centre / New Arts & Culture Venues Uilenburgersjoel · 18:00 - 19:30 Uilenburgersjoel + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/200
2843071.description: This is not a regular concert. Come trip on the avant-garde sound world of Sofia Gubaidulina - the composer the Soviets tried to ban for being too radical - and the trance-ambient music of Soheil Shayesteh , live in one of Amsterdam's most beautiful hidden gems: the Uilenburgersjoel. Lay down. Let the sound move through the space and through you. There's no stage to face, no seat you're expected to sit still in - just a shifting, physical body of sound built to take you somewhere else, inside a 17th-century synagogue most of Amsterdam has never set foot in. The music itself moves in two directions at once. Gubaidulina's world is raw, confrontational, rooted in the physical - it pulls you down into the earth. Shayesteh's music reaches the other way, up toward something hypnotic and transcendent, closer to the heavens. Together they take you the whole way: from the earthly to the heavenly and back again, one continuous trip. Sofia's Trip is made by Lonelinoise , a platform for contemporary classical music that exists to break the genre out of its own habits - out of the concert hall, out of the silence-and-applause ritual, and into spaces and formats where the music can actually be felt. This is that idea taken all the way. Sofia's Trip. One night only at the Uilenburgersjoel. 2844614.description: “What if creating a more accessible, safer, and inclusive nightlife isn’t about adding more rules — but about changing how we show up in the space?" Giulio Beja and Veronica Motta are ’Spazi Sensibili’ , a project that explores accessibility, safety, and inclusivity within club and night culture as practices of collective care. Together, we will question who gets to feel safe, visible, heard, and free on the dancefloor — and who is still being excluded. Through hands-on exercises, collective mapping, real-life nightlife scenarios, and open discussion, we will explore how discrimination and exclusion can show up in night spaces, while reflecting on our own experiences, perspectives, and capacity to intervene. Rather than offering fixed solutions or more rules, we focus on building awareness, confidence, and practical tools for collective responsibility and action: How do we notice? How do we respond? How do we look after each other? An invitation to move beyond awareness — to unlearn, challenge, experiment, and co-create nightlife where difference is actively welcomed, protected, and celebrated.” The session will be accompanied by a listening session with Mark Knekelhuis, creating space to connect the themes explored with music, sound, and collective experience. Entry is free until full capacity. For this edition of ADE, café40 welcomes (dis)comfort : a three-day programme rooted in the belief that music can, and should, create collective spaces for awareness, dialogue, and reflection. Born from a desire to reconnect with ourselves and those around us, the programme invites audiences to slow down, listen deeply, and make space for meaningful exchange. Throughout the programme, Sasha Todorovska and Virginia Gianni will present their artworks in the space. Discover the full programme at Café40 here .

2844875.description: A monochromatic light instrument played through collective presence. White Space is an immersive installation that transforms negative space into a place where strangers connect. At its heart, a monolith of intense blue and white light spins on its axis, casting compositions of monochromatic light and generative music that shift and dance among the audience. Responding to pose and position, the sculpture becomes an instrument, played by everyone present at once. Only by coordinating their positions and synchronising their poses can visitors reach the climax of the installation: illuminating the emptiness that separates them and transforming the negative space into White Space. White Space is an interactive light installation by artist Matthias Oostrik , who leads its concept, software, and production. Developed under the Harmonic Dissonance Collective , it premieres during ADE Friday (with a public try-out on ADE Thursday ), hosted by ICK Dans Amsterdam. Its sonic language, developed with composer Marcel Wierckx , draws from electronic dance music and generative composition, placing the work at the intersection of light art, club culture, and participatory performance. The program also features ‘ SMILE ’, Oostrik's AI installation that transforms your portrait into an eerily perfect version of yourself. The Harmonic Dissonance Collective, which Oostrik co-founded with Suzanne Dikker, is known for award-winning work on human connectedness, with collaborations spanning artists from Marina Abramović to Bad Bunny and institutions including the Max Planck Society, VU Amsterdam, New York University, and ICK Dans Amsterdam. Programme: ADE Thursday: Public Try Out, €5- ADE Friday: Premiere, €5- ADE Saturday: Installation, Free ADE Sunday: Installation, Free

The Harmonic Dissonance Collective, which Oostrik co-founded with Suzanne Dikker, is known for award-winning work on human connectedness, with collaborations spanning artists from Marina Abramović to Bad Bunny and institutions including the Max Planck Society, VU Amsterdam, New York University, and ICK Dans Amsterdam. 2844954.description: During ADE, artist Sammie Tjon Sien Foek , also known as DJ Slimfit , will perform three shows featuring a hybrid live set at the historic clandestine church of Museum Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder . For this special curation, Slimfit explores the ritualesque quality of sound throughout differing historical and cultural contexts. By integrating and remixing classical music elements with live electronic composition influenced by ancestral rhythms, they reinterpret supposedly opposing liturgical ideologies. Slimfit's practice centers on critical postcolonial theory and its friction with contemporary meaning-making within a metamodernist zeitgeist. Slimfit is a queer multidisciplinary artist and DJ of Chinese, Surinamese, and Dutch heritage. Known for their high-energy, multi-genre sets, they blend an expansive range of sounds into a seamless flow of cultural expression. From emotional techno and bubbling to post-club and hardgroove, Slimfit transcends conventional rave aesthetics by infusing their sets with Caribbean and Latin American influences. Celebrated for their harder sound, they’ve delivered impactful closing sets at key electronic music events, including Lowlands Festival, Down the Rabbit Hole, and Cicciolina during Paris Fashion Week. This visual and audio art installation is part of the Pantheon Amsterdam exhibition, an art production with eight talented and multi-disciplinary artists who reflect on religion. Spirituality and celebrations. Pantheon Amsterdam is on display in the museum from ADE 2026 until ADE 2027. Three Performances: Thursday 22 October, 19:30-21:00 Friday 23 October, 19:30-21:00 Saturday 24 October, 19:30-21:00

2845040.context: Circuits and Ceremonies Exhibition by Sunjoo Lee, Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan Exhibitions / Free A&C Events / Other / South / New Arts & Culture Venues Zone2Source · 13:00 - 17:00 Zone2Source + - <path d="M22.4652
2845040.description: Zone2Source presents an exhibition exploring electricity as a living network through works by Sunjoo Lee, Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan , in which technology, ecology and ritual become intertwined. Circuits and Ceremonies takes Sunjoo Lee’s long-term artistic research project Electric Garden as a starting point, a project initially developed in collaboration with FIBER. Zone2Source invited the artist to continue to explore the implications of her project further through engagement with the work of fellow artists who equally consider electricity not as an invisible, unlimited source of energy but as a living and relational process. Presented in the centre of the glass pavilion and growing outwards, works by Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan will engage in direct dialogue with Sunjoo Lee’s work through installations, research and experiments. Using microbial fuel cells, which generate power through the metabolic processes of soil bacteria, Electric Garden becomes an ecosystem where microbes, plants, insects, and minerals coexist while emitting small currents of electricity. Devices powered by the garden are designed to adapt to the slow, variable and unpredictable currents of the microbes, questioning the speed and extractive logic of industrial energy systems and encouraging reflection on degrowth, reciprocity, and ecological coexistence. What happens when electricity is not generated and consumed, but cultivated, nurtured and shared? Zone2Source is located in the Amstelpark. The closest access is the so-called Red Bridge. Open Friday - Sunday, 13:00-17:00 Free entry Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Zone2Source here .
2845040.lineup_names: Claire Williams · Ryan Jordan · Sunjoo Lee
2845040.title: Circuits and Ceremonies

2845188.description: Niels Orens Niels Orens (BE) is an electronic producer and live performer exploring the intersection of acoustic instrumentation and immersive electronic sound design. His music transforms organic textures into deeply atmospheric, emotionally resonant soundscapes that prioritize tension, spatial depth, and sonic detail over traditional song structures. Orens crafts a sound that moves between fractured breakbeats, haunting low-end pressure, distorted textures and fragile melodic moments — balancing raw intensity with moments of quiet stillness. His work explores themes of alienation, loneliness and internal unrest, translating emotional detachment into immersive, slow-burning compositions that feel both physically immediate and deeply human. His live performances extend the emotional and cinematic quality of his recordings through immersive audiovisual elements and precise sound design, offering an intimate glimpse into an evolving body of work that continues to push deeper into experimentation, texture and emotional clarity. echofarmer echofarmer (BE) is the alias of Brussels-based producer and musician Arne Nuyts . With a sound as suited for the club as for the couch, echofarmer crafts enchanting miniverses. Hyperdetailed percussion and deep subs fuse with vocal-like synths, acoustic instruments, and found sounds. Combining childlike joy with surgical precision, every live set is infectiously unique, all unified by echofarmer’s tactile approach to sound and relentless appetite for experimentation. From teletubbie hyperjungle to bedroomstep and pillowcore, echofarmer blurs the line between dance floor and blanket fort.

2845408.description: A concert film premiere at Koninklijk Theater Tuschinski, followed by a Q&A with M07 and the creative team. On ADE Thursday, M07 premieres SIGNAL: a new concert film shot after dark across northern Vietnam. Across eight original tracks, hardware-driven electronics, processed vocals, custom instrument design and choreographed movement collide in a performance exploring the tension between technological overload and human stillness. The film was produced by Antiantiart, the Hanoi-based multidisciplinary collective behind Apple’s innovative 360-degree “Shot on iPhone” campaign. Co-founder Phuong Vu led the creative direction, with Hoang Dang, Hai Tom and Pham Duy directing. SIGNAL unfolds across northern Vietnam, with performances staged inside an abandoned circus on an island in Ha Long Bay and the concrete shell of an apartment block near Hanoi, transformed by a monumental LED screen spanning four storeys. Additional scenes explore urban locations around Hanoi. Created for the cinema screen, the film features music produced by M07 and developed for live performance with music director Steven Weston at Peter Gabriel’s Real World Studios. Cristiano Nicolini (Afterlife, Kevin Saunderson) designed the live system; M07 creative director Dmytro Nikolaienko (daynight studio, Muscut Records) shaped the visual identity; and Julia Borelli mixed and mastered the music. Experience SIGNAL for the first time on the big screen, followed by a Q&A with M07 and members of the creative team. This is a free, seated event. Reserve your spot through the RSVP link. About M07 M07 is an LA-born, Spain-based live artist and producer whose work is shaped by more than a decade spent living in Kyiv. The project takes its name from the M07 highway connecting Kyiv and Warsaw, a road travelled by millions leaving Ukraine after the full-scale invasion began in 2022. After years working across electronic music as a promoter, talent buyer, booking agent, manager and music-technology founder, M07 moved

2846831.context: Tea and Sound Where traditional Tea Ceremony meets immersive live art and sound Ambient & Listening / Ambient / Beyond the Dancefloor / South / New Arts & Culture Venues / Deep Listening & Spatial Sound The Stargate · 14:30 - 16:00 The Stargate + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none"
2846831.description: During ADE, an intimate Tea and Sound experience unfolds as a space for ritual, deep listening, and presence. Led by Bruno Sitton , the experience brings the ancient practice of Tea Ceremony into a contemporary sensory setting. Guests are invited to slow down, drink Tea with intention, and enter a shared space shaped by sound, silence, meditation, and reflection. Throughout the ceremony, an immersive soundscape moves through the space, following the natural rhythm of the ritual. Ambient and cinematic textures deepen the sensory experience, gradually shifting attention from the outside world toward subtler states of perception. Tea becomes the guiding thread between body, sound, space, and imagination. Created during the intensity of Amsterdam Dance Event, Tea and Sound offers a moment of stillness within the city. A space to listen differently, reconnect with the senses, and experience Tea as a living ritual. BRUNO SITTON Host & Tea practitioner Bruno Sitton has practiced Tea Ceremony for more than a decade. His work explores Tea as a medium for attention, connection, and transformation, bringing traditional ritual into contemporary cultural and artistic environments. Through Tea, sound, silence, and space, he creates immersive experiences that invite participants into a deeper relationship with themselves, their surroundings, and the present moment. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at The Stargate here .
2846831.title: Tea

2847335.description: WORKROOM returns to Amsterdam Dance Event in 2026 with one of our biggest writing events yet, taking place during ADE’s 30th anniversary edition at STMPD Recording Studios On Saturday 24 October, WORKROOM will bring together around 30 exceptional artists, songwriters and producers from across dance and electronic music for a full day of collaboration at Martin Garrix’s renowned STMPD Recording Studios. Across six studios, participants will be placed into groups selected to bring together complementary skills, sounds and perspectives. The aim is simple: create exciting new music, build genuine creative relationships and make the most of one of the biggest weeks in the global electronic music calendar. 2847405.context: The World’s Longest Back-to-Back DJ Set hosted by Fosbury music studio Daytime events / Nighttime events / All night long / Music Culture / Live Fosbury & Sons · 00:00 - 23:59 Fosbury & Sons + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46
2847405.description: Fosbury will transform its studio on Kerkstraat into a one-of-a-kind live broadcasting space, inspired by the openness and energy of New York’s The Lot Radio. Our ambition is simple: Create the longest continuous back-to-back DJ performance ever attempted. For more than 100 consecutive hours, all DJ’s in town will take over the booth. But there is one rule: Nobody ever plays alone. Every DJ joins the artist already playing, performs a two-hour back-to-back, and then hands over to the next DJ. Every hour, one artist leaves and another joins, creating an endless chain of collaborations, unexpected combinations, and once-in-a-lifetime musical moments. The entire event will be professionally livestreamed and recorded. With large windows facing Kerkstraat, the studio becomes part of the city during ADE. People walking by can watch the DJs perform from outside, while thousands more tune in from around the world. ∞ B2B isn’t just about breaking records. The entire event raises money for charity. Fans around the world can access the livestream by making a donation, turning every hour of music into real-world impact. Access is only available through charitable donations, making every ticket another contribution to the cause. A Guinness World Records attempt We’re aiming to make ∞ B2B an official Guinness World Records attempt for the longest continuous back-to-back DJ performance ever staged. If successful, ADE won’t just witness an unforgettable livestream. ADE brings together the world’s greatest electronic artists every year. ∞ B2B creates collaborations that would never normally happen. •⁠ ⁠Unexpected B2B combinations. •⁠ ⁠More than 100 hours of continuous music. •⁠ ⁠A global livestream. •⁠ ⁠Incredible content for years to come. •⁠ ⁠Money raised for charity. •⁠ ⁠An official world record attempt. One booth. 100 hours. No solo sets. One endless back-to-back. Where one DJ never stops, because another is always joining.
2847405.title: The
2847405.title_full: The World’s Longest Back-to-Back DJ Set hosted by Fosbury music studio

2848324.description: For three days, Amsterdam City Hall becomes a home for the people, sounds and ideas that shape Amsterdam after dark. Music, light, food and art come together in a setting that belongs to the city as much as it belongs to the people who inhabit it. A temporary and custom-built world where familiar faces meet new perspectives and where Amsterdam's creative night culture is celebrated without translation. Rooted in Amsterdam yet open to the world, Motie celebrates the city's creative spirit during its most international week. Curious by nature, uncompromising in taste, and welcoming to everyone willing to discover something new. Initial program release: Helios by Heleen Blanken (AV Installation) Young Marco (live) ft. About Motie ADE: The former municipal service desks of Amsterdam City Hall becomes a meeting place for Amsterdam’s creative ecosystem. Music, food and art come together in a custom-built world. From Amsterdam, for Amsterdam. At the centre of the stage sits Helios, a kinetic audiovisual installation by Heleen Blanken. Each evening, Helios takes on a different musical interpretation. Young Marco ft. Jonny Nash, Oceanic and Gizem - artists known for moving dance floors - step into slower, more atmospheric territory for a series of one-off performances. As an official part of ADE Arts & Culture, the program extends beyond music, featuring newly commissioned and previous work by interdisciplinary Ukrainian artist Sophia Bulgakova , curated by Nxt Museum. 2848875.description: Futures of Listening comes to Amsterdam Dance Event 2026 with Currents , a four-day programme of experiments and performances in spatial sound at Loods6 , from 22 to 25 October. Across three evenings of live and DJ sets, a day of workshops and demos, and a closing spatial sound meetup, artists will work with changing sound system configurations to shape a different listening experience each night. The programme takes place in the concrete Bagagehall of Loods6 , a former passenger and freight terminal on the edge of the IJ. 2848944.description: Futures of Listening comes to Amsterdam Dance Event 2026 with Currents , a four-day programme of experiments and performances in spatial sound at Loods6 , from 22 to 25 October. Alongside three evenings of live and DJ sets, the programme includes two days of hands-on workshops and demos and a closing spatial sound meetup, bringing together artists, makers and the wider community around the tools and techniques of spatial sound. During Saturday afternoon, we’ll offer everyone who’s active as a DJ or live performer the chance to get to know Ambrio’s new spatial mixer. There will be a demonstration, you’ll be able to try out the mixer yourself, and there will be discussions with the artists who work with it and the creators at Ambrio. More news about the programme, including a masterclass in spatial sound, will follow very soon. Free entry. Presented by FIBER Festival, 4DSOUND, Ambrio, and CTM Festival as part of Futures of Listening.

2848981.description: Gathering Sounds closes the Currents programme with a shift in register: from performance to practice, from audience to community. This is a day where the room turns inward, practitioners sharing what they're working on, and why. Across an afternoon at Loods6 , spatial sound practitioners take turns bringing something from their practice into the room: a tool, a patch, a speaker build, a piece in progress, a field recording, a research question, a score. Nothing here needs to be finished. This is a space for work that's still finding its shape, presented as an invitation to think and listen together. Gathering Sounds is part of a series of community events running throughout the Futures of Listening project, built to create space for exchange and connection outside of formal presentation contexts. Free entry. Presented by FIBER Festival and 4DSOUND as part of Futures of Listening.

2851348.description: Pantheon Amsterdam brings together contemporary art, heritage and spirituality in a unique exhibition at Museum Ons’ Lieve Heer op Solder. Eight artists are creating new altarpieces and celebrations centred on stories of faith, identity, exclusion and recognition. Pantheon Amsterdam demonstrates that these subjects are not merely historical phenomena, but contemporary themes that continue to give meaning to the lives of many people. One of these art installations is ‘ Opacity ’ by Sammie Tjon Sien Foek , also known as DJ Slimfit . During ADE, Slimfit will give three intimate performances in the museum’s clandestine church. By integrating and remixing classical music elements with live electronic composition influenced by ancestral rhythms, they reinterpret supposedly opposing liturgical ideologies. More information about the performances at this page . Pantheon Amsterdam will run from 21 October 2026 until 24 October 2027. It can be visited everyday during regular museum hours (10:00-18:00) with a museum entrance ticket.
2851348.title: Pantheon Amsterdam

Breath of Freedom brings guided breathwork, spoken word by Simone Alicia (Siem), and live electronic music by Renana together in one room. Together, Breath of Freedom and Vrijburg create a space where the worlds of club culture, breathwork and spirituality meet: club breath. A different kind of club experience: one that invites you to slow down, feel and connect. About the artist: Renana is a frequency bender with strings and other musical toys. Trained as a violinist and music technologist, she dives into the depths of sound. Her work is about creating a space for opening up and to make ripple waves to let spirit flow in and guide. The music follows the rhythm of the room and the breath of the group, shaped by the energy of the people in it. The soundscape moves between pulse and silence, intensity and stillness. 2852077.description: Dear music friends. On October 22, Killacutz records invites one of there all time favorite labels SWAG RECORDS. 4 dj's , 8 hours of pure bliss. What can be said about SWAG RECORDS that hasn’t already been said. Swag was not just only a record shop; it was a hub of creative like-minded souls. From the studio upstairs to the shop and the inhouse record labels and onto the parties. Swag was set up in 1993 by Jiten Acharya along with Paul Stubbs. The list of names of just some that served their time behind the counter is somewhat legendary – DAVE MOTHERSOLE – TERRY FRANCIS – RICHARD GREY – CLARA DA COSTA – GRANT DELL to name a few. In 1996 Jiten moved onto pastures green and the wonderful Liz Edwards became manager and took the reins. Liz guided the shop until its closer in 2010. Liz was not only the manager of Swag but the link pin to so many friends’ connections, over the years and a great DJ. Liz ran a tight ship and was always pushing us all forward, with our productions and releases, she was the soul of Swag. Liz sadly passed in 2018, and her wishes were that SWAG RECORDS carried on. So here we are in 2026 with the relaunch. Swag 2026 is not solely a reissue label. It will feature some old hard to find releases from some of its subsidiary labels and there will be unreleased gems, from back in the day, but the main objective is – NEW MUSIC - from all the great producers and artists that were involved in SWAG over the years, from the likes of GIDEON JACKSON – TERRY FRANCIS – ADAM COLLINS – JAY TRIPWIRE – UHURU BEATS – SILVERLINING – LEN LEWIS – JOSH & FABIAN COLES – ALEX ARNOUT - GRANT DELL To name a few! Swag will also aim to bring new and up and coming producers to the fold, just like it did all those years ago. So, keep an eye out for SWAG in 2026 as its going to be special... We bring some backstock and upcoming releases. All very limited Big Love , SWAG and Killa crew
2852077.lineup_names: Adam Collins · Boris Werner · Grant Dell · Herra

2852078.description: Two cities. Two sounds. One night at the museum. Van Gogh Museum x ADE Arts & Culture: Experience a special evening of experimental electronic music by Devon Rexi with visuals from uncloud, inspired by the art of James McNeill Whistler. The nightlife of Amsterdam and London will converge in the Van Gogh Museum during ADE 2026. This evening of art and music is inspired by nocturnal images of London by James McNeill Whistler (1834–1903) and the exhibition Whistler . Dandy and Disruptor in the Van Gogh Museum. Two musical worlds intertwine, enhancing each other and creating a unique experience, as Amsterdam band Devon Rexi and Coby Sey will each play two sets. Coby Sey is a songwriter, producer, vocalist, multi-instrumentalist and DJ who developed his distinctive sound in South East London’s DIY scene. His music combines live instrumentation, samples and experimentation with elements of hip hop, noise, jazz and grime, creating a distinctive, dub-infused sound. He is also a founding member of London collective CURL and hosts a long-running monthly show on NTS Radio. In his performance, Coby admires the artistic value of James McNeill Whistler's paintings while questioning his character, his racial views, and the legacy of that work today. In that sense his performance is a disagreement with Whistler's own belief that art can be made purely for art's sake. Devon Rexi , an Amsterdam-based band with a playful, dub-influenced experimental style all their own, incorporate distorted Farsi vocals, layered drum patterns, unearthly sounds and driving bass lines to create a sound that often seems otherworldly. Art collective uncloud will use sound and images to transform the museum into a visual nocturnal landscape. ADE Pro Pass holders must reserve their free spot through the ticket link. Programme 20:00: Doors open 20:30-21:15: Coby Sey 21:15-21:30: break 21:30-22:15: Devon Rexi 23:00: End Discover more about the exhibition Whistler. Dandy and Disruptor at this link .

2852109.description: One monumental art installation. Two weeks on view. Five extraordinary concerts. Celebrate ADE’s 30th anniversary with EINDER by Boris Acket. On 22 October , experience Djrum (live) with his self-built instruments: hybrid acoustic-electronic sculptures made from raw and found materials. For EINDER , Djrum not only creates the soundscape and music, but also performs live with a genre-defying discography released on labels including Houndstooth, and performances at international platforms such as Berlin Atonal, Djrum creates an ever-evolving, physical landscape of sound in which the architecture of the space itself becomes part of the instrument. About EINDER EINDER is an artificial sky in constant motion. A vast expanse of ultralight fabric floating above the space, animated by hundreds of electronically controlled fans. The system is precisely programmed, yet what happens overhead can never be entirely controlled. Air currents collide, gravity pulls and turbulence interrupts, turning every movement into something new.At times, EINDER resembles a rolling sea. At others, a passing cloud or the beginnings of a storm. It moves somewhere between choreography and weather. Always changing. Never performing the same way twice. This is a production by artist Boris Acket and Making Waves. Acket has previously collaborated with institutions and artists including the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, the Van Gogh Museum, Lowlands and Fred again. The production is realised by Goonie Crew. EINDER brings together movement, space, sound, material and light in an installation that invites people not only to observe, but to experience. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Centrale Markthal here .
2852109.title: Djrum (live) x EINDER by Boris Acket

2852931.description: Venue information: This event was originally scheduled to take place at the Embassy of the Free Mind, but has been relocated to The Stargate. The Sanctuary Earth Foundation presents: Resonance - Listening to the Future. One conversation, five perspectives. The future we are trying to protect. The ritual of gathering around sound is as old as the species. It has survived war, plague, empire and prohibition. It has never survived being turned into a product. Are we the last stewards of what makes it work? Can the cities, technologies and spaces we build next protect it rather than consume it? 09:45 - 10:45 | Arriving Through Breath: 108 AUM, €15 A gentle guided meditation set to a specially curated Sonic Spheres composition. Before the first beat, we begin with the breath. Bianka Duka opens the day with breathwork and meditation, inviting visitors to leave the noise behind and arrive fully in their bodies, the space, and the moment. 12:30 - 13:30 & 13:30 - 14:30 | The Sanctuary Sessions: Empowerment, €15 Monica van der Meulen and Lasse Mosegard lead visitors through the Sonic Spheres, an immersive sound experience exploring whether sound can help us slow down, recalibrate, and reconnect. Each session begins with a short introduction, followed by the session using spatial audio and curated frequencies designed to support nervous system regulation and a sense of calm. Visitors experiencing sound as something felt throughout the body, not only heard. 14:30 - 15:30 | Resonance: Listening to the Future (indepth session), €35 Five distinctive voices from different disciplines share their knowledge, practice and vision, followed by an open conversation with the audience. How does sound shape consciousness, and how might emerging technologies extend the ways we listen, feel and experience the world? This session explores sound as a medium for investigating perception, memory and altered states. What is the therapeutic potential of psychoacoustics and archaeoacoustics? Connect

2853142.description: “The Persian garden has always been a refuge and resting place to the scorching heat of the desert. And perhaps every age has its own kind of desert….” — Faranak Mirjalili There is an old Persian word: pairidaeza. It is the root of the english word paradise. Long before paradise became an idea of a biblical heaven, it was a garden amidst earthly life. A walled sanctuary in the heart of the desert, where water flowed in fountains that stood at the center of blooming roses and nightingale’s songs, where the desert-wind blew the soil of an ancient land into fragrances that inspired poetry, and where music echoed and soul could hold dialogues that flowed like a stream beneath the shade of an ancient cypress tree. But the Paradise Garden was never simply a place, a locai, although it certainly was materialized into wonderful gardens. As Henry Corbin reminds us, this garden of the soul belongs to the Mundus Imaginalis: an imaginal place that is not fantasy, nor a symbol or metaphor, but a living reality where the visible and invisible meet, where heaven and earth are united in the true meaning of the word “beauty”. A place where the soul remembers how to breathe, how to expand into itself and grow like a blooming rose. Today, as the world turns more painfully erratic and unpredictable, and our individual lives become increasingly mediated by speed, algorithms, and endless information, we risk forgetting something our wisdom traditions have always known: that wisdom, and soul, cannot simply be consumed. It must be inhabited as a space that comes alive with the right ingredients, both simple and refined. Above all, it asks for us to gather together in spaces that tease the soul. The Paradise Garden is an invitation into that ancient practice of gathering in beauty. We gather in the sanctuary not as escapism but to experience this wounded and troubled world sitting in the lap of the much older and eternal earthly beauty that it is. Through music, storytelling, image, silence
2853142.title: Paradise Garden

2853664.description: Pantheon Amsterdam brings together contemporary art, heritage and spirituality in a unique exhibition at Museum Ons’ Lieve Heer op Solder. Eight artists are creating new altarpieces and celebrations centred on stories of faith, identity, exclusion and recognition. Pantheon Amsterdam demonstrates that these subjects are not merely historical phenomena, but contemporary themes that continue to give meaning to the lives of many people. One of these art installations is ‘ Opacity ’ by Sammie Tjon Sien Foek , also known as DJ Slimfit . During ADE, Slimfit will give three intimate performances in the museum’s clandestine church. By integrating and remixing classical music elements with live electronic composition influenced by ancestral rhythms, they reinterpret supposedly opposing liturgical ideologies. More information about the performances at this page . Pantheon Amsterdam will run from 21 October 2026 until 24 October 2027. It can be visited everyday during regular museum hours (10:00-18:00) with a museum entrance ticket.
2853664.title: Pantheon Amsterdam

2853704.description: Between 22-25 October, you can walk beneath the art installation EINDER by Boris Acket and experience it up close as it continuously transforms, flowing to the rhythm of day and night. Ready to step into the art and leave time behind? During the EINDER exhibition, you decide how your experience unfolds and how long it lasts. Walk, sit, stand still, and watch EINDER continuously transform to the rhythm of day and night. Always moving. Never the same twice. All we need to know is when you’ll arrive. From that moment on, the space is yours. Special time-slots with performances of Kianí del Valle On Friday 23 and Saturday 24 October at 9PM, Kianí del Valle takes over with a unique performance, reshaping the installation’s movements through her dynamic choreography. Every moment of the day has its own unique effect on EINDER. It’s up to you to choose your favourite time slot(s) As the sun rises and sets, shining its light through the sky panels onto the installation. Enjoy the soft morning light, the brightness of day, the shifting colours of sunset, or the dark skies at night. You decide how you experience EINDER. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Centrale Markthal here .

2854968.description: EarthSonic, ARTIS and ADE Arts & Culture, with the support of the European Space Agency, present: What if we could not only see how our planet is changing, but hear it? For more than fifty years, satellites have been observing Earth, generating an extraordinary archive of data about our changing planet. In Signals: Hearing a Changing Planet , science, sound and visual art come together to transform that data into an experience that can be felt as well as understood. The programme brings together artists, scientists and cultural thinkers to explore what happens when real Earth observation data becomes a source for music, sound and moving image. Following immersive audiovisual performances inspired by data from the European Space Agency , a live conversation asks how art can translate complex scientific stories into experiences that resonate beyond the world of science, and whether hearing and seeing the planet differently can inspire new ways of thinking and acting. Presented by EarthSonic, ARTIS and ADE Arts & Culture, with the support of the European Space Agency, the programme moves between sonic exploration, audiovisual performance and conversation, creating a journey from data to emotion, and from observation to action. Programme: Redshift: Slow Down and Reconnect with Time, The Museum of Consciousness, Tom Middleton and Gavin Starks - A 20-minute acoustic cosmology of the planet, using ESA earth-observation data as source material for temporal restoration. Signals: Hearing a Changing Planet: Panel discussion with Joey Dean (Natural Symphony) · Ruth Daniel (EarthSonic/ADE) · Jamie Franklin (Roland) · Dirk Schuettemeyer (Earth Observation Scientist at ESA) · Matthew Russell (The Interplanetary Podcast) Halina Rice: Audiovisual performance with the support of the European Space Agency Natural Symphony: Audiovisual performance with the support of the European Space Agency 19:30 – doors open 20:00 – start time Strictly no access after the start of the show.

2856592.description: From Thursday 22 to Saturday 24 October 2026, Minimal Collective presents the second edition of its ongoing site-oriented listening series, Post-Space, in collaboration with Oude Kerk and ADE Arts & Culture. Across three days, sound and visual art enter into dialogue with the distinctive architecture and acoustics of Amsterdam’s oldest building. On Friday , October 23rd and Saturday , October 24th, Post-Space presents two distinct evening programmes of live performances and DJ sets, featuring an audiovisual world premiere and several debut collaborations. On Friday, local artist lazergazer opens the evening with a DJ set. Berlin-based Pavel Milyakov and Finnish artist Tapio Viitasaari perform Melancholia by Yana Pavlova , an electroacoustic work featuring the church’s organ. Mexican-Norwegian artist Carmen Villain presents her latest album, Memoria , live, before emerging local artists Lulá Luna & Nessim close the night with a DJ set. For its second edition, Post-Space expands its format with Hieropixel , a new audiovisual installation by Tharim Cornelisse . Using images and sound recordings from the Oude Kerk as source material, the work transforms elements of the building into an evolving audiovisual composition. In addition to being presented during the church’s daytime opening hours from Thursday through Saturday, Hieropixel also accompanies the live programmes on Friday and Saturday night in an adapted form. The work marks the first iteration of an evolving visual method within Post-Space, responding to the spatial character of each location. The installation and live performances come together within a wider listening environment developed specifically for the Oude Kerk. Building on research conducted during last year’s edition, Kantarion Sound returns with a custom sound system that responds to the building’s distinctive acoustics, while seating by côte&ciel introduces a physical dimension to the act of listening. Through art, sound and editorial storytelling

2858882.description: Club shapeshifter BAMBII takes over Parallel on October 22 for an ADE evening show. Based in Canada, BAMBII has made a name for herself by refusing to stay in one lane. Her sets jump between global club sounds, dancehall, bass and rave, connecting scenes, eras and geographies while keeping the dancefloor at their core. 2860774.description: From Thursday 22 to Saturday 24 October 2026, music and art platform Minimal Collective presents the second edition of its ongoing site-oriented listening series, Post-Space, in collaboration with Oude Kerk and ADE Arts & Culture. Across three days, sound and visual art enter into dialogue with the distinctive architecture and acoustics of Amsterdam’s oldest building. For its second edition, Post-Space expands its format with Hieropixel , a new audiovisual installation by digital artist Tharim Cornelisse . Using images and sound recordings from the Oude Kerk as source material, the work transforms elements of the building into an evolving audiovisual composition. In addition to being presented during the church’s daytime opening hours from Thursday through Saturday, Hieropixel also accompanies the programmes on Friday and Saturday night in an adapted form. The work marks the first iteration of an evolving visual method within Post-Space, responding to the spatial character of each location. The installation and live performances come together within a wider listening environment developed specifically for the Oude Kerk. Building on research conducted during last year’s edition, Kantarion Sound returns with a custom sound system that responds to the building’s distinctive acoustics, while seating by côte&ciel introduces a physical dimension to the act of listening.
2860774.title: Minimal Collective x Oude Kerk: Post-Space - Audiovisual Installation

2861187.description: " Vira ", in Portuguese, means to turn or transform something — a situation, a scenario — in a positive way. VIRA becomes the cultural link between Brazil and the Netherlands , pulsing with music, art, nightlife, and the vibrant energy of both countries. During ADE Week, Studio/K will be transformed into a free public exhibition space where photography, film, and digital storytelling come together. A photography exhibition featuring images from São Paulo and Amsterdam highlights the connections between the two cities. The program concludes with an indepth session on the 24th of October featuring members of Encosta and ONDA Collective, followed by "Beats & Bites," an informal networking event that brings together artists, musicians, creatives, visitors, and professionals from the Dutch and Brazilian creative sectors. The exhibition is free to visit. Open Wed-Sat 16:00-22:00. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Studio/K here .

2861261.context: Arsenal Mikebe Ugandian ensemble forms a living drum machine inspired by the Roland TR-808. Live Performances / Bass / Bass & UK / Contemporary / Live / East Bimhuis · 20:30 - 22:00 Bimhuis + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21
2861261.description: With raw, hypnotic beats, exhilarating chants and heavy basses, Arsenal Mikebe has steadily been infiltrating the international avant-garde. The Ugandian percussion group has celebrated triumphs at festivals such as Dekmantel and BRDCST and platforms such as Boiler Room. At the heart of their sonic identity is a steel percussion system, custom-made by Ugandan sculptor Henry Segamwenge and inspired by the Roland TR-808 drum computer. It makes the band become a living drum machine that sounds at least as intense and dynamic as today’s electronic dance music. Arsenal Mikebe is part of the Nyege Nyege collective, based in the outskirts of Kampala. The group is comprised of master drummers Ssentongo Moses, Dratele Epiphany, and Luyambi Vicent de Paul. Their debut album Drum Machine, produced by visionary Portuguese artist Jonathan Uliel Saldanha, is a ritualistic plunge into dissonant chants, deep rhythmic trance, and industrial textures. Their next album, a collaboration with Valentina Magaletti and HHY, is slated for release this autumn. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Bimhuis here .
2861261.title: Arsenal Mikebe

2861423.context: Charged by Jaco Schilp Free light installation at ADE Lab Village Audiovisual & Immersive Arts / Free A&C Events / Other / West ADE Lab Village Westergas · 00:00 - 23:59 ADE Lab Village Westergas + - <path d="M22.4652
2861423.description: Every person who walks into Charged becomes exactly that. A cloud of light gathers around you, pulled in by your presence, and moves when you move. Some people you meet in it carry the same charge as you, and so push each other's energy away. Others carry the opposite, and your clouds fold into each other before either of you has decided to merge. As magnetic poles repel, opposites attract. The work is about how we change each other's environment simply by being in it, positively or negatively, whether we mean to or not. Charging and discharging as a way of interacting between persons. The more people step in, the more chaotic it becomes. With only a few, it settles into something calm and connected. The visuals in Charged were built with TouchDesigner, while its eye uses an open-source AI vision model called YOLO, which has become the standard way for a machine to find people in a camera image. Its own creator walked away from it in 2020 because he could no longer ignore its military and surveillance uses. In Charged, artist Jaco Schilp give it a different job: it doesn't know who you are, but only where you are and how you move. No record of the images is kept. Technology born for watching, reimagined as a tool for connection and play. Jaco Schilp explores how these systems can transform when placed in a different light. Charged is a public light installation in Westerpark. It can be visited for free at any time of day or night during ADE week.
2861423.title: Charged by Jaco Schilp

2861459.context: The Egg by Touki Delphine Free A/V art installations at ADE Lab Village Audiovisual & Immersive Arts / Free A&C Events / West ADE Lab Village Westergas · 00:00 - 23:59 ADE Lab Village Westergas + - <path d="M22.4652 1.
2861459.description: Part of ADE Arts & Culture, co-curated with Amsterdam Light Festival. Amsterdam-based Touki Delphine is a boundary-pushing collective of musicians, performers, and visual artists. They are making waves both nationally and internationally with monumental light and sound installations, built from recycled materials: taillights in FIREBIRD , turn signal relays in RELAY , wiring in TRANSMISSION , windshield washer fluid reservoirs and their pump motors in DRIFTING . Their latest work, SUPERDRUM , is constructed from second-hand drums, wooden branches, and car door lock mechanisms. Through their work, they create musical poetic encounters between humans and machines. Inspired by natural systems, the climate crisis and the idea of nature as a living whole, they imagine a future in which people, nature and technology collaborate rather than compete, and where waste can be transformed into something meaningful, alive and beautiful. That vision feels more urgent than ever. In a time of ecological exhaustion, technological alienation and social fragmentation, they believe there is a growing need for physical, sensory and collective experiences. Through their work, they explore how technology can not only distance us, but also reconnect us, creating poetic encounters between humans and machines. The Egg is a public light installation in Westerpark . It was co-curated with Amsterdam Light Festival , marking a first collaboration between the two organisations that brings together electronic music and light art. It can be visited for free at any time of day or night during ADE week. It will appear in the city again coming winter for the fifteenth edition of Amsterdam Light Festival. More information: amsterdamlightfestival.com
2861459.title: Het Ei By Touki Delphine

2861596.context: Charged by Jaco Schilp Free light installation at ADE Lab Village Audiovisual & Immersive Arts / Free A&C Events / West ADE Lab Village Westergas · 00:00 - 23:59 ADE Lab Village Westergas + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C
2861596.description: Every person who walks into Charged becomes exactly that. A cloud of light gathers around you, pulled in by your presence, and moves when you move. Some people you meet in it carry the same charge as you, and so push each other's energy away. Others carry the opposite, and your clouds fold into each other before either of you has decided to merge. As magnetic poles repel, opposites attract. The work is about how we change each other's environment simply by being in it, positively or negatively, whether we mean to or not. Charging and discharging as a way of interacting between persons. The more people step in, the more chaotic it becomes. With only a few, it settles into something calm and connected. The visuals in Charged were built with TouchDesigner, while its eye uses an open-source AI vision model called YOLO, which has become the standard way for a machine to find people in a camera image. Its own creator walked away from it in 2020 because he could no longer ignore its military and surveillance uses. In Charged, artist Jaco Schilp give it a different job: it doesn't know who you are, but only where you are and how you move. No record of the images is kept. Technology born for watching, reimagined as a tool for connection and play. Jaco Schilp explores how these systems can transform when placed in a different light. Charged is a public light installation in Westerpark. It can be visited for free at any time of day or night during ADE week.

2861645.context: Heliotrope by Heleen Blanken & Daniel de Bruin Free art installations at ADE Lab Village Audiovisual & Immersive Arts / Free A&C Events / Other / West ADE Lab Village Westergas · 00:00 - 23:59 ADE Lab Village Westergas + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2
2861645.description: After being cancelled during ADE 2025 due to the adverse weather conditions, Heliotrope by Heleen Blanken & Daniel de Bruin is back at the ADE Lab Village in Westerpark during the ADE week 2026. Heliotrope is a kinetic installation inspired by the natural phenomenon in which plants orient their leaves and blossoms toward the sun. The work takes this principle as both a biological reference and a metaphor, exploring processes of energy reception, tropistic behaviour, the atomic movements inherent to living matter, and the pulsating rhythms embedded within the natural world. This idea is translated into a mirrored installation. The mechanically engineered installation moves its blades, diffusing light beams, and reflecting its surroundings in a chaotic and refracted image. It explores parallels between manufactured and organic movements and tries to liquefy the barriers. Heliotrope transforms from day into night and back again, evoking a state of perpetual motion. In doing so, it proposes an artificial organism, one that, like its botanical counterpart, responds to invisible flows of energy. Heliotrope is a public light installation in Westerpark. It can be visited for free at any time of day or night during ADE week.

2861861.description: Lately we've observed fewer dancers on the dancefloor, fewer dancers hired or planned as part of an event's programming, and audiences standing facing the DJ with their phones out. What happened to dancing all night long, connecting to the music and to each other? Have we lost the essence of clubbing? This indepth session is organized in the context of The Better Move , a project supported by VibeLab . Its goal is to increase the employment of dance professionals in the nighttime economy, and integrate more movement-based, health-enhancing, and culturally rooted experiences into club programming. This event is donation-based. Would you like to support our work? You can donate via the QR code on the day of the event. Program: 18:30 doors open 19:30 Part 1: How big is the disconnection between dancers and clubs? What we observe nowadays. Featuring Polli Panda (dancer, DJ), Diego Oliveira (dancer), and Sophie Koffeman (Doka). 20:30 Part 2: Best practices and learnings from people in the space, featuring Nick V. from La Mona (Paris) and Lottie Horton (Defected Records) 21:00 Dance activation by Diego Oliveira 21:30 - 23:00 Tunes by Polli Panda There will be opportunities to ask questions during the talk.
2861861.title: Rethinking Dance in Nightlife

2862573.description: A Soft Landing for the Final Day of ADE Join Anya at The Stargate for a 2 hour experience of blue lotus tea, Thai yoga massage and sound — a chance to slow down after a full week of music, dancing, and late nights. We begin with a Blue Lotus tea ceremony, creating a moment to arrive, quiet the mind and become more attuned to your senses. From there, settle into your body through a guided Thai yoga massage exchange — a flowing, meditative practice of giving and receiving, performed fully clothed, on comfortable mats on the floor. Come with a partner or alone; solo participants will be paired. We close with an immersive sound journey featuring singing bowls and other instruments, offering space to integrate, turn inward and land. Capacity is intentionally limited to keep the experience intimate and allow for personal attention. Practicalities: Join: With a partner or alone — solo participants will be paired. Wear: Comfortable clothing, long pants, layers and clean socks. Participation: You should be able to sit on your knees and move freely on the floor. Not suitable: Pregnancy, recent surgery, cancer or intoxication. Arrival: Please arrive on time. Doors open 30 minutes before and close 5 minutes after the start. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at The Stargate here .

2862613.description: The mission of Het Danspaleis (Translated: The Dancing Palace) is to keep all older adults vital and inclusive through dancing and music. With our ‘Tankstation van levensvreugde’ (‘Refueling Station of Joy’), we battle loneliness among seniors. Get ready to dance!Het Danspaleis is a traveling dance party filled with classic tunes from every decade, offering everything from rock & roll and heartfelt songs to English waltzes and merengue. With our passionate DJ, festive decor, and lively dancers, we create an unforgettable, nostalgic experience for seniors and anyone who loves to dance. Huis van de Tijd, is a meetingpoint for people with dementia and memory loss. Our main goal with this edition is to help them stay connected and involved in society. You can use your social skills and help out as a dance connector. Want to dance and sing like in the old days? You are warmly welcomed at ‘Het Danspaleis’ – ADE edition.

2862654.description: For ADE, Nigerian-American artist, producer, saxophonist and DJ Eli Fola brings The Healing Scapes to The Stargate — an evolving live experience exploring the intersection of electronic music, ancestral wisdom and emotional wellbeing. Moving fluidly between house, techno, ambient soundscapes, jazz improvisation and Yoruba rhythmic traditions, Eli combines live saxophone, electronic production and cinematic sound design to create performances that exist somewhere between dancefloor and meditation ritual. 2863904.description: ADE // Splendor An experimental double bill where internationally acclaimed musicians collide in improvised electronic sound, rhythm & dance This year Splendor is part of Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE) again. For this special occasion, the trio dives into a dance experiment, drawing you into a world of acoustic and electronic sounds and beats, influenced by Balkan and Middle Eastern rhythms.Deep sounds, heavy grooves, immersive visuals — come and get lost, and DANCE!
