2864727.context: HEXAGON Nighttime events / Intimate venues / House Soulkitchen Amsterdam · 23:00 - 05:00 Soulkitchen Amsterdam + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.403411 19.4499 -0.108609 17.6581 0.0224758C15.8642 0.154054 14.1749 0.91690
2864727.description: What started as a remix that hit number one on Beatport turned into something way bigger than I ever imagined. Over the past ten years, HEXAGON has grown into a global platform — not just a label but a movement, a family, and a launchpad for new talent. We've had the honor of working with legends like Major Lazer, Robbie Williams, MK, Jamiroquai, Galantis, Gucci Mane, and Felix Jaehn while helping shape the sound of a new generation. My "FORΞVΞR" album crossed a billion streams, and in 2020, I was named the most supported producer in the world on 1001Tracklists, built almost entirely on HEXAGON releases. That moment really said it all. But as we celebrate ten years, it's also time for a reset. We're entering a new era where quality needs to win over quantity. ‘Freek Like Me’ marks the start of HEXAGON 2.0 — a new chapter where every release is more intentional, more meaningful, and designed to truly connect with people, not just feed the algorithms. From a musical perspective, I'm going back to the essence — combining the classic house sounds I grew up with and futuristic sound design. I call it NeoNostalgia. Just like the early days of Future House — HOUSE is the FUTURE, and the FUTURE is HOUSE. And beyond the music, my mission as an artist is to blur the line between the DJ and the crowd. I want to break the fourth wall and create a space where we're all in it together. That's the energy I'm chasing in 2025 and beyond. We've built something powerful with HEXAGON. Ten years in, and I truly believe the best is yet to come. Line up: TBA
2864727.title: HEXAGON

2865507.description: HUBS is een gratis en toegankelijk programma van Common Culture tijdens ADE, waarin jongeren in Amsterdam-Noord kennismaken met elektronische muziek, de evenementenindustrie en de creatieve sector. Tijdens de Hub ontdek je op een interactieve manier wat er allemaal komt kijken bij de wereld achter de muziek. Van het testen van DJ-gear en het maken van je eigen beat tot het ontwerpen van een festivalposter of podium. Daarnaast zijn er talks en workshops over onderwerpen als het organiseren van evenementen, het starten van een collectief en het programmeren van artiesten. Ook kun je netwerken, een expositie over de Amsterdamse clubcultuur en het nachtleven bekijken en advies krijgen over je eigen artiestenprofiel. Je hoeft geen ervaring te hebben: de Hub is juist bedoeld om te ontdekken, te experimenteren en kennis te maken met de verschillende mogelijkheden binnen de muziekindustrie en creatieve sector. De dag wordt afgesloten met een borrel en pop-up party in samenwerking met een collectief uit Amsterdam-Noord. Een middag vol muziek, inspiratie, creativiteit en nieuwe ontmoetingen, midden in de buurt en tijdens ADE.

2865518.description: presented by WhyNot, Stadsherstel, and ADE Arts & Culture. 15 dancers explore the state of nightlife, post-clubbing. “Wonderful and devastating performance (…) Definitely the most impressive group work I saw in years.” Fransien van der Putt, dramaturg, theatre critic and author. Elisa Zuppini choreographs a system in which human perception converges with other-than-human agencies. Fifteen dancers form a pulsing structure, extending toward and withdrawing from the audience’s perceptual field. Like chthonic waves, they generate a hybrid circuit of sensation. Within the insomniac framework of post-clubbing, the dancers explore the effects and aftereffects of hedonistic nightlife. They perform through a dissociative state of depersonalization, allowing them to resource from something other than conditioned subjectivity. By inhabiting liminal and viscous spaces, the dancers explore multiple sensibilities, navigating the condition of metathreshold—a ceaseless transition in which boundaries dissolve, transformation occurs, and ambiguity itself sculpts tangible states. Accompanied by deconstructed melodies and industrial rhythms, a haunting gothic tendency emerges. Navigating a world erratically attempting to understand itself, Disambiguation reflects on collective agency and on how distributed cognition gives rise to a dramaturgy of affect. A second p erformance also takes place at 21:15 at De Duif Duration 50' Credits: Concept and choreography: Elisa Zuppini creation in collaboration with the performers Hannah Badura, Rowan van den Boomen, Tara Brügger, Lola Dupriez, Mandisa Gramelsberger, Katrina Gusca, Jieon Ko, Edward Lloyd, Maxine van Lishoet, Clémence Masakidi, Esteban Alejandro Obregon Moriano, Efua-Maria Raknerud Aikins, Jentel Schiettekatte, Envel Serazin, Ditte Toppet. Sound composition: Fabian Reichle, featuring original tracks by Lotic and BFRND dramaturgy Bruno Listopad. Costumes: Elisa Zuppini and Bruno Listopad. Lighting design: Martijn Smolders. Technic: Pa

2867053.description: BOUT IT is OSCAM 's ongoing programme exploring hip-hop as more than music: as culture, archive, artistic language and a space for identity, storytelling and community. Since 2018, BOUT IT has made room for women, queer artists and other voices that remain on the margins of hip-hop, through exhibitions, international writers' camps, exchange and a live programme. For BOUT IT #6 , OSCAM takes the next step: from short-term encounter and exchange towards long-term artistic development. At the centre of this edition is the multidisciplinary artist and performer Noell3 , based in Amsterdam Zuidoost. Together with OSCAM and KIP Republic, Noell3 begins an artist-in-residence trajectory in which music, performance, research and community become part of one evolving artistic process. As part of ADE Arts & Culture 2026 , audiences are invited into that process through an intimate listening session and artistic encounter. Noell3 shares new work and offers a first glimpse into the development of her artistic practice. Rather than presenting only a finished work, BOUT IT #6 makes the process itself visible . The ADE session is an important first public moment within a longer trajectory leading towards Noell3: An ARTist in Residence at OSCAM in 2027.
2867053.title: OSCAM BOUT IT #6 x Noell3: An ARTist in Residence

2879239.description: MARSHALL JEFFERSON & FRIENDS THE CHICAGO CONNECTION Celebrating 30 Years of Amsterdam Dance Event Wednesday, October 21, 2026 | 5PM–10PM BLEND XL | Amsterdam The Legendary MARSHALL JEFFERSON joins forces with Fun With Dick & Jayne to kick off ADE’s 30th Anniversary in true House Music fashion and he’s personally inviting YOU to be part of a night that promises to be nothing short of historic! This is more than a party. This is a musical journey through the birth, evolution, and future of House Music. Travel back to the Chicago clubs, dance floors, and underground sounds that gave birth to a global movement. Experience the music through the artists who helped build the foundation of House Music and continue to shape its future today. Marshall Jefferson will be joined by some of his legendary House Music pioneering friends and architects. From the early Chicago House sound to the soulful, deep, jackin’, and uplifting rhythms that have traveled around the world, The Chicago Connection brings the story to life through the people who were there and the music that started it all. As Amsterdam Dance Event celebrates 30 years of bringing the global electronic music community together, there is no better way to begin the anniversary than by honoring the city where House Music was born and the pioneers who helped carry its sound across the globe. ONE CITY. ONE SOUND. ONE GLOBAL MOVEMENT. Chicago connected Amsterdam to the sound of House Music and now, for one unforgettable ADE night, the connection comes full circle. Come experience the history. Feel the energy. Celebrate the pioneers. Dance to the music that changed the world. THIS IS THE CHICAGO CONNECTION. THIS IS HOUSE MUSIC. THIS IS WHERE YOUR ADE 30TH ANNIVERSARY BEGINS. DON’T JUST HEAR THE HISTORY. EXPERIENCE IT.
2879239.lineup_names: DJ Deliver · DJ Hugo H. · First Lady · Joe Smooth · Marshall Jefferson · Mike Anderson
2879239.title: MARSHALL JEFFERSON & FRIENDS

2882965.description: Audio-Technica and The Stargate have joined up with guest selector Nina Yamada to present Hotaru:Analog:Ambient – an immersive multi-sensory event featuring Audio-Technica’s Hotaru turntable. Launched at Milan Design Week 2025, the Hotaru is the next step in the evolution of analog. The floating turntable's stylus reacts to the messages held deep in the record groove, uniting music and light into a unique experience. Nina Yamada will curate a collection of Japanese minimal, ambient and kanyõ ongaku records to guide the guests deeper into the listening experience, painting a truly one-of-a-kind deep listening scene. Inspired by the delicate glow of the firefly from which the Hotaru takes its name, this event echoes their fleeting beauty in a unique analog experience that will leave a long-lasting impression. As the needle gently touches the record, sound and light emerge, colouring the silence. Guests are invited to stand, sit or lie down in the round, for as much or as little time as they need to deeply connect with the music. Free entry. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at The Stargate here .

But UML Records is much more than a record label it’s a state of mind. An independent universe bringing together a House Music label and a clothing brand, driven by the same vision: building a culture and a community where music, lifestyle and people come together. 2883883.description: The Node North will be hosting an free exposition with nightlife related art by Britta Moller from Wednesday October 20 till Sunday October 25. Britta Möller is an Amsterdam-based artist creating large-scale abstract paintings wth acrylic, mixed media and layered textures. Her work explores transformation, surrender, visibility and concealment — themes rooted in the moment her former professional world came to a sudden stop during the pandemic. Before turning to painting, Möller worked for more than twenty-five years as a graphic designer and art director. In 1998, she co-founded Maslow, an Amsterdam-based design agency working for a wide range of organisations within the cultural sector. Maslow was responsible for the art direction and visual identity of Amsterdam Dance Event from 1998 to 2020, one of the key projects that shaped Möller’s strong position within the music and nightlife industry. With a specialisation in books and magazines, she designed and produced publications connected to Dutch dance culture, including Mary Go Wild — 25 Years of Dance in the Netherlands. She later co-founded and co-owned Mary Go Wild, a platform, store and publishing house dedicated to dance culture, which produced titles including Awakenings — 20 Years of Techno, Celebrate Life — The Story of ID&T and Thunderdome — 25 Years of Hardcore. When the pandemic brought the cultural and event world to a halt, painting became a way to move through loss and transition. After decades behind a computer, large-scale painting brought her back into the body: using movement, rhythm and physical presence instead of screen-based control. In some works, Möller uses phosphorescent pigments, creating a hidden layer that appears only in darkness — a subtle reference to nightlife, and to the idea that everything carries both a light and a dark side. She works from her studio at A Lab in Amsterdam-Noord. Expo: Wed 21/10
2883883.title: Expo How Can There Be Day Without Night

2884784.description: Hong Kong DJ, selector and producer Gia Fu specialises in Afro-Latin music, particularly salsa and its associated rhythms. Drawing from her Chinese heritage and Latin American influences, her work explores how different musical cultures can meet, enrich one another and challenge stereotypes. Through her Canton Mambo project, Gia bridges these worlds across music, research, dance and cultural events. Her upcoming single, ‘Canton Mambo’, continues this exchange by combining the traditional Chinese guzheng with salsa rhythms. Gia’s work has taken her from Clockenflap Festival and the Latin Grammys in Las Vegas to opening for Marc Anthony in Miami and a sold-out headline tour across Mexico. She has also produced a big-band salsa album for Grammy-nominated artist Angel Meléndez and curated music for Louis Vuitton’s Men’s Pre-Fall Show afterparty in Hong Kong. On Saturday, October 24th Gia Fu presents an evening performance during ADE with local support from DJ Mickster (Fiesta Macumba) and Chico.

2885408.description: Über die Veranstaltung Kids Rave – Family Party open for everyone @ Club Panama – ADE 2026 After last year’s amazing ADE edition, Kids Rave returns to Amsterdam for its third year at ADE — and in 2026, we are taking the concept to the next level. 30 years of ADE. 3 years of Kids Rave. One of the highlights was the collaboration with Charly Lownoise, and the response showed us how powerful this idea can be. So this year, we decided to go even further. The Concept Kids Rave is all about bringing generations together through electronic music. Our young DJs share the decks with experienced artists, creating unique B2B performances where different generations, styles and experiences meet. What started as an experiment has now become an important part of the event. In 2026, the concept grows once again with Future Beats and a much bigger setup across three floors inside Club Panama. 2888084.description: People on Music is a multidisciplinary crew of friends with a shared love for house music, founded in Amsterdam. The crew - after growing too big for a living room- is best known for hosting intimate, non-commercial daytime events built around warm and uplifting sounds. No line-ups or timetables are announced. Instead, the focus is on promoting raw talent and refined record bags, while leaving room for spontaneity and a dance floor where it’s all about people and the music. Alongside its parties, the crew has hosted radio shows, released a mix series on SoundCloud and organized vinyl markets serving delicious food. This event has very limited capacity. Get a taste of some real Amsterdam flavor and grab a ticket if, like us, you’re longing for a breath of fresh air during this year’s ADE.
2888084.title: People On Music

2888098.description: Start your ADE night at Episode with a free vinyl pre-party in the heart of Amsterdam. Mr. Fox takes over the decks for four hours of all-vinyl, no-shortcut house music. Expect stripped-back, rolling grooves inspired by the French underground, with deep hypnotic basslines, crisp percussion and warm rhythms that keep the floor moving without ever pushing too hard. Digging deeper, he moves effortlessly through UK house, deep house, disco and UK garage, stitched together with long, smooth blends and plenty of character. They say a fox may lose its fur, but never its tricks. Come and hear a few of them. While the music rolls, dig through Episode’s racks of vintage clothing and build your ADE look from the ground up. Whether you’re heading to a daytime party, a warehouse or the main event, this is your chance to find something unique before the night really begins. No club queue. No overpriced drinks. Just good grooves, great clothes and the perfect start to your ADE night. Entry is free.

2888208.description: MIDI Amsterdam welcomes Producely, bringing a fresh approach to hands-on music production with the Dailr — their new intelligent plugin controller designed to make working with software instruments and effects faster, easier and much more intuitive. For this special Meet the Makers session, a Producely product specialist will be joining us to demonstrate the Dailr and show how its AI-powered automatic plugin mapping can transform the way you interact with your favourite plugins. Instead of constantly reaching for your mouse and manually assigning controls, Dailr automatically maps your plugins, giving you direct hands-on access to the parameters that matter. The idea is simple: spend less time looking at your computer screen and more time actually making music. During the session, you’ll be able to see the Dailr in action, discover how it integrates into a modern production setup and learn more about the technology and ideas behind the controller. And, of course, this is your opportunity to get your questions answered. Want to know how Dailr works with your favourite plugins? Curious about its AI mapping, DAW integration, workflow or what Producely has planned for the future? This is your chance to ask them anything. Come meet Producely, get hands-on with the Dailr, and discover how intelligent automatic mapping could bring the feeling of hardware control back to your plugin collection!

2889665.description: A concert film screening at Koninklijk Theater Tuschinski. On ADE Thursday, M07 premieres SIGNAL: a new concert film shot after dark across northern Vietnam. Across eight original tracks, hardware-driven electronics, processed vocals, custom instrument design and choreographed movement collide in a performance exploring the tension between technological overload and human stillness. The film was produced by Antiantiart, the Hanoi-based multidisciplinary collective behind Apple’s innovative 360-degree “Shot on iPhone” campaign. Co-founder Phuong Vu led the creative direction, with Hoang Dang, Hai Tom and Pham Duy directing. SIGNAL unfolds across northern Vietnam, with performances staged inside an abandoned circus on an island in Ha Long Bay and the concrete shell of an apartment block near Hanoi, transformed by a monumental LED screen spanning four storeys. Additional scenes explore urban locations around Hanoi. Created for the cinema screen, the film features music produced by M07 and developed for live performance with music director Steven Weston at Peter Gabriel’s Real World Studios. Cristiano Nicolini (Afterlife, Kevin Saunderson) designed the live system; M07 creative director Dmytro Nikolaienko (daynight studio, Muscut Records) shaped the visual identity; and Julia Borelli mixed and mastered the music. Experience SIGNAL for the first time on the big screen. This is a free, seated event. Reserve your spot through the RSVP link. This movie will also be screened at 19:00 - 20:00 . About M07 M07 is an LA-born, Spain-based live artist and producer whose work is shaped by more than a decade spent living in Kyiv. The project takes its name from the M07 highway connecting Kyiv and Warsaw, a road travelled by millions leaving Ukraine after the full-scale invasion began in 2022. 2890093.description: As part of the Extreme Presence weekend—a gathering on technology, consciousness, and devotion in Amsterdam organised by Hartwig Museum , coinciding with ADE—British contemporary artist Mark Leckey presents a lecture-performance at Cinema The Pulse. Leckey’s performance-lecture begins with a medieval prophecy and ends with the high-dimensional realm we are about to enter. It threads together apocalyptic visions, 20th-century counterculture, Y2K, and the singularity. Join us for this one-off performance, and explore the rest of the Extreme Presence programme of talks, performances, interventions, and workshops here . About Hartwig Art Foundation Hartwig Art Foundation is dedicated to the production, presentation, and collection of contemporary art. We foster contemporary artistic development, exchange and critical enquiry through global collaborations and commissions. Currently, we are developing the Hartwig Museum , a major new contemporary art museum in Amsterdam scheduled to open in 2028. Until then, our temporary space, Hartwig Proxy , serves as a testing ground and meeting place in the city for artists, neighbours and cultural communities alike. For more information, please visit hartwigartfoundation.nl . Image credits: Paolo Uccello, Battle of San Romano (ca.1435-1440). Courtesy of Mark Leckey. 2890846.description: Electronic Groove and Listed return to Duke of Tokyo for the fourth edition of their ADE fundraiser series, continuing a long relationship built around music, community, and giving back. This year carries a deeply personal meaning. The 2026 edition is dedicated to the memory of Philipp Jung, a close friend to many involved in the night and an important figure within electronic music. In his honor, part of the proceeds from ticket sales will be donated to VisionSpring, a cause Philipp cared about and had wanted to support. VisionSpring works to bring affordable eyeglasses and vision care to people vulnerable to poverty. Since 2001, the organization has helped millions of people gain clear vision, supporting better access to education, work, safety, and everyday life. The lineup brings together artists with real ties to Philipp and to the community around him. DJ T., one of the founding figures behind Get Physical Music, joins Anja Schneider, M.O.N.R.O.E., Ivan Sandhas, Andrew Vogt, Havi, and a very special Secret Guest. For Electronic Groove and Listed, these ADE fundraisers have always been about creating something that goes beyond the party itself. This edition feels especially meaningful, bringing friends together to remember Philipp through music while supporting a cause that mattered to him. Get your tickets here (Part of ticket proceeds will support VisionSpring Foundation)

Daytime events / Intimate venues / Minimal / Tech-house / Instore Session / Radio & Livestreams Duke of Tokyo · 12:30 - 18:30 Duke of Tokyo + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none" xml
2891063.description: Five selectors. Six hours. One daytime session. During ADE 2026, select bookings joins forces with Hamburg's Torture The Artist for a daytime session built on artists who've spent years shaping the underground rather than chasing the front of it. SaPu arrives as curator of Rhythm By Nature records , the imprint he's steered into one of the more consistently excellent deep and tech house labels of recent years - a catalogue that's included Nail, Grant Dell, and Terry Francis, with SaPu himself contributing remixes and solo EPs marked by groove-drenched, hypnotic rhythms and 15+ years of accumulated craft. Saktu flies in from Barcelona, the new home of Heisenberg , a label that has grown from an underground club into one of the most influential imprints in minimal house. With 25+ vinyl releases, 100+ digital cuts, and support from key artists across the underground scene, Heisenberg continues to push its unmistakable sound forward. 29 years in the game, Saktu is still pushing, still digging, and always moving forward. Chad Andrew 's musical journey spans well over a decade, marked by a relentless dedication to his craft. He digs deep, carefully curating a blend of all genres from house and garage to early UK tech with influences of his Orlando breakbeat roots. He runs his vinyl label Scoville Records , as well co-owned imprints coast2coast and Retrospect, consistently pushing quality music that has bits of nostalgia embedded into each release. just_me runs his Interkom label out of Berlin, as well as coast2coast and Retrospect alongside Chad Andrew. Six years, every release sold out and mixes and masters much of what this scene puts out, on top of playing and producing it himself. Holger Breuer heads Torture The Artist out of Hamburg. A true vinyl enthusiast with one of the more carefully built collections around, and a selector known for rare cuts and precision. LINE UP: 12:30 - 14:00: SaPu (Berlin) - Rhythm By Nature records 14:00 - 15:15 : Holger Brauer (Hamburg) -

2891904.description: Presented as part of the Amsterdam Museum's 100th anniversary, with the support of ADE Arts & Culture and Podiumkunst.net For decades, Amsterdam's club culture has been a breeding ground for art, music, and social movements. From the legendary venues of the 1980s to today's nightlife scene, these are stories that have shaped the city. Yet this heritage is largely absent from official archives and collections. How do we ensure that the history of Amsterdam's nightlife is preserved, and for whom? Two art installations by MRLYN and State OFFF form an archive for night and club culture in their own way. The exhibition explores what it means to collect club culture: which objects, stories, and experiences deserve a place in archives and collections? Who are the custodians of this heritage, and what role can a city museum play in that? And how do you give a culture that is inherently fleeting, physical, and nocturnal a lasting place in the light of day? With contributions from people from the club scene as well as heritage professionals, we explore together the possibilities and limits of collecting the night. Free entry. Join the free opening event on ADE Friday . After the opening, the exhibition will stay open during the ADE weekend of 24 and 25 October.

2892764.description: On the Friday of ADE, Paradiso hands the keys over to DEEWEE, the internationally renowned label for sophisticated electronic music founded by Flemish brothers David and Stephen Dewaele. Since the label’s inception in 2015, the brothers have maintained a rigorous artistic vision. Working from their bunker-like studio in Ghent, they produce, write, and/or mix every release themselves. Recent DEEWEE success stories include records by Marie Davidson and Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul. That perfectionism didn't come out of nowhere. Stephen and David are the masterminds behind the electronic rock band Soulwax and are also globally renowned under their DJ alias, 2manydjs. Since the early 2000s, the brothers have uniquely bridged the worlds of rock, pop, and electronic music. Their taste and sound are defined by an encyclopedic knowledge of music and gear, as well as the use of an extensive collection of vintage synthesizers. On the Friday of ADE, David and Stephen will present the best of their label’s roster in our Main Hall. The arrival of the DEEWEE circus at Paradiso also brings a lovely touch of nostalgia. Long before the world was at their feet, Stephen and David cut their very first DJ teeth on the Weteringschans during Paradiso’s club night, Noodlanding. Years later, the gear may be pricier and the hair a bit greyer, but their musical energy and their love for Paradiso remains exactly the same.

2892959.description: Justine Ellul’s work sits between music journalism, documentary, and commercial photography, with her assignments often growing from an intuitive, observational approach to people, society, and the spaces they inhabit.She has been documenting club culture and nightlife since 2013, developing an extensive personal archive through her ongoing relationship with the scene. For STILL DANCING, the photographer brings together more than a decade of this archive, from 2013 to the present photographed across Malta and the Netherlands. The exhibition brings together digital photography, Polaroids, and 35mm film, presenting a collection of favourite images made throughout the years. Moving between Faces of Society, Chaos and Order, Empty Spaces, and The Solitude and the Self, the work looks beyond the obvious spectacle of nightlife. Close-ups, abstract details, fleeting encounters, and quiet spaces become fragments of a larger portrait of the night; and of the people who inhabit it. The exhibition is both an archive and a personal reflection on more than a decade of dancing, observing, documenting, and being part of the scene. I’m still dancing.
2892959.title: 'STILL DANCING' exhibition by Justine Ellul

2894380.description: On ADE Wednesday - whether lying down or sitting up - embark on a musical journey through time. A musical story that begins in Jamaica, with music by artists such as Donna Summer, Grandmaster Flash, and Kraftwerk, and - via Frankie Knuckles and Juan Atkins - passes through Chicago and Detroit before finally ending in Europe, and thus also in Amsterdam. The evening will feature hosts and DJs Nathan Kofi and Derk Louwes . The event will be conducted in English. For this unique event, only the seats next to the stage and a limited number of spots to lie down on the stage itself will be sold. This means the stage is rotated 180 degrees compared to the normal setup at The Concertgebouw's Main Hall. Listening without distractions Through carefully selected tracks, sound fragments, and stories, Nathan Kofi and Derk Louwes make audible musical connections that you might not have noticed before: between styles and pioneers, from the roots of a genre to its influences on other music and cultures. Alongside the music and the story, you experience what it feels like to listen without distraction. This is becoming less and less commonplace, even though listening to music consciously can help you relax and be in the here and now, something many of us could use. Please bring your own mat if you wish to lie down. Important for ADE Pro Pass holders: A limited number of tickets for this concert have been reserved for ADE Pro Pass holders. The tickets will remain reserved until 15 minutes before the start of the concert (19:00 - 19:15). After that, the tickets will be released at the box office for other visitors. Please make sure you pick up your ticket on time by showing your ADE wristband at the ADE-desk in the entrance hall (address: Concertgebouwplein 10). First come, first serve; full = full.
2894380.title: Sonic Journey: The History of Electronic Dance Music

2895999.context: Art Expo: How Can There Be Day Without Night by Britta Möller Daytime events / Exhibitions / Lifestyle / Culture / Other / Showcases & Expo's / North / Club Culture The Node North · 10:00 - 22:00 The Node North + - <path d
2895999.description: The Node North will be hosting an free exposition with nightlife related art by Britta Moller from Wednesday October 20 till Sunday October 25. Britta Möller is an Amsterdam-based artist creating large-scale abstract paintings wth acrylic, mixed media and layered textures. Her work explores transformation, surrender, visibility and concealment — themes rooted in the moment her former professional world came to a sudden stop during the pandemic. Before turning to painting, Möller worked for more than twenty-five years as a graphic designer and art director. In 1998, she co-founded Maslow, an Amsterdam-based design agency working for a wide range of organisations within the cultural sector. Maslow was responsible for the art direction and visual identity of Amsterdam Dance Event from 1998 to 2020, one of the key projects that shaped Möller’s strong position within the music and nightlife industry. With a specialisation in books and magazines, she designed and produced publications connected to Dutch dance culture, including Mary Go Wild — 25 Years of Dance in the Netherlands. She later co-founded and co-owned Mary Go Wild, a platform, store and publishing house dedicated to dance culture, which produced titles including Awakenings — 20 Years of Techno, Celebrate Life — The Story of ID&T and Thunderdome — 25 Years of Hardcore. When the pandemic brought the cultural and event world to a halt, painting became a way to move through loss and transition. After decades behind a computer, large-scale painting brought her back into the body: using movement, rhythm and physical presence instead of screen-based control. In some works, Möller uses phosphorescent pigments, creating a hidden layer that appears only in darkness — a subtle reference to nightlife, and to the idea that everything carries both a light and a dark side. She works from her studio at A Lab in Amsterdam-Noord.
2895999.title: Expo How Can There Be Day Without Night
2895999.title_full: Art Expo: How Can There Be Day Without Night

2896054.description: In this new documentary, we immerse ourselves in the mysterious world of one of the most iconic clubs in the world – and accompany very different people through their Berlin nights. We meet Tim, alias Raven Van Krueger, who wants to make it big as a drag artist. Elisa discovers a new sexuality with her friends, a BDSM couple loves publicly, a dog play duo lives stability and excess, David tries to fight his way out of addiction. And club founder Simon seems out of step with the times – like many who once laid the foundations of the legendary KitKatClub. Performances, discussions about consent, tender conversations with fathers, encounters between bodies and souls. "KitKatClub: Kinks of Berlin" is a cinematic experience about freedom, intimacy, identity, sex, and unlearning shame—raw and poetic at the same time.

2896057.description: Lauren Martin , the Scottish, London-based music writer and editor (formerly of RBMA, DJ Mag, and others), published " Aftershock: The Seismic Impact of Dubstep " in 2026 through Velocity Press. The first book on dubstep history, it's an oral history of the British electronic music genre’s origin story, as told through extensive interviews with 28 key artists and industry figures, and exclusive photography and visual ephemera from artists and photographers. 2898121.description: The story of ABDETIK reads like an incredibledd adventure. After working relentlessly for the past 17 months and dropping as many releases as possible since October 2025, things are moving insanely fast. From his home studio in the province of Groningen, he is rapidly conquering international radio stations, and this summer he spontaneously played the closing set at the legendary Club Eden in Ibiza! As the next step in this journey, he is crowning his very first ADE performance with his own exclusive showcase at the famous Desmet Studio's (where heavyweights like Lucas & Steve have also hosted their intimate parties). With the brand-new release of his single 'Moments' on S2 (the label of Swiss house pioneer EDX), a coveted spot in the Beatport Mainstage Top 100, and the pioneering of his unique Organic Progressive House sound, the down-to-earth artist from Groningen is on the verge of a global breakthrough. During this special 'ABDETIK & FRIENDS' edition, the DJ booth will be placed right in the middle of the room. Don't expect a standard program with strict set times, but rather a laid-back afternoon full of spontaneous back-to-back sessions with befriended artists. And those secret guests are going to shake this showcase to its core. We are talking about absolute festival headliners and Mainstage global stars dropping by unannounced, simply to support the artist they have been friends with for years. Seize this unique opportunity. This is the perfect moment to experience the energy of this musical fairytale up close in an intimate setting, before ABDETIK heads into the capital for the rest of the week for surprise performances at the parties of the biggest names in the scene!

2898558.description: Justine Ellul’s work sits between music journalism, documentary, and commercial photography, with her assignments often growing from an intuitive, observational approach to people, society, and the spaces they inhabit.She has been documenting club culture and nightlife since 2013, developing an extensive personal archive through her ongoing relationship with the scene. For STILL DANCING, the photographer brings together more than a decade of this archive, from 2013 to the present photographed across Malta and the Netherlands. The exhibition brings together digital photography, Polaroids, and 35mm film, presenting a collection of favourite images made throughout the years. Moving between Faces of Society, Chaos and Order, Empty Spaces, and The Solitude and the Self, the work looks beyond the obvious spectacle of nightlife. Close-ups, abstract details, fleeting encounters, and quiet spaces become fragments of a larger portrait of the night; and of the people who inhabit it. The exhibition is both an archive and a personal reflection on more than a decade of dancing, observing, documenting, and being part of the scene. I’m still dancing.
2898558.title: 'STILL DANCING' exhibition by Justine Ellul

2898752.description: Rehearsal of the Victory Day Gig is developed from online meetings that helped _mediaklub stay together during lockdown and, later, during Russia’s war against Ukraine. When Max Robotov joined the Ukrainian Army, while others were separated by cities, countries, and time zones, this format became a way to remain close and continue working. Delays, glitches, and interruptions that once made collective music-making almost impossible became the structure of the work. The performance is built around Max’s voice from the front line, his commands, and the attempt to play together through unstable connection and distance. The _mediaklub group is based on the idea of an open visual and sound environment, the creation of which, at any stage, can be joined by members of the Ukrainian community of new media – Photinus. Thus, at different times, musicians, artists, programmers, and, by way of exception, the robot GAIA joined the group. Limited Edition Poster by Rutger de Vries: To mark ADE’s 30th anniversary, Rijksakademie alum Rutger de Vries designed a unique poster, screen-printed by the artist in the Rijksakademie print workshop. De Vries’ design is part of his ongoing investigation into glitch imagery and the visual translation of sound. Inspired by the digital VU meter of a DJ mixer, the artwork translates audio into an abstract visual composition. Following the performance by _mediaklub, the poster will be available in a limited edition for €300 each. All proceeds from the sale of this print will go towards the Rijksakademie’s ‘for artists, by artists’ fundraising initiative, supporting the next generation of artists at the Rijksakademie.
2898752.title: Mediaclub Rehearsal Of The Victory Day Gig

2899021.description: Welcome to your ADE home away from home! ​This year, Canapa-X is taking over the iconic Meet Berlage right in the heart of Amsterdam for an ambitious, non-stop 3-day music marathon. Across three continuous days, we are turning one space and one dancefloor into a hub for authentic underground sounds, warm hospitality, and genuine connection. PWCC is in Parma — well, just a few hundred meters outside Parma, in the very first stretch of superflat countryside that lies between the Alps and the Apennines. PWCC is a countryside house, an old farm surrounded by cultivated fields, a bucolic dream made of red tomatoes growing in the sun, mixed with the ’70s industrial spaces once built to house animals and machines. PWCC is a social place, a club, a concert venue, a restaurant, and whatever other human activity can possibly fit into it. PWCC is many things, and many more are yet to come, but it has a few simple rules to keep everything in harmony: no greed, no mannerism, just pure authenticity and expressions of love. For ADE, we’re taking a little piece of PWCC to Amsterdam, with a fine selection of DJs drawn from two of our most representative parties: Debunker and Bodycode. So if you wanna breathe it in, pass by Meet Berlage, stay for a few hours, bring some friends, have a nice drink, listen to good music, and make yourself at home. About Canapa-X ​More than just a liquor brand, Canapa-X is focused on building a community around dance, shared experiences, and genuine human connection, bringing together emerging and established talent under one roof. ​Pure authenticity. House & Underground culture. One community. ​3 Days. One Venue. One Dancefloor. Pure Authenticity. See you on the dancefloor!

2899798.description: Live act transforming the signals from living fungi into sound By Kasper van der Meulen - Mushroom Pulses Kasper van der Meulen is a biology teacher, multi-instrumentalist and internationally recognised breathwork facilitator, known for his work around nervous system regulation and altered states of consciousness. He has guided thousands of people through breathwork, live music, retreats and transformative experiences. For Mushroom Pulses, Kasper brings this background into a live audiovisual experiment centred around a living mushroom grow box - and treats the mushroom as another musician to jam with. A biosonification device connected to the mushrooms measures the subtle shifts in their bioelectrical activity and translates them into notes, which feed an evolving ambient soundscape in real time. Over that living, ever-changing foundation Kasper improvises, layering different instruments from around the world through live looping - a genuine back-and-forth between human and organism. The signals are also visualised on screen, so the audience can see and hear the interaction as it unfolds. Kasper weaves music with storytelling. The three-hour session will start with a lecture about Biosonification and mushrooms: How does the bio-electrical signal fungi get translated into music? From there he opens up the bigger picture - the quiet, essential role fungi play in our own health and in the wellbeing of the whole planet. A living reminder of how deeply interconnected all things truly are. Part performance, part lecture and part audiovisual installation, Mushroom Pulses brings together biology, music, technology and curiosity inside the botanical environment of Mr. Watson. The session is curated and documented by REDBOX, with the full experience captured and edited into high-quality visual content, preserving the performance beyond the room and giving it a second life through the REDBOX platform. Open Fire Sessions: Free entree - reserving a table is advised. 13:00–16:00

2902087.description: AFRODISE arrives at ADE for the first time and you are invited. Over the years, AARON SEVILLA has established AFRODISE as a solid and electrifying force within the LATIN and AFRO HOUSE sphere, drawing inspiration from the sounds of the world and from his own Latin mestizo identity, embracing global folklore and paying tribute to the many tribes of our planet, channeling their spirit onto the dance floor. Through this journey, clubbers from all over the world have been invited to pay tribute to these roots through dance — surrendering themselves completely to the sound. In doing so, AARON SEVILLA has transformed AFRODISE into one of the most iconic record labels in the scene. As an event, AFRODISE has become one of the most beautiful concept parties out there — a place where thousands of souls come together and create, alongside him, a truly magical atmosphere and unforgettable moments. And now, this experience is coming to Amsterdam. AFRODISE presents its first annual ADE event, and you can't miss it!. We will bring together a first-class lineup and create pure magic — the kind that stays in your memory long after the last beat fades. For our arrival, we have chosen IJLAND, located right by the waterfront...So, lovers and ravers, get ready for a day-into-night experience where the AFRODISE family will take you on a journey through a wide spectrum of sounds and emotions — inviting you to lose yourself completely, blend with the music, and leave everything on the dance floor. 2902881.description: XiJaro & Pitch’s Chasing Dreams comes to ADE for a charity fundraiser in support of the Norrie Disease Foundation. Beyond the music, Chasing Dreams has grown into one of trance's most community-driven platforms: a long-running podcast and livestream, a mix compilation, a record label championing emerging talent, and now its own club nights. Through various fundraising initiatives it has raised over 100.000 EUR for charity, driven by the belief that the impact of music should extend beyond the speakers. Anthony Reyers (Pitch) was born blind and faces progressive, compound hearing loss due to Norrie disease. In his words: "I'm really excited to bring Chasing Dreams to ADE for a day of trance, while raising funds for a cause that is very close to my heart. Norrie disease is the reason behind the hearing loss that will eventually bring my time behind the decks to an end. This will be Anthony’s last ADE and this one will be special as both Anthony and Xander will both be there to perform, alongside various guest DJs and vocalists throughout the event chasing their dreams. Entry is free but we encourage you to make a donation with your ticket or on the door.

2903826.description: THE GREEN ROOM x ANOTHER RADIO- ADE 2026 Special Tijdens ADE brengt de stad vijf dagen lang de elektronische muziekscene samen. The Green Room zet de camera op wat daaráchter zit: de mensen, ideeën en keuzes die de cultuur maken, verder dan line-ups, releases en aankondigingen.The Green Room is een video-podcast over de cultuur achter elektronische muziek. Voor deze ADE-special strijkt het format neer bij Another Room, slow-fashion concept store en atelier in het centrum van Amsterdam, in samenwerking met Another Radio. In zestig minuten voelt het als een avond uit, met redactionele diepte: een cold open en scene-update zetten de toon, een persoonlijk hoofdgesprek met een gast vormt de kern, aangevuld met muziekverhalen uit Digging the Crates, en een field report en live session geven de aflevering een tastbaar slot.Het thema van deze editie: 30 jaar cultuur vooruit, legacy × next generation, in het jaar dat ADE dertig wordt.De opname vindt plaats achter gesloten deuren en is niet toegankelijk voor publiek. De volledige aflevering, de losse live session en field report, shorts en behind-the-scenes verschijnen vóór, tijdens en na ADE op de kanalen van The Green Room en Another Radio.

2904616.context: Allard Pierson Presents What happens when young electronic artists immerse themselves in an archive containing more than 75 years of experimental music? Music Culture / Other Allard Pierson · 15:00 - 16:30 Allard Pierson + - <
2904616.description: During ADE, the Allard Pierson brings Gaudeamus’s collection of contemporary composed music out of the archive and to life in a unique live setting. Producer and dj Tala Drum Corps (real name Tijmen Lohmeijer) and Georgian electronic producer Anushka Chkheidze present two adventurous live sets inspired by this remarkable musical source material. The Gaudeamus collection The Gaudeamus collection at the Allard Pierson contains contemporary composed music from 1945 to the present day. Alongside works by well-known composers, it holds a wealth of music by lesser-known artists from around the world. From sheet music and LPs to CDs, audio tapes and cassettes, the collection reveals how composers have been experimenting with sound, technology and new forms of music for decades. The producers For Anushka Chkheidze, the archive became a source of unexpected musical discoveries. Among other things, she came across classical pieces from the 1970s, featuring wind instruments and choral and operatic works. She combines these historical, acoustic sounds with her own electronic music. The result is an experimental mix of rhythms, voices and unexpected soundscapes, in which past and present meet. Tala Drum Corps has been digging the Allard Pierson: Gaudeamus Collection for snippets, samples and instruments that speak to him and ask to manipulated. These recordings are given new life and serve as the starting point for a performance in which they are paired with tala’s self built instruments and sound experiments, forming a dialogue between new ‘live’ and preserved sounds. The two performances are part of an annual collaborative project by Stranded FM and Gaudeamus, in which young artists delve into the collection and transform archival material into new work. Expect not a traditional concert, but a musical journey of discovery in which forgotten sounds, radical ideas and contemporary electronics come together in a unique live experience.
2904616.title: Ade In The Allard Pierson

2904735.description: Etherealism During ADE, Ethereal Africans presents a one-day cultural programme at Another Room with East African art, music and creativity at its centre. A stage for emerging and established East African artists & friends, DJs and performers, and an invitation to discover the diversity and coming together into the East African creative scene. Ethereal Africans grew out of something small, a group chat, started a year ago by a handful of East Africans in Amsterdam who rarely came across each other in the city. Its founders carry stories of migration and flight, and of growing up between cultures. What they built together is a place where none of that needs explaining. Gatherings where people share stories, poetry and music, and where, as they put it, you don't have to do it alone. That spirit, intimate, warm, close, is what they bring to Another Room for a day. The day moves from exhibition and talks in the afternoon to music and DJ-sets in the evening, in an intimate setting where the atelier, the collection and the community share one room. 2904857.description: In Berlin, you stop at the Späti for a beer on your way to the club. Four hours later you're still standing there, and it was one of the best nights you've ever had. Amsterdam has the same corner shops and none of the habit. Here, everything is booked weeks ahead. You barely meet anyone by accident. That's why Amsterdam Cornering Society exists. Free gatherings in and around avondwinkels. Standing at the corner. Letting things happen. You know the feeling if you've been in one at half past midnight. Fluorescent light. The hum of the fridges. Someone buying bread, someone buying a lighter, someone who just wanted somewhere to be. This ADE cornering edition happens at Avondwinkel van Wou, Van Woustraat 243. Records from local, upcoming DJs between the shelves, the shop trading as normal, a corner full of people who didn't know each other at eight. That week, the whole city runs to the minute. Let this one be your "let's see what happens". Come alone. Bring five. Drop in at midnight because the other thing fell through. Stay ten minutes or stay till two. One night, one corner. Then the shop goes back to being a shop. No tickets, free entry, from 20:00.
2904857.title: ACS Avondwinkel Sessions

2906740.description: Join us for an immersive breathwork journey inside the Nassaukerk, Amsterdam. Lie back on a mattress in the church's quiet, beautiful space as surround sound carries you through an album composed specifically for this practice. Our breath will carry us through a musical journey. Live harp and voice from Fralalai will accompany the recording, adding a further layer of texture to the sound. ​Hosted by Levels Below ​ https://www.instagram.com/leve... ​Levels Below is an Amsterdam events series built around attention, working from the idea that attention precedes connection, detail and ideas. They form a stance against the constant distraction our lives are filled with. Their evenings bring people together through modern and creative takes on cultivating attention through various practices. Led by David Caron and Samuel Becht. ​Music by Rufus van Baardwijk ​/rufusvanbaardwijk ​Rufus is a music producer, composer and owner of Hidden Gem Studio in Amsterdam. His work spans recording, mixing and scoring across genres. This album was composed specifically for breathwork, drawing on his interest in the states of consciousness reached through sound and breath ​Guided by Peter Vermeiren from Breath&Energy ​/breathandenergy ​Peter is breathwork teacher and coach with decades of healthcare and spiritual background. He has been guiding breathwork sessions and retreats for the past 10 years. He combines the latest Western scientific and philosophical insights with Eastern philosophy like Non-Dual Shaiva Tantra and Buddhism. ​Live music by Fralalai https://www.instagram.com/fral... ​Fralalai is a harpist, singer and artist who awakens what is sacred, otherworldly and mythical in our essence. Through shimmering harp strings, drum and voice, she weaves ethereal melodies infused with Celtic atmospheres and archaic chants, songs that speak to the soul.

2906969.description: ADE is calling, and we're warming up the rooftop! ​Kick off your ADE weekend with an early-evening Silent Disco from your favorite rooftop. 2906986.description: TIDE brings Zeeland’s electronic music and creative culture to Amsterdam for three days of listening, exchange and discovery.By day, explore work in progress through listening sessions, open studios and conversations with makers. By night, music and community gatherings bring artists and audiences together in an intimate setting.Rooted in Zeeland, TIDE connects artistic development with opportunities to share work and build lasting collaborations. Meet the people behind the sound, discover what they are making and join the conversation. Friday’s Low Tide brings makers, policymakers and cultural professionals into one shared conversation. Martijn Diepenhorst, Lex Kruijver of Bureau Respons, Johan Aalberts of the Province of Zeeland and Jesse Aarnouts of the Municipality of Middelburg explore what artists need to develop, collaborate and build a sustainable practice. In the evening, Pawelo Event transforms the space into a High Tide community gathering centred around music, visual culture and connection.

2907009.context: Slam Bam! Must Click! A Photography Exhibition by Dave Clarke Monochrome portraits of artists by Dave Clarke Exhibitions / Free A&C Events / Techno / Centre / Club Culture SPRMRKT · 10:00 - 21:00 SPRMRKT + - <path d="M22.4
2907009.description: Following his solo exhibition at The Leica Gallery in Amsterdam in 2024 and his Parisian solo exhibition at Jardin 21 in September 2026, Dave Clarke presents twelve deep pictures of artists he has photographed over the years. Shot in his trademark monochromatic style, these are strong, vital images that capture the honest essence of the subject in the frame. Nelleke Strijkers , one of the partners at SPRMRKT and a former international photographers' agent, has been following Dave's work for a while and invited him this year to collaborate on an exhibition at their avant-garde store. You are welcome to join us throughout the ADE week to view the exhibition, on view 21–25 October, daily from 10:00 to 21:00, free entry. On Thursday 22 October at 19:00, Dave will be with us in person for The Art of Noise – Part One , a panel with Isaac Sellam and An Vandevorst on the interaction between fashion, photography and music, moderated by Jonas Zitter .
2907009.title: Slam Bam! Must Click! A Photography Exhibition by Dave Clarke

2907247.description: For the first time, SPRMRKT joins ADE Arts & Culture, turning its 400 m² concept store and creative hub into a meeting point for fashion, photography and music. On Thursday 22 October, DJ, artist and photographer Dave Clarke is joined by Parisian fashion designer Isaac Sellam and Belgian fashion designer and DJ An Vandevorst to talk about the interaction between fashion, photography and music. Who and what inspires each of them? Where does the process start, and where will it finish? With An on the decks. The conversation is moderated by Jonas Zitter of KledingCast. Before or after the talk, visit Dave's exhibition Slam Bam! Must Click! : twelve monochrome portraits of artists, on view at SPRMRKT throughout ADE. Free entry. RSVP via the link.

2907894.description: This upbeat, beginner-friendly Pilates session is designed to wake up the body, get the blood flowing and leave you feeling energised rather than exhausted. She welcomes clients of all experience levels and has a particular interest in using breathwork in combination with music and movement to regulate the nervous system and improve performance and wellbeing. Bella specialises in sculpt, core and contemporary fusion pilates.

2907900.description: In the middle of a high-energy week, take 60 minutes to pause, reflect and reset. This guided writing session explores the small habits, rhythms and repeated actions that quietly shape how we feel, where our attention goes and the life we’re creating. Through simple frameworks, guided prompts and moments of reflection, you’ll be invited to notice what’s currently supporting you, and what may be ready for a shift. A thoughtful, low-pressure space to step out of autopilot, reconnect with your own direction and identify small changes that feel meaningful and realistic. All writing materials are provided, with tea served throughout. Come as you are, no previous journaling experience needed. Led by Julia Úbeda Julia Úbeda is a writer and facilitator of guided journaling sessions focused on inner clarity, emotional awareness and self-observation. With over ten years of experience, she uses writing as a practical tool for understanding inner patterns, reconnecting with what matters and creating greater clarity in everyday life. Through her Substack The Journal, where she has published over 180 essays, she explores inner work, emotional wellbeing and creative practice.
2907900.title: Art Of Arte Small Habits With Big Impacts

We are welcoming you straight into our home base: “The Bunker” at NDSM, located inside a historic UNESCO heritage site. Hidden away in the industrial edges of the shipyard, these raw premises become a sanctuary for electronic music from Wednesday through Sunday. For 125 hours straight, the outside world fades away, driven by a sound system custom-tuned to deliver a deep, exceptionally warm sound that you can feel in your chest. Inside The Bunker, the soundscape constantly evolves. 2908830.context: Selectors Sunday - Orbit Wax invites Percy (Orbit Wax) and resident selectors of a Sense of Place Music Culture / Beyond the Dancefloor a Sense of Place · 12:00 - 18:00 a Sense of Place + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.4
2908830.description: Orbit Wax is an independent record shop for underground electronic music, and it lives inside a Sense of Place. Percy runs it. He picks the records, he prices them, and on Sundays he plays them. On the last day of ADE he plays from the shelves, noon until six . What comes out of the crates: Japanese psychedelics from the 80s and 90s, dub techno, minimal, ambient, downtempo, 2000s tech house. The thread through all of it, in his words, is "an endless, dreamy, hypnotic sound". The day starts easy, builds through the afternoon and settles again towards six. Through the day he invites our resident selectors to the decks with him: the people who play the room on other Sundays of the year. Most of the records you hear are in the shop , a few metres from the turntable. Listen first, then take one home. Come for one record or stay for the day. Free entry, no reservation. Seated. Coffee is served as on any Sunday.
2908830.title: Selectors Sunday - Orbit Wax invites

2909776.context: MOSIMANN's VOULEZ-VOUS Boiler Room format, no labels, no hierarchy, just music and collective energy. Nighttime events / Intimate venues Bar Rouge · 22:00 - 03:00 Bar Rouge + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.403411 19.4499
2909776.description: "Voulez-vous" comes from the iconic French phrase "Voulez-vous coucher avec moi (ce soir)?", instantly recognizable worldwide. It carries the universal codes of seduction, connection, love and freedom, reimagined for the global electronic scene by Mosimann. Voulez-vous is more than a question — it's an invitation. A respectful, positive proposal to share a moment together. Nothing imposed, only energy, consent and collective emotion. A powerful, emotional, dance-driven journey across Tech-House, House and Techno, curated and performed by Mosimann: a high-impact live DJ performance with strong crowd interaction, in a Boiler Room format that places the DJ in the heart of the crowd, not above it. A Voulez-Vous night is the club equivalent of the mantra "Come as you are." No barriers, no labels, no hierarchy — only music and connection. A warm, inclusive, international atmosphere designed to resonate with global clubbers. "Voulez-vous…" can evolve endlessly. Each city, each venue, each night — same spirit, unique experience.
2909776.title: Mosimanns Voulez Vous

2909839.context: a Sense of Place presents: Soft Signals Nisham Olakara (Kerberos and Styx Studios) · Alexcel · Beastie · logan kai Beyond the Dancefloor a Sense of Place · 09:00 - 18:30 a Sense of Place + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.
2909839.description: Soft Signals is the sound of a room, played back inside it. Nisham Olakara of Kerberos and Styx Studios spent months recording a Sense of Place, a coffee bar in a 1930s garage on the Willemsstraat: the pull of an espresso shot, the hiss of the steam wand, the way the old garage holds a note. He turned those recordings into a spatial audio piece. On the Friday of ADE he performs it live, in the room where it was made. The day has three parts. 9:00 to 11:00. Omakase 'Beyond', Soft Signals edition. Our coffee omakase: a sequence of courses built from coffees that never reach the regular menu, served for one morning while Nisham performs live. Six seats. Reservation only, at asenseofplace.nl . 13:00 to 14:00. Soft Signals, open door. The piece performed live, over a coffee. Free entry, seated, while the seats last. 14:00 to 18:30. Three selectors on vinyl , one after the other. 14:00 to 15:30. Alexcel. From Riga, more than ten years behind the decks. He opens the afternoon the way this room likes it: warm, deep house played slow, long blends, a patient build, some of it his own productions. Recent sets have taken him from Riga to Tokyo. 15:30 to 17:00. Beastie. Learned his ear on London internet radio and has spent the last ten to fifteen years digging through funk, disco, house and Detroit techno. Now based in Barcelona and still close to the electronic scene, he plays vinyl only. For ADE he strips it back: no dancefloor to serve, just a selector's set of jazz, funk and experimental records. 17:00 to 18:30. logan kai. NYC born, amsterdam based, logan’s been building his sound for both downtempo and higher-energy sets around the city. Now leaning mostly vinyl, he’s bringing lush deep house cuts, trip hop nodders, and much in between to showcase his sound. Free entry all day, except the omakase. Seated. Coffee is served as on any Friday.
2909839.title: a Sense of Place presents: Soft Signals
2909839.title_full: a Sense of Place presents: Soft Signals

2910426.description: It's Sunday evening and ADE is winding down. Whether you've spent the week partying hard, networking non-stop, or soaking in events across the city, Too Martian is inviting you to close things out the right way. On Sunday the 25th, him and his friends will be hosting an evening full of experimental Bass Music, ambiences that take you on a journey and a wide range of Electronic Music that makes you want to move your body in ways you’ve never felt before. This isn't just about partying or raving. It's about coming together to truly listen, as a lineup of artists share sets shaped by their own identity and sound. Come wind down, reconnect, and let the music carry you through the night.

2912515.description: South Asian-inspired electronic music has moved from the margins to some of the most talked-about rooms in global house and techno over the past few years. As audiences for a deeper version of this sound grow, artists and producers working in this space are finding new stages, new labels, and new fanbases that didn't exist a few years ago - and the market is wide open for the right voices to define it. VYU is a UK-based underground electronic music collective exploring deeper sounds through South Asian and global culture - creating a dance floor for all backgrounds and one of the first to start opening up these new sounds to a wider demographic. This ADE, the collective is hosting their first public presentation and networking/mixer to introduce VYU's forthcoming record label - its vision, its sound, and the artists shaping it. Open to producers, DJs, and industry figures with an interest in deep, culturally-inspired, global sound - house or techno. There'll be a chance to play your demos and get direct feedback, with the possibility of signing to the label if it's the right fit. What does it take to build a label around a sound that's still finding its shape internationally? Where is South Asian-inspired electronic music heading over the next few years, and what should artists building in this space be thinking about now? This session is a first look at VYU's long-term plans for future events and collaborations, and a chance to connect with other artists and key players working in this corner of the scene. 📅 Saturday 24 October 2026 🕒 4-6PM 📍 Cruise Control Studios, Rokin 75, Amsterdam Spaces are limited - contact Instagram.com/vyu.world to confirm attendance.
2912515.title: Introducing VYU

2912827.description: During this special The Bookshop Invites , in collaboration with the Prins Claus Fund and ADE Arts & Culture , we bring together various artists for an evening about music, memory, and heritage. Nigerian musician Lady Donli , theater maker Priscilla Vaudelle , and Brazilian producer and DJ Raiany Sinara make an appearance. The evening unfolds in three parts: a statement, an exploration, and an offering. First, Lady Donli will open the space with an artistic statement, setting the frequency for the evening. We then shift into a deeper conversation moderated by ITA programmer Richard Kofi, looking closely at the urgent ideas, influences, and creative practices that shape their work. To close the evening, Raiany Sinara will present a sonic performance responding to the opening statement, weaving past and present into a living, moving memory. Together, they will explore how music, memory, and heritage are carried, transformed, and given new meaning across generations and geographies. Not a standard artist talk, but an encounter you can hear, feel, and experience. This event is part of Exchanges, the Prins Claus Fund's programme connecting Prince Claus Awardees and Seed Awardees with Amsterdam’s vibrant cultural landscape, this gathering creates a space for open conversation, shared learning and new connections across the city’s cultural ecosystem. Exchanges is made possible through the generous support from the City of Amsterdam.

2914346.description: On ADE Thursday, Foam and Echobox present an evening of music and storytelling inspired by In Her Own Way / شوية وراجعة , Yomna El Beyaly 's outdoor exhibition on Mercatorplein. Developed as part of Foam's collaboration with Middle East Archive , a platform dedicated to celebrating and reimagining visual narratives from the Middle East and North Africa, the programme invites audiences to engage with the exhibition's themes through sound, conversation, and collective exchange. For one evening, Echobox takes over Aladdin's Notenhoek , a beloved local business that has long been part of daily life on Mercatorplein. In this intimate and unexpected setting, Karmel , Noise Diva , and ZINEB share musical selections alongside personal stories, cultural references, and sources of inspiration. Moving beyond the traditional DJ set, the programme creates space for listening, reflection, and dialogue. Through sound, the artists respond to themes that resonate throughout El Beyaly's work: identity, femininity, community, and the ways women see, define, and represent themselves and one another. About the exhibition: In Her Own Way / شوية وراجعة is a public-space exhibition by Egyptian-French photographer Yomna El Beyaly, presented by Foam and Middle East Archive. Through photographs made in Cairo, El Beyaly explores identity, femininity, and everyday life, creating a visual world shaped by colour, movement, intimacy, and personal perspective. The exhibition is on view at Mercatorplein from 1 to 29 October 2026.
2914346.title: Foam x Echobox present: The Sounds of In Here Own Way

2915870.description: Podium Mozaïek, in collaboration with Echobox Radio, Foam, and ADE Arts & Culture, presents a programme centred on sound, image and identity. The Wednesday program starts with Improvisation as Composition , a workshop by EIN L AQL introducing participants to Arabic maqam: modal thinking, microtonality and its connection to contemporary composition. The workshop opens with a listening session dedicated to pioneering women artists from the MENA region, including Munira al-Mahdiyya , Naima al-Masriyya , Fatma Serry and Kamilya Jubran , and builds towards a collective improvisation session. Feel free to bring your own instrument. Want to actively take part? Reserve a participant ticket. Coming to watch and listen? A regular ticket is enough. Following this, a lecture takes place, connected to Foam's exhibition Al Nisa / النساء , curated by Middle East Archive at MAQAM. Photographer Yomna El Beyaly , whose work is also on view at Mercatorplein, gives the lecture on identity, femininity and self-representation. She is then joined by Karmel and Noise Diva for a discussion moderated by Sarah Saleh . Together, they explore themes of representation, archiving, diaspora and the female perspective, drawing on photography, visual culture and music. The evening concludes with an open jam led by EIN L AQL, in which participants and visitors continue to improvise together, building on what the workshop and talk have brought forward. Info & Tickets: 18:00 - Workshop: Improvisation as Composition - Free registration here . 20:45 - Lecture: Sound & Image as Language - Free registration here . 22:00 - Jam Session - Free registration here . Also worth checking out: ADE Thursday at Mercatorplein - The Sounds of In Here Own Way Those who want to experience more of this story can head to Mercatorplein on Thursday, where Foam and Echobox host an accessible daytime programme right next to the Foam exhibition.
2915870.lineup_names: EIN L AQL · Kamilya Jubran · Karmel · Noise Diva · Sarah Saleh

2916710.description: We start our ADE three-day performance program with Working (Título) | Cuddles are not enough, I need to be under your nails, sharing space with the dirt of your labor by Eloy Cruz del Prado . The performance points to a desire for intimacy that involves tenderness but goes beyond it. Through the sound of a waltz, a dance associated with coupling, but here danced with a hammer, and the words of James Baldwin’s Giovanni’s Room, in which desire, shame, and precarious living conditions are inseparable, the work treats affection and waged labor as entangled. The work asks how the material conditions in which we work and live shape the ways we love and care for others. What does intimacy look like when exhaustion and economic pressure are part of the relationship? Rather than separating love from work, the performance lets them share the same space, suggesting that care is never free of the conditions under which it is given. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at ROZENSTRAAT here .
2916710.title: Performance: Eloy Cruz del Prado -

2917272.context: Melting Image The longer you look, the more it changes. Exhibitions / Free A&C Events / Other / Centre The Cristel Ballroom Gallery · 00:00 - 23:59 The Cristel Ballroom Gallery + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46589C21.157 0.403411
2917272.description: Melting Image is a quiet resistance to how we consume images today — against the passive, one-dimensional scroll of the digital screen, it asks for presence instead of speed. Here, looking takes time, and the image only reveals itself to those willing to give it. An image is silkscreened onto layers of transparent material, then heat-formed until it lifts off the flat surface and takes on an organic, sculptural shape. Displayed in the gallery window, it turns the glass into a screen between street and space. Lit from behind by a slowly shifting projection, each layer catches the colour differently: parts of the image surface, others fade, never quite settling into one form. The longer you look, the more it keeps changing. Romina Koopman is a visual artist working at the edge of the tangible and the virtual, questioning how the digital image reshapes our perception of reality. The artwork will be displayed in the gallery's window throughout the ADE week, day and night.
2917272.title: Melting Image

2918617.context: Performance: Wynnie Mynerva - Sidario On the lives and mortality of gay and trans people during the HIV crisis Dance & Theatre / Beyond the Dancefloor / Centre / Club Culture / New Arts & Culture Venues / Recommended Arts & Culture Events ROZENSTRAAT – a rose is a rose is a rose · 19:00 - 20:00 ROZENSTRAAT – a rose is a rose is a rose + - <div class="ade-favourites-button__icon ade-fav
2918617.description: On the second evening of the ADE Arts & Culture programme, ROZENSTRAAT presents Sidario (2025-26) by Peruvian artist Wynnie Mynerva . Blood and a white shroud are the central materials of Mynerva’s performance, which is inspired by Loco afán: Crónicas de sidario (1996) by Chilean writer and performer Pedro Lemebel. In this work, Lemebel describes the lives and mortality of gay and trans people during the AIDS crisis. In Sidario , HIV is addressed not only as a medical condition, but also as a social and political issue. Mynerva brings together HIV, sex work, gender, racialisation and death with the exclusion and neglect experienced by certain bodies. B uh , a term used within trans communities in Peru to refer to HIV, appears as a virus that enters the exhibition space from the street and, as it were, ‘infects’ it. Drawing on drag and club-kid aesthetics (an extravagant and avant-garde fashion and lifestyle subculture that emerged in New York nightlife in the late 1980s and early 1990s), as well as ritual elements from the Andes, Mynerva pays homage to Lemebel while giving his work new meaning from a contemporary Peruvian and trans perspective. Sidario makes visible how bodies excluded by social systems continue to manifest themselves and persist. Wynnie Mynerva will perform together with Alexis Lima. 2921870.description: Art Bar SEXYLAND is a café you visit on Wednesdays when you’re stuck in your ideas, a place to talk about art or show your work to a renowned artist or curator from the field, who happens to be your bartender for the night. It offers emerging and established artists an informal way to ask questions without the formality of a traditional Q&A, because the person you’re talking to is simply standing behind the bar. The credo is bad bartenders, great ideas , so awkwardness is something we all share. From Raquel van Haver, Renzo Martens and Wolfgang Tillmans to Kenneth Aidoo, Iriée Zamblé and Beatrix Ruf, every edition features a seasoned artist or curator serving terribly poured beers and exceptionally good ideas. On ADE Wednesday, Art Bar SEXYLAND returns to Café De Engelbewaarder, with the one and only Gerald van der Kaap aka KAAP aka VJ 00-KAAP. Café De Engelbewaarder is a historic literary café in Amsterdam, opened in 1971 as the first literary café in the Netherlands. A longstanding meeting place for writers, artists and musicians, it hosts readings, exhibitions and live music, and remains a classic Amsterdam brown café where culture and everyday life meet.
2921870.title: Art Bar SEXYLAND

2922559.description: The session opens with sound transmissions from the Museum of Consciousness , followed by a talk by Carl Hayden Smith exploring how sound can transform perception, attention and our experience of reality. How does sound shape consciousness, and how might emerging technologies extend our capacity to listen, feel and perceive? Drawing on immersive artistic practice, psychoacoustics and archaeoacoustics, Smith explores the relationship between sound, embodiment, memory and altered states of consciousness. Moving between ancient acoustic traditions, contemporary technologies and scientific enquiry, the session examines the therapeutic potential of sound and asks a fundamental question: Can extraordinary listening experiences produce lasting changes in how we perceive, feel and act?
2922559.title: Sound, Technology and Consciousness

2922593.description: CrunchyHouse Records is an Italian collective born between Reggio Emilia, Modena and Bologna. Founded by Klevi Koci,it grew from a circle of longtime friends, new faces, DJs and people who live andbreathe music, brought together by a shared approach to club culture. At its core, CrunchyHouse is about groove, connection and freedom of expression, creating spaces where different people and identities can meet and shape the experience together. Rooted in Chicago house and shaped by the European underground, CrunchyHouse brings sound, people and visual culture into one identity: raw, open and constantly evolving. Its influences range from the community-driven spirit of projects such as SlapFunk to Berlin's club culture, where music, people, spaces and visual identity are all part of the same experience. The focus is not on performance, but on what happens between people: connection, freedom and the shared energy of the dancefloor. From its first 36-hour marathon inside a Renaissance castle, CrunchyHouse has continued to develop its identity through carefully selected events, meaningful relationships and encounters with artists from the local and international underground scene. Along the way, the collective has worked with artists including Oward, Lambda, Almuedo, Smoud Beats, DJ Senc, KIWA, Brawther, Monika Ross and Dyed Soundorom.
2922593.lineup_names: A.M. Project · Ale Melloni · Brotherz · Klevi Koci
2922593.title: CrunchyHouse

2927420.description: A night dedicated entirely to live electronic music. On 22 October, Baggerbeest hosts an ADE night featuring live performances from every artist. At the center of the program is a special Analog Kitchen immersive 4D sound performance, created together with acclaimed engineer and immersive audio specialist Attie Bauw and guitarist Eran Hareven. Analog Kitchen's hardware-only approach extends beyond conventional stereo, allowing individual sounds and instruments to move around and through the room during live performance. The rest of the night brings together a diverse line-up of electronic live acts, each with their own approach to performing with machines and instruments: Analog Kitchen — Live 4D Sound with Attie Bauw & Eran HarevenEnrico SuGrit & Peter LaserJelle BolijnMaster D.Mikey 44Sinisin+ more TBA From techno and hypnotic electronics to experimental and machine-driven performance, the common thread is simple: everything you see and hear is being performed live. 2927997.description: A magical highlight for ADE. Specially adapted for STMPD’s state-of-the-art Dolby Atmos Mix Stage, their sound becomes a piece of fully immersive artistry. Expect a captivating live performance transporting you into another dimension. “Brimming with rich, luscious melodies and bizarre but beautiful chord changes.
