2928552.context: Killacutz X RECUT RECUT Music showcase @ Killacutz Records Daytime events / Intimate venues / Music Culture / House / Jackin House / Chicago House / Acid / Disco KILLACUTZ · 11:00 - 14:00 KILLACUTZ + - <path d="M22.4652 1.4658
2928552.description: RECUT Recut is an Italian Dj, producer and founder of Recut Music, with more than three decades deeply connected to vinyl and underground club culture. He started making music in the ’90s, coming from DMC culture and developing his approach through the art of storytelling with records. His sets are built around groove, strong musical roots and carefully selected records, moving naturally between Disco, Chicago House, Acid, Funk, Latin and other forms of electronic music. His musical philosophy is deeply influenced by the pioneers who shaped modern club culture and the art of Djing. For Recut, being a Dj is not simply about playing records, but about creating a journey through sound, where technique, selection and emotion come together to create a deeper connection with the dancefloor. Through Recut Music, he has developed a catalogue of vinyl releases that reflects this same approach. The label explores the meeting point between Acid, Disco and Chicago-inspired House, combining raw analogue grooves, soulful elements and a contemporary dancefloor sensibility. Recent releases including Love Da House, Narcotic Tango and the forthcoming Picture About You continue to develop this sound, with a strong focus on groove, analogue character and functionality for the dancefloor. At the centre of both the artist and the label is a simple commitment to vinyl, club culture and music made to be played: Fun for Djing.
2928552.title: Killacutz X RECUT

2929032.description: Amsterdam Vinyl Club & Wanakam come together yet again this time to bring you an all vinyl (& more) multi genre evening on the opening night of ADE 2026. Joining the night will be veteran and new DJ's alike from the Amsterdam Vinyl Club roster playing music across genres of NU & Italo Disco, House, Jazz, Roots Reggae, Dub, Live Synth, South Asian Grooves, Electronica, Techno. All sets are exclusively curated for the occasion and will be accompanied with Immersive live visuals making it the perfect way to expirence what this local talent pool in Amsterdam has to offer on such an occasion of celebrating music, dance & culture like ADE. About Amsterdam Vinyl Club: Amsterdam Vinyl Club started as an experiment: create a night for people who love records. A celebration of collecting, discovering and sharing music – built for crate diggers, wax junkies and anyone who think music feels better when it’s played on vinyl. What started as a single event has grown into something bigger. Today, Amsterdam Vinyl Club hosts events across the city, alongside new spin-off nights including listening parties, genre specials and laid-back Sunday sessions. But the spirit remains the same as it was on day one: great music, great people and the thrill of discovering something new. The best part? What began as an experiment has become a genuine international community – DJs, collectors and music lovers from all over the world, united by a shared love of vinyl.

2929145.context: Performance: Erik Tlaseca - Eclipse A child and a vampire: loss and desire Dance & Theatre / Beyond the Dancefloor / Centre / New Arts & Culture Venues ROZENSTRAAT – a rose is a rose is a rose · 19:00 - 20:00 ROZENSTRAAT – a rose is a rose is a rose + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none"
2929145.description: On the final evening of our ADE performance programme, we show Eclipse by Erik Tlaseca . In the performance, we encounter two characters: a child and a vampire. These apparent opposites both long for connection, understanding and care. The vampire becomes a figure for the desire for those fleeting moments of pleasure and intimacy that remind us that we are alive, precisely in a world where certain bodies and lives risk becoming invisible. The eclipse is the starting point for the work. In colonial Mexico, the phenomenon was represented by Indigenous artists as the moment when the sun closes its eyes; the sun did not disappear, but rather we disappeared from its sight. From this perspective, Tlaseca asks to what extent our memories remain present, and whether we can return to them. Eclipse grew out of a series of letters that Tlaseca wrote from a deep longing for connection. At the same time, the work reflects on loss and desire, and on the ways in which we might reinvent ourselves when there is no way back to our origins. As Tlaseca writes: “When darkness falls completely, there’s a different kind of light.” The performance is a collaboration with Dagmar Bosma and Dmytro Tentiuk. Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at ROZENSTRAAT here .
2929145.title: Performance: Erik Tlaseca -

Juls With a Grammy nomination and productions for an impressive roster of international artists, Juls is regarded as one of the key figures behind the modern Afrobeats sound. 2931339.context: Dreaming Babies: illi by Yoon Chung Han Free installations at ADE Lab Village Exhibitions / Audiovisual & Immersive Arts / Free A&C Events / Other / West ADE Lab Village Westergas · 00:00 - 23:59 ADE Lab Village Westergas + - <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 25 21" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/20
2931339.description: The artwork “ Dreaming Babies: illi ” presents 23 special hybrid human babies , each with a different chromosomal anomaly, sleeping and dreaming inside their own virtual incubator in space, weaving stories through their unique identities. This project explores new speculative human designs, addressing humanity’s desire to create a perfect being through genetic technologies, the fusion of science and cloning, the many possibilities and uncertainties of future human birth, and the ethical dilemmas surrounding genetic modification. Each baby’s story, generated from genetic data, is created in collaboration with artificial intelligence. Visitors can interact with the sleeping babies in real time by inputting sound through a microphone, connecting with them via the ChatGPT system. The videos of babies floating in space can be viewed on each screen, where audiences can observe how genetic anomalies are reimagined not as physical difficulties, but as representations of more unique and special forms of humanity. After experiencing egg retrieval and Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT), the artist went through the process of selecting embryos through genetic testing—freezing only those that passed as “normal,” while discarding those that did not. But what exactly defines an embryo with “normal” genes, and should embryos with “abnormal” genes be discarded? Even now, countless human embryos that fail PGT during in-vitro fertilization are discarded worldwide, never reaching pregnancy or birth. Does an embryo that fails PGT, then, represent a baby that was never born? This AI-based installation reinterprets the genome not as an object of pathology, but as a site of imagination and mythology. Each chromosome—often associated with genetic disorders or congenital conditions—is reborn as a baby character with a name, an alter ego and imagined being, endowed not with deficiency but with a poetic and abstract superpower. By naming and animating what is often silenced or hidden in the
2931339.title: Dreaming Babies: illi
2931339.title_full: Dreaming Babies: illi by Yoon Chung Han

2932331.description: TRNSCND — A RITUAL OF RELEASE | ADE 2026 🔥 You spend all week being who the world needs you to be. On this night, you can put that down. This is a moment on the dancefloor when your thoughts loosen their grip. Your body takes over, the tension breaks, and strangers around you feel suddenly connected. TRNSCND is built around that moment. During Amsterdam Dance Event, March Forward brings his world to The Velvet Fixen: a dark, atmospheric space where high-energy tech house pulls you beyond the everyday and fully into the present moment. Together with @mrsidofficial and @robinaristo, @marchforwardmusic shapes a continuous journey through rolling basslines, percussive grooves, hypnotic repetition and melodic release. The energy deepens throughout the night, building towards those moments when the whole floor lets go together. At its heart is a simple invitation: put down who you think you have to be. The responsibilities, the expectations, the pressure to always be in control. Give yourself the night to move, feel and be carried by the music. Come for the groove. Leave with that feeling you’d forgotten you needed. March Forward presents: TRNSCND. Step beyond the known. 📅 Thursday 22.10.2026 📍 The Velvet Fixen · Amsterdam 🕘 21:00–00:00 🎧 LINEUP: MARCH FORWARD · Mr. Sid · Robin Aristo ✨* Amsterdam Dance Event 2026*
2932331.title: TRNSCND

2933072.description: ​It's ADE week. The city's been up all night. We're doing the opposite. ​ RUN & RAVE is a morning run through the Amsterdam canals with the energy of the dancefloor — a STËLZ car rolling with us for the music, HOKA on our feet, and a few hundred people who'd rather start the day moving than scrolling. No race, no clock, no pressure. One group, one easy pace (6:30/km), 5 km, and everyone finishes together. ​Here's how it goes: we meet at Jimmy Woo for a warm-up dance and a pre-workout drink, head to the Leidsegracht where the STËLZ DJ SUV is waiting, run an easy 5k along the canals, and come back to Jimmy Woo for a 2–3 hour rave with STËLZ × HOKA. ​And here's the deal: nobody runs alone, nobody gets left behind. You don't have to be fast. You don't have to know anyone. You just have to show up — that's the whole entry requirement. ​Every runner helps to Free a Girl . Right now, children, some as young as eight years old, are being sexually exploited. Free a Girl tracks down the perpetrators, rescues these children and keeps embracing them afterwards. And it doesn't stop there: through its School for Justice, young women who survived sexual exploitation as children become change agents: the lawyers, social workers, teachers and journalists who take their abusers to court, protect vulnerable children and change the system from within. ​To date, Free a Girl has rescued almost 10,000 children worldwide and supported them in their path to healing, justice and empowerment. ​📍 Start & finish — Jimmy Woo, Leidseplein 📅 Saturday 24 October · 10:30 (be there 10:00 to check in, dance & warm up) 🏃 5 km · easy social pace · 0.0 on the run 🔊 STËLZ DJ SUV on the canals → 2–3h rave at the finish 👟 Powered by 020.RC × STËLZ × HOKA ​Bring a friend, bring the energy. Grab your ticket; limited spots, so be fast.
2933072.title: 020.RC RUNS FOR FREE A GIRL

2933153.context: Clubcult - Video Installation Free installations at ADE Lab Village Exhibitions / Free A&C Events / Other / West / Club Culture ADE Lab Village Westergas · 00:00 - 23:59 ADE Lab Village Westergas + - <path d="M22.4652 1.46
2933153.description: In loving memory of Jelmar van Belle, who filmed these videos during the closing of De School and sadly passed away on 20 February 2026. In January 2024, the renowned Amsterdam nightclub De School closed its doors. For more than eight years, it offered the city a unique space where everyone could truly be themselves. Behind these doors, a world of expression, love, fashion, and identity emerged. Clubs like this are more than nightlife venues, they are breeding grounds for culture. The culture that forms around Amsterdam’s underground nightlife is shaped by people who cannot easily be defined. They often remain invisible to the outside world, partly due to the strict no-picture policy. Yet they are the ones who embody the color, creativity, and authenticity of the city. From this invisibility, CLUBCULT emerged as a creative collective who share the same passion for fashion, art & nightlife. During the final 66 hours of De School, Clubcult captured more than two hundred club visitors in temporary studios built within the walls of this iconic venue. The portrayed were scouted directly from the club; spontaneous, unfiltered, and completely themselves. The result is raw, intimate, poetic, and real. Alongside these videos, photographs were also taken in four photography studios. These images have been brought together in a 400-page photography book, available to order at johnnyblood.nl. The project premiered with an exhibition at Door Open Space during ADE 2025, and will be screend across Westerpark throughout ADE 2026. Credits: Creative direction: Maaike Bouwman JOHNNY BLOOD, Casting & Creative direction: Lizzy Bouwman, JOHNNY BLOOD Art Direction: Daan Kneppers Videographers: Jelmar van Belle, Dorith Mous Photographers: Barrie Hullegie, Lonneke van der Palen, Jorre Janssens, Tim Verhallen. Graphic Design & Art Direction book: Anne van Bokhoven Casting & Scout: Michiel van Maaren With special thanks to: Jochem Wertheimer, Leendert Sonnevelt, Nathan Kofi, Anne van der Weij

At the same time, he built a distinct identity of his own, with support from the Soulection community and a steadily growing international fanbase. 2935623.context: Circuits and Ceremonies Exhibition by Sunjoo Lee, Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan Exhibitions / Free A&C Events / Other / South / New Arts & Culture Venues Zone2Source · 13:00 - 17:00 Zone2Source + - <path d="M22.4652
2935623.description: Zone2Source presents an exhibition exploring electricity as a living network through works by Sunjoo Lee, Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan , in which technology, ecology and ritual become intertwined. Circuits and Ceremonies takes Sunjoo Lee’s long-term artistic research project Electric Garden as a starting point, a project initially developed in collaboration with FIBER. Zone2Source invited the artist to continue to explore the implications of her project further through engagement with the work of fellow artists who equally consider electricity not as an invisible, unlimited source of energy but as a living and relational process. Presented in the centre of the glass pavilion and growing outwards, works by Claire Williams and Ryan Jordan will engage in direct dialogue with Sunjoo Lee’s work through installations, research and experiments. Using microbial fuel cells, which generate power through the metabolic processes of soil bacteria, Electric Garden becomes an ecosystem where microbes, plants, insects, and minerals coexist while emitting small currents of electricity. Devices powered by the garden are designed to adapt to the slow, variable and unpredictable currents of the microbes, questioning the speed and extractive logic of industrial energy systems and encouraging reflection on degrowth, reciprocity, and ecological coexistence. What happens when electricity is not generated and consumed, but cultivated, nurtured and shared? Zone2Source is located in the Amstelpark. The closest access is the so-called Red Bridge. Open Friday - Sunday, 13:00-17:00 Free entry Explore more ADE Arts & Culture events at Zone2Source here .
2935623.lineup_names: Claire Williams · Ryan Jordan · Sunjoo Lee

About Mixx Sound Network: Mixx Sound Network is a pioneering 360-degree electronic music ecosystem based in Toronto. Encompassing a professional DJ academy, artist management, premium audio installations, festival production, and streetwear retail, the network provides a multifaceted platform driving the future of the industry. With a mission to discover, educate, and elevate, Mixx Sound Network aims to connect a global community of creators and listeners, bridging the North American and European scenes. LEARN. CREATE. PERFORM. DRESS the SOUND. Free entry. Limited capacity, so arrive early.

2939376.description: MADE is coming to Amsterdam to celebrate 30 years of Amsterdam Dance Event. Join us on Friday 23 October 2026, from 3pm to 7pm, at Ganbei Cocktail Bar for a free afternoon of good music and networking. With performances from some of the names making headlines in the UK: Connor Doonan, Corey Bell, Fletcher Kerr, Gemma Baxter, Joe Wilson, Laura Colandrea, Louis Johnstone, Roman Briggs, Usif and Zander. Alongside the DJ showcase, we will record a live podcast with guest interviews. There will also be plenty of time to meet people from across the music industry, connect with record labels and start new creative projects together. Whether you are a DJ, a producer, a label or simply in town for ADE, come and say hello. Free entry.
